jobs.title: Freelance Project Coordinator - Administrative
jobs.description:
**Summary**

**About the Project:**  
Supercharged is seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented Freelance Project Coordinator to support our growing Roadshow team. This role will provide critical coordination, project administration, data management, and workflow support across multiple concurrent clusters, activations, partners, vendors, and deliverables.

The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in a fast\-moving, project\-based environment and is exceptionally comfortable keeping information organized, following up on open items, maintaining accurate project records, and making sure deadlines and deliverables stay on track.

**This is a hands\-on coordination role for someone who enjoys bringing structure and visibility to complex projects.**

**What You'll Do:**

* Support maintenance of our project\-management foundation across Egnyte, Airtable, Teamwork, Slack, Iconik, and CoreCRM, ensuring the Roadshow team can consistently locate accurate information, resources, and deliverables.
* Provide additional bandwidth as the Roadshow grows, helping the team manage multiple clusters, activations, partners, vendors, and reporting requirements without sacrificing organization, accuracy, or delivery quality.
* Prepare and maintain reporting and activation records by auditing metadata, hyperlinks, statuses, task comments, cluster records, stop records, and activation records against established requirements.
* Reinforce standardized workflows and delivery timelines by facilitating repeatable processes, applying due dates, preparing resources, and maintaining weekly update cadences across clusters and activations.
* Increase accountability and visibility by proactively identifying missing deliverables, overdue tasks, incomplete metadata, unresolved Slack threads, and other gaps before they create downstream delays.
* Relieve Roadshow leadership and project staff of high\-volume administrative and data\-management work so they can focus on production, stakeholder management, strategy, and core Roadshow execution.
* Coordinate information across platforms and workstreams, ensuring corresponding records, folders, reports, tasks, contacts, and creative assets are accurately linked and reflect consistent project information.
* Conduct regular quality\-control checks to identify inconsistencies, missing information, or outdated records.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders and project owners to obtain missing information and keep workstreams moving.
* Maintain a high level of organization and accuracy across a fast\-changing portfolio of projects.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 2\+ years of experience in project coordination, project administration, marketing operations, agency operations, event/experiential production, or a similar role.
* Experience supporting multiple projects, workstreams, clients, activations, or stakeholders simultaneously.
* Exceptional organizational and time\-management skills with a strong attention to detail.
* Ability to proactively identify gaps and follow through until issues are resolved.
* Comfortable working across multiple project\-management, collaboration, CRM, and file\-management platforms.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of assigned workflows.
* Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
* Strong follow\-up skills and a high level of accountability.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Experience with tools such as Airtable, Teamwork, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, ClickUp, Slack, or similar platforms is highly valued.
* Experience in events, experiential marketing, creative agencies, sports, entertainment, media, lifestyle, or marketing\*\* is strongly preferred.

**Location \& Time Zone:**

* **Candidates must be located in California and work within the Pacific Time Zone** (PST/PDT).
* **Please do not apply if you are not currently located in California** or are unable to consistently work Pacific Time hours.

**NOTE:**

* If selected for this role the client will run a background check.
* Please be prepared to be responsive to interview request within 24 hours.

**Success in This Role:**

Success in this role means the Roadshow team can rely on you to keep project information accurate, organized, connected, and current; identify issues before they become problems; maintain momentum across deadlines and deliverables; and provide the administrative and coordination support that allows the broader team to focus on executing exceptional Roadshow experiences.

If you are someone who naturally creates order, loves a well\-maintained project tracker, follows up relentlessly, and can keep many moving pieces organized at once, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $35\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* How many hours per week are you able to commit to this project?
* Do you understand this is a contract/freelance position?
* What are your pay expectations (hourly)?
* What experience do you have working with UHNW family offices, professional services firms, or legal environments, project coordination, operations, legal administration, or related experience do you have? Please provide example of relevant experience and how it relates to this role OR where on your resume can these details be seen?
* Are you commutable distance to Santa Monica? (In office work may be required)
* How many other projects/contracts are you currently engaged on?
* Do you have experience with any of the following (Airtable, Teamwork, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, ClickUp, Slack, or similar platforms)? If so, please specify where you gained that experienced.
* How many years of project coordination, operations, administrative, data entry, or related experience do you have? Please provide example of relevant experience and how it relates to this role OR where on your resume can these details be seen?

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Project Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Code Four is looking for a highly organized Project Coordinator / PM Administrator to support our Project Management team in a fast\-paced event production and experiential environment.**

This role is ideal for someone who is strong with systems, organization, documentation, and follow\-through. You’ll work closely with our Project Managers to keep projects set up correctly, information current, logistics tracked, and documentation organized from project kickoff through closeout.

Experience with **NetSuite, Asana, and /or Flex Rental Solutions is highly preferred.**

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Set up and maintain projects in company PM and operational systems
* Enter and update project information in **NetSuite, Asana, Flex, and project management platforms**
* Populate project schedules and tasks using established templates
* Maintain accurate project data, folders, and file structures
* Track shipping, deliveries, pickups, and project logistics
* Collect and organize COIs, permits, approvals, and compliance documentation
* Assist with purchase orders, vendor information, work orders, and project documentation
* Track outstanding items and follow up with internal teams
* Coordinate information between Project Management, Creative, Graphics, Fabrication, AV, Warehouse/Logistics, and Accounting
* Prepare project status updates and reports
* Compile and organize project closeout documentation
* Support multiple Project Managers and active projects at the same time

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* 2\+ years of project coordination, project administration, operations, logistics, event production, AV, or related experience
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Comfortable working across multiple software systems
* Excellent follow\-through and ability to keep multiple projects organized
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities

**HIGHLY PREFERRED**

* **NetSuite experience**
* **Flex Rental Solutions / Flex ERP experience**
* Asana, Smartsheet, or similar project management software
* Event production, AV, experiential marketing, signage, graphics, fabrication, or scenic production experience
* Familiarity with POs, sales orders, estimates, shipping documentation, COIs, and permits

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is a **Project Coordinator / PM Administrator position**, not a senior Project Manager role. You will support Project Managers with the administrative and systems side of their projects rather than independently owning client relationships, project budgets, or onsite execution.

For someone interested in growing into Project Management, this is an excellent opportunity to learn the full lifecycle of complex event and experiential projects while working directly with an experienced production team.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Education:

Ability to Commute:

jobs.title: Program Coordinator II, Community Based Research Initiative (Community Engagement & Research Coordination)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**



Under the general supervision of the Executive Director and Program Principal Investigator, the INSPIRE Programs Coordinator will manage the day\-to\-day operations of CDU’s growing portfolio of INSPIRE community\-based research programs—INSPIRE Faith, INSPIRE CA, and INSPIRE USA. The Coordinator serves as the primary operational point of contact across these programs, combining research\-program coordination, community relationship\-building, and oversight of the digital engagement and data\-capture platforms (in partnership with the technology team) that enable the programs to operate at scale. The role blends hands\-on, place\-based community partnership (primarily through INSPIRE Faith) with the coordination of predominantly online, largely automated statewide, and national programs. A central purpose of the role is to strengthen community trust in research and to broaden the participation of Black/African American/Hispanic communities and other communities of color in clinical research and trials, ensuring that community voice and priorities shape how the work is designed and carried out.



About the Center:



The Charles R. Drew University of Medicine and Science (CDU), a partner in the UCLA Clinical and Translational Science Institute (CTSI) alongside UCLA and Cedars\-Sinai, is building a community\-centered clinical research enterprise through its Clinical and Translational Research Center (CTRC) in South Los Angeles. The INSPIRE programs are a family of community\-based research initiatives advancing health and brain health across diverse populations. INSPIRE Faith is a deep, place\-based partnership with faith institutions requiring regular in\-person engagement with community partners; INSPIRE CA, and INSPIRE USA are digitally delivered, largely automated programs conducted primarily online, with select live sessions led by physicians and study staff. Together they build on CDU’s longstanding legacy of community engagement and health\-equity research.

  



This work advances a national commitment to health equity: expanding access to healthcare in underserved communities, building lasting trust between communities of color and the healthcare system, and increasing the participation of Black/African American communities and other communities of color in research and clinical trials. As a historically Black graduate institution, CDU pursues these goals in partnership with peer institutions and community organizations, treating community relationships not as a means of recruitment but as the foundation of research that is shaped by, accountable to, and beneficial for the communities it serves. The INSPIRE Programs Coordinator is central to this mission, serving as the trusted community bridge that connects faith and community partners to research and trial opportunities and helps ensure that the science reflects the priorities of the community.


**Essential Duties**


* Manage the day\-to\-day operations and coordination of the INSPIRE research programs (Faith, CA, and USA), ensuring each program runs smoothly, on schedule, and in alignment with study protocols and the Center’s mission
* Coordinate in\-person activities for INSPIRE Faith—anticipated at approximately two days per week of on\-site engagement with community partners—and support the logistics of live sessions conducted by physicians and study staff across all programs, including scheduling, participant coordination, and event execution.
* Coordinate and support program staff, students, and volunteers across the INSPIRE programs, including onboarding, task coordination, and training
* Support participant recruitment, retention, and outreach across programs, including coordinating culturally appropriate promotional and educational materials (in collaboration with the communications team)
* Attend community meetings, faith\-partner gatherings, health events, and program activities as needed to represent the INSPIRE programs and CDU
* Oversee the online engagement platform, participant communications, scheduled calls, and data\-capture elements for the digitally delivered programs (INSPIRE CA, and USA), coordinating closely with the technology team to ensure the platforms function reliably and participant data is captured accurately and securely.
* Monitor program metrics, participant engagement, and feedback to assess effectiveness, support quality improvement, and inform recommendations to program leadership
* Establish and support Faith Community Advisory Boards across Los Angeles, coordinating the formation of one board in 2026 and several additional boards by 2028\. Each board is a governance body of no more than 11 faith leaders drawn from partnering faith institutions, guiding program direction, protocol input, and community voice at the faith\-partner level.
	+ The Coordinator organizes board recruitment, scheduling, meeting logistics, and ongoing stewardship.
* Recruit, onboard, and support Community Navigators from partnering faith institutions, growing the Navigator corps to 50 by the end of 2026 and more than 500 by the end of 2028\. Navigators are community members who support the conduct of the studies from the faith\-community side, including participant recruitment, guidance in navigating different community and clinical spaces, and support at program events.
	+ Navigators are distinct from advisory board members and are not study participants themselves.
* Organize and help lead faith\-based health festivals, coordinating planning, faith\-partner engagement, logistics, staffing, and execution to advance community health and program visibility across partnering faith institutions.
* Build trusted partnerships with community and faith\-based organizations, serving as the primary liaison and fostering ongoing engagement across INSPIRE programs.

The person doing this job is responsible for a variety of tasks that lead to a high level of customer satisfaction in the most cost effective manner.**Job Requirements**
Required* Bachelor Degree in Nursing (BSN)

* Ability to function as a member of an interdisciplinary team.

jobs.title: Navigator/ Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Description

**Legal Name of Agency:** Central City Neighborhood Partners

**Position Title:** Navigator/ Outreach Coordinator

**Reports to:** 

Financial Empowerment Manager

**Hours and Benefits:** This is a full\-time, on\-site position offering an hourly rate of $19\-$22, based on experience, with an expected commitment of 40 hours per week. The role includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical and dental coverage, paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave.

**ORGANIZATIONAL/PROGRAM BACKGROUND:**

Central City Neighborhood Partners (CCNP) was established in 1994 and incorporated as a formal non\-profit collaborative in 2000 to address the socio\-economic conditions impacting low\-income families living in the City of Los Angeles, with a focus on Westlake and surrounding communities. and expanding to Koreatown in 2024\. With the mission of catalyzing partnerships to systemically address the multiple challenges facing low\-income families, CCNP works with its partners to help families create pathways to financial security and economic opportunity through our FamilySource Center (FSC) program, financial asset\-building programs and other signature programs.

**Position Overview:**

The Outreach Coordinator is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing strategic outreach initiatives to connect with and serve individuals and communities impacted by specific events or conditions such as the fires. This role requires building strong relationships with community stakeholders and partners to ensure the effective delivery of information and resources. The person is responsible for active recruitment of individuals to CCNP programs, specifically recruiting eligible individuals to participate in financial and career development.

**Outreach Coordinator** will perform a broad range of duties spanning the full employment cycle, including, but not limited to providing support and/or monitoring of the following

* Warmly welcome clients and provide information and referrals based on client needs;
* Anticipate, meet and exceed client needs by maintaining a current working knowledge of all programs, activities and procedures;
* Develop and implement strategic outreach plans tailored to the needs of impacted populations.
* Lead workshops and trainings to the general public and offer 1\-1 navigation support
* Build and maintain relationships with community leaders, organizations, government agencies, and other stakeholders.
* Create and distribute outreach materials such as brochures, flyers, and newsletters, and graphics that can be ready to post on social media
* Work with internal teams to align outreach strategies with overall organizational goals and respond to public inquiries.
* Attend community outreach events, job fairs, and other events to promote the financial and career coaching opportunities.
* Assist in the preparation of all outreach material for distribution in the community
* Additional tasks, projects and responsibilities as assigned by supervisor and executive leadership.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Savvy and energetic with ability to outreach, connect and engage the community in activities;
* Ability to instruct and present ideas, rules and activities in a clear and comprehensive manner;
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills required, ability to multi\-task, and the ability to fill\-in for co\-workers as the work schedule requires;
* Must be able to cultivate teamwork, exercise good judgment and be comfortable working with partners, staff and clients of diverse backgrounds and circumstances;
* Must be a self\-starter, have initiative, excellent follow\-through skills and problem\-solving capacity;
* Commitment to the mission and goals of CCNP.
* Proven experience in outreach, community engagement, public relations, or a related field.
* Familiarity with the Westlake and surrounding communities
* The ability to read, write and speak in English and Spanish is required, given that many of the targeted families are monolingual in Spanish. Cultural sensitivity is required.
* Operational knowledge of the Internet and web\-related technologies; Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint); Windows Operating System.
* Ability to manage databases and reporting systems in order to produce a variety of written reports.

**EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Any combination equivalent to: High School Diploma/GED and two years of general office experience; related coursework and certifications encouraged.

**Other Requirements**

* Successfully pass all post offer, pre\-employment screening requirements, including criminal background check, and provide proof of eligibility to work in the United States.
* TB Certificate
* Full COVID\-19 Vaccination
* Must have a valid California Driver’s License, proof of liability insurance, and access to a reliable automobile are required because this position involves traveling to multiple locations to conduct outreach and perform job\-related duties.

**COVID\-19 Vaccine required for all employees**Central City Neighborhood Partners has implemented a mandatory vaccination policy effective October 1, 2021 requiring COVID\-19 vaccinations for all employees (with approved religious and medical accommodations). At present, an individual is deemed “fully vaccinated” when that person has received, either the single\-dose COVID\-19 vaccine Pfizer or Moderna. As a condition of employment, employees must submit official COVID\-19 vaccine documentation.

**Physical Requirements**

* To perform this job the individual must be able to carry out all essential functions satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.
* Approximately 50% of time is spent sitting, while frequently required to walk, stand and bend.
* Must be able to speak and hear well.
* Good vision is imperative.
*

**ABOUT EARTH COMPOUNDING PHARMACY**

Our mission is to help people achieve optimal wellness through personalized, research\-based compounded medications made just for them. We are a fast\-growing compounding pharmacy in California, and we are looking for pharmacy technicians who thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.

**WHAT YOU'LL FIND HERE**

**Fast Growth \& Opportunity**  
Join a rapidly expanding pharmacy where high performers are recognized, challenged, and given opportunities to grow.

**Meaningful Work**  
Every prescription we prepare is customized to meet a patient's unique needs. Your attention to detail directly impacts patient outcomes.

**High Standards \& Strong Team Culture**  
We believe in accountability, professionalism, and teamwork. We work hard, support one another, and take pride in delivering an exceptional experience to our patients and providers.

**About the Role**

As a **Patient Care and Sales Coordinator**  at **Earth Compounding Pharmacy**, you are the first voice our patients hear and a key part of how we deliver an exceptional experience from the first call to the final shipment. You will manage inbound and outbound patient communication, process prescriptions accurately, and proactively offer patients the options that best serve their health and their budget, including multi\-month supply options where product expiration allows.

If you take pride in doing things right the first time, thrive on building patient relationships, and want to grow within a company that rewards results, we want to hear from you.

**What You Can Expect**

✅ **Intensive Training**  
No experience working in the pharmacy? We will train you — but only if you are committed to learning and delivering results. You’ll work side\-by\-side with experienced professionals who expect you to keep up, ask questions, and take ownership of your growth.

✅ **High Standards, Real Impact**  
We are trusted to prepare custom medications that impact patients’ health every single day. Accuracy and attention to detail are not optional — they are the baseline.

✅ **A Team That Delivers**  
You’ll be part of a results\-driven group where everyone pulls their weight. We value **accountability**, **dependability**, and **competence** — and we expect the same from every team member.

**Requirements**

* Proven reliability and punctuality
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under time pressure
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with a high\-performance team
* Commitment to learning and improving daily

If you are **ambitious**, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and are ready to meet high expectations, apply now to join a team that rewards hard work and results.

**What You Will Do**

* Answer and make phone calls with professionalism, urgency, and genuine care for the patient
* Process prescriptions accurately, verifying addresses, quantities, expiration dates, and supply options before every order
* Proactively offer specials and multi\-month supply options to patients when product expiration allows
* Communicate clearly and consistently with patients, providers, and teammates
* Take ownership of errors, correct them immediately, and apply the lesson going forward
* Support daily pharmacy operations with attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong communication skills and a willingness to pick up the phone and engage; this role requires high phone volume
* Exceptional attention to detail; mistakes in a pharmacy setting have real consequences for patients
* A sales mindset; you are comfortable offering options and guiding patients toward the best choice for their needs
* Accountability; you take correction well and do not repeat the same mistake twice
* A drive to learn, produce, and grow within one company over the long term
* Reliability, punctuality, and a strong work ethic

**Compensation**

* Base pay: $18\.50 to $20\.00 per hour, depending on experience
* Eligible for commission after 90 days, with the with the potential to earn an additional $300 to $1,000 per month based on performance

**Hours**

* Monday \- Friday 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

**To apply: If you are serious about building a long\-term career in a high\-standard, patient\-focused environment, apply today.**

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $18\.50 \- $21\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator / Client Experience Advocate - Plastic Surgery
jobs.description:
**About the Opportunity**
Adoreal works with a small number of leading aesthetic and cosmetic medicine practices, giving them the technology, operational support, and talent they need as they grow. We are hiring on behalf of one of those partners, a plastic surgery practice in Santa Monica, for a Patient Care Coordinator (PCC) / Client Experience Advocate (CEA).


Adoreal partners with a select group of top\-tier aesthetic and cosmetic medicine practices, providing the technology, operational support, and talent that help them deliver an exceptional patient experience while they scale. We are recruiting on behalf of one of our partner practices, a high\-end, luxury plastic surgery practice based in California.


**About The Role**
This is a patient care coordination and client experience role. You own the patient relationship from the first phone call through consultation, treatment, and everything after. It is not a front desk job. A separate front\-office team handles reception, check\-in, and the day\-to\-day running of the office, and you will work alongside them.


What matters most here is the conversation itself. You find out what a patient actually wants, talk openly about options and pricing, and help them reach a decision they feel settled about, whether that decision is yes or no. Do that well and patients come back for years and send their friends. It suits someone who is at their best one\-on\-one and who follows up when they said they would.


Key Responsibilities**Inquiry \& Consultation Intake**

* Handle incoming inquiries by phone, email, and social. The first call sets the tone, so ask real questions and find out what the patient is actually after.
* Turn those inquiries into booked consultations, and send patients in prepared so they are not hearing everything for the first time in the room.
* Keep notes current in the practice EMR and CRM. A patient history, goals, and hesitations should not have to be rediscovered at the next visit.

**Patient Care Coordination**

* Be the person patients call, from consultation through surgery, recovery, and follow\-up.
* Walk patients through pre\-op and post\-op instructions and answer the questions they are nervous to ask.
* Coordinate with the surgeon and other treatment providers, and clinical staff, so nothing falls between them.
* Follow up to confirm appointments and check on recovery, before a patient has to chase you.

**Client Experience \& Practice Growth (CEA)**

* Present treatment plans, pricing, and financing clearly, so patients can decide with the full picture in front of them.
* Run the consultation conversation with structure. Understand the goal, address hesitations head on and help every patient throughout their decision\-making process.
* Follow up on a real schedule with patients who need time to think. Consultative, never pushy, but nobody should go quiet in your pipeline because you forgot about them.
* Keep track of your own pipeline of prospective patients, from first inquiry to booking, in the practice CRM.
* Help them navigate financing options such as CareCredit and Cherry.
* Help with reputation management by asking happy patients for reviews and handling any service complaint quickly.
* Protect patient privacy and hold the standard of discretion a practice like this depends on.

  

**Requirements**  

* You live in or near Santa Monica. This role is on\-site.
* Polished, presentable, and professional in appearance and demeanor at all times.
* Organized and diligent, and comfortable holding several patients, schedules, and priorities in your head at once.
* Comfortable talking about value. Pricing, treatment plans, and financing come up constantly, and how you handle those conversations shapes whether patients go ahead.
* You see what needs doing and do it, rather than waiting to be told.
* Genuinely at ease in a clinical setting and around patients.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with a warm, client\-service instinct.
* Prior experience as a patient coordinator, treatment coordinator, or client experience advocate in plastic surgery, dermatology, a medspa, or a similar aesthetics setting.
* Formal consultative sales training in aesthetics or elective medicine is a strong plus, as is a track record of owning the consult\-to\-booking process.
* Familiarity with aesthetics EMR, CRM, and scheduling software helps, but we can teach the software.

  

**Benefits** **Adoreal is helping our partner plastic surgery practice fill a position internally. This position is not with Adoreal directly.**

**We provide the operational, marketing, and growth infrastructure that empowers surgeons to focus on what they do best: delivering exceptional patient care and outcomes.**

 **By combining innovative business strategies with world\-class clinical talent, Adoreal enables clinics and surgeons to thrive in today’s competitive elective medicine landscape.**

jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Purchasing Coordinator to join our procurement team. In this vital role, you will orchestrate the purchasing process, ensuring timely acquisition of materials and services that support our operational excellence. Your expertise in supply chain management, vendor communication, and procurement systems will drive efficiency and cost savings across the organization. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast\-paced environment where strategic sourcing and inventory control are key to success.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage end\-to\-end procurement activities using SAP, SAP ERP, JD Edwards, Oracle EBS, and other purchasing management systems to streamline purchasing workflows.
* Collaborate with vendors through direct negotiation and relationship management to secure optimal pricing, delivery schedules, and quality standards.
* Monitor inventory levels using inventory management systems and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) tools to ensure supply chain continuity.
* Analyze Excel data and spreadsheets for purchase trends, pricing analysis, and procurement forecasting to support strategic sourcing decisions.
* Coordinate with supply chain teams to optimize materials management, inventory control, and logistics operations.
* Support vendor communication efforts by resolving issues related to order discrepancies, delivery delays, or quality concerns.
* Maintain accurate records of purchase orders, contracts, and supplier performance metrics in accounting software and ERP systems.

**Experience**

* Proven experience working with SAP, SAP ERP, JD Edwards, or Oracle EBS in a purchasing or materials management role.
* Strong understanding of supply chain management principles including inventory control, sourcing strategies, and vendor relationship management.
* Demonstrated ability to utilize spreadsheets and Excel for data analysis related to procurement activities.
* Familiarity with procurement processes such as direct negotiation procurement and sourcing techniques.
* Experience supporting purchasing management systems technically or administratively is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of MRP systems, inventory management software like AS400 or equivalent platforms is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills for effective vendor negotiations and cross\-departmental collaboration.

Join us as a Purchasing Coordinator to be at the forefront of our supply chain operations! Bring your expertise in procurement systems and vendor relations to help us achieve operational excellence while enjoying a vibrant work environment dedicated to your growth and success.

Pay: $18\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Territory Account Manager** **– Public Sector (SLED) Focused**


**FLSA STATUS: Exempt**


**Location:** **Anaheim, CA**

  


**WHO WE ARE:**



MGT is a leading provider of technology and advisory solutions serving state, local, and education government agencies (SLED) across the United States. Through client partnerships, MGT’s almost 1,200 employees impact communities for good by managing and securing critical networks, solving complex human capital and fiscal problems, elevating education systems, and advancing equity as a performance imperative. MGT partners with thousands of agencies as a trusted advisor delivering solutions that improve technology, operational, and economic performance to help communities thrive.



Founded in 1975, MGT initiated an ambitious restart in 2016, broadening the solutions portfolio to provide the most specialized solutions, tackling the most mission\-critical problems that live at the top of the public agency leadership agenda. MGT drives over 20% compound annual organic growth and utilizes programmatic mergers and acquisitions to grow capabilities, attract top talent, and accelerate growth scale. Since 2020, MGT has successfully completed 13 acquisitions, driving over 60% compound annual inorganic growth.



Celebrating its 50th year in 2025, the firm attracts exceptional talent and empowers them to exceed client expectations as they navigate the dynamic demands of the clients we serve. Hear more about MGT’s culture in the words of ouremployees (https://www.mgt.us/careers/).

  


**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**



A Territory Account Manager is a hunter\-focused sales role designed to accelerate growth across an assigned geographic territory by identifying, developing, and winning new business within the State, Local Government, and Education (SLED) market. This position is thrives on prospecting, building relationships from the ground up, and creating opportunities within largely untapped ("white space") accounts. The Territory Account Manager is responsible for executing strategic business development initiatives, establishing trusted relationships with technology and business decision\-makers, and positioning MGT as a preferred technology advisor.



The position opens doors, builds executive relationships, uncovers customer challenges, and partners with technical resources to deliver innovative technology solutions. Success in this role is measured by pipeline generation, new customer acquisition, revenue growth, forecast accuracy, and long\-term customer development.


* Develop and execute a strategic territory business plan focused on expanding MGT's presence within assigned SLED markets.
* Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities within white\-space accounts through outbound calling, email campaigns, networking, referrals, social selling, and partner engagement.
* Build relationships with executive leadership, IT leadership, procurement officials, and operational stakeholders throughout state agencies, local governments, K\-12 districts, higher education institutions, and special districts.
* Develop a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities by consistently executing prospecting and business development activities.
* Conduct virtual customer meetings, discovery sessions, presentations, and solution discussions while leveraging in\-person meetings for strategic opportunities.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects, Engineering, Sales Support, Renewals Support, Professional Services, and Managed Services teams to design and deliver comprehensive technology solutions.
* Develop account strategies that identify customer initiatives, funding opportunities, refresh cycles, and long\-term technology roadmaps.
* Build strong relationships with strategic technology partners, manufacturers, distributors, and channel account managers to jointly identify and pursue opportunities.
* Prepare customer presentations, proposals, quotations, statements of work, and executive business reviews.
* Maintain accurate opportunity, activity, forecasting, and pipeline information within Salesforce CRM.
* Achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales objectives, including pipeline generation, revenue, profitability, and new logo acquisition.
* Represent MGT at customer events, conferences, manufacturer events, and regional networking activities.

  


*ADA Notice: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

  


**WHAT YOU’LL BRING:**



Successful Territory Account Managers consistently:


* Generate new qualified opportunities through proactive prospecting.
* Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline.
* Acquire new customers while expanding existing relationships.
* Meet or exceed revenue, gross profit, and margin objectives.
* Consistently execute daily sales activities including outbound calls, virtual meetings, customer visits, and follow\-up.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts and CRM data.
* Develop trusted relationships with customers and strategic technology partners.
* Demonstrate strong collaboration across sales, engineering, operations, and leadership teams.

  


**Education**


* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and professional sales experience.


**Experience**


* Two (2\) or more years of successful B2B technology sales, business development, or public sector sales experience.
* Experience prospecting and developing new customer relationships.
* Demonstrated success managing a sales pipeline and achieving revenue goals.
* Experience selling complex technology solutions and professional services preferred.
* Familiarity with public sector procurement processes, cooperative purchasing contracts, and RFP/RFQ environments is a plus.

  


**Skills \& Competencies**


* Self\-Motivation
* Results Orientation
* Time Manage

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist, Life Sciences
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world's health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem \- including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient's request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.  

  

By joining Datavant today, you're stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.


We're looking for a Marketing Specialist with a knack for operational excellence \- someone who brings order to standard operating procedures, cross\-format production support, and the knowledge systems that keep the team's collateral and institutional knowledge organized and accessible.



This role is responsible for documenting and maintaining how the team works, coordinating production of marketing assets across formats including video, one\-pagers, and design collateral, and serving as the team's go\-to for Airtable, building and maintaining the systems that organize the team's work, content, and knowledge management.



This is an individual contributor role reporting into Life Sciences Marketing, with the opportunity to grow into additional marketing domains as the team scales.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Process \& SOPs:** Maintain and continually refine standard operating procedures across the Life Sciences marketing team, documenting how work gets done and helping keep processes current and easy to follow as the team evolves.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Content Marketing Manager

**Company:** Tacos 1986

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA (In\-field \& On\-site)

**Compensation:** $75,000 Starting Base Salary

**Who We Are**

Tacos 1986 brings the unfiltered, high\-energy experience of a Tijuana street taqueria straight to Los Angeles. We’re known for our trompo, fresh\-pressed masa, and cult\-favorite menu that communities love. We don’t do boring corporate food. We create real, raw, fast\-paced culinary experiences across our brick\-and\-mortar locations, major music festivals, pop\-ups, catering events, and private activations.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a dynamic storyteller, content strategist, and brand\-minded creator to become the in\-house documentarian of Tacos 1986\. The scope of the role will continue to evolve alongside the company.

This is much more than scheduling social posts. You’ll be capturing taqueros slicing adobada off the trompo, documenting festival load\-ins, building our YouTube presence, highlighting parts of the brand our audience may not know about, and helping turn our social reach into real\-world awareness, catering leads, and event opportunities.

You’ll work closely with our marketing team to ensure all content supports the larger marketing calendar, campaigns, promotions, partnerships, and overall brand direction. While there will always be opportunities to capture spontaneous moments, this role requires **proactive planning, scheduling, and pre\-production of shoots** so we consistently have the right content for upcoming initiatives.

**What You Will Do**

* **Produce Weekly Social Content:** Shoot, edit, deliver and post approximately **4–5 high\-energy short\-form videos per week** for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other social platforms. Shoot accompanying photography when needed for marketing initiatives.
* **Plan \& Schedule Content Shoots:** Work ahead of the marketing calendar to identify content needs, coordinate locations and talent, build shot lists, and schedule dedicated shoot days for upcoming campaigns, menu launches, partnerships, and events.
* **Partner With the Marketing Team:** Work closely with marketing to ensure content remains aligned with Tacos 1986’s brand identity, campaign priorities, promotions, partnerships, and business objectives.
* **Build the YouTube Channel:** Develop longer\-form vlogs, mini\-documentaries, behind\-the\-scenes features, and recurring concepts showcasing ingredient sourcing, festival load\-ins, restaurant culture, events, and the people behind Tacos 1986\.
* **Own the Narrative:** Capture the grit, personality, and energy behind the brand—from early\-morning prep and busy restaurant services to weekend pop\-ups and large\-scale festival activations across Southern California.
* **Expand Brand Awareness:** Create dedicated content around offerings our audience may not fully know about, including happy hour, breakfast, catering, new menu initiatives, special events, and other emerging programs.
* **Create Product\-Focused Stories:** Develop content around individual menu items, ingredients, and signature products—from specific tacos and proteins to Salsa Macha and other elements that make Tacos 1986 distinctive.
* **Support Catering \& Events:** Create content designed to generate awareness and inbound interest for catering, private events, festivals, and brand activations, while helping track social\-generated opportunities.
* **Grow With the Brand:** As new initiatives launch, help develop the content strategy, storytelling approach, and content systems needed to introduce and support them. Also supporting content for the New York location and Las Vegas location(will require travel).

**What You Bring**

* Proven experience shooting and editing compelling, fast\-paced video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, and similar platforms.
* Strong instincts for storytelling, pacing, hooks, editing, and identifying moments that audiences actually want to watch.
* A strategic mindset and an understanding that content should support broader marketing and business objectives—not just generate views.
* Strong organizational and production\-planning skills, including the ability to schedule shoots, develop shot lists, anticipate upcoming content needs, and work from a marketing calendar.
* The ability to collaborate closely with a marketing team while also independently identifying strong content opportunities.
* Comfort working in loud, chaotic, fast\-moving environments including kitchens, festivals, pop\-ups, events, and late\-night restaurant rushes.
* Flexibility to occasionally shoot outside traditional office hours when festivals, events, restaurant services, or other brand moments require it.
* Bilingual Spanish/English is highly preferred to communicate naturally and authentically with our back\-of\-house team.

**Compensation \& Perks**

* $75,000 starting base salary
* Potential travel to pop ups around the world, to any store outside California like Las Vegas and New York.
* Entry to all our festivals and events
* In\-house equipment allowance to build out your run\-and\-gun content gear
* Shift meals

Pay: From $75,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: VA Regional Sales Representative
jobs.description:
American Armor Gloves is hiring its first VA Regional Sales Representatives to build out a dedicated sales function for VA healthcare accounts. This is a new sales team, not a new company — AAG has spent years developing the manufacturing capacity, quality systems, and early government relationships this role is built to take advantage of.


**The Opportunity**
===================



This is a new role, but it isn't a cold start. AAG has already done much of the groundwork required to sell into government and VA healthcare: compliant manufacturing, a quality system built for regulated buyers, and early relationships with VA stakeholders. What hasn't existed until now is a dedicated sales representative to develop that opportunity fully within an assigned VA region. You'll be one of the first five or six people to hold this role, working from an established foundation rather than starting from nothing.


**What You'll Own**
===================


* Sales development and account management for VA facilities, CBOCs, and healthcare systems within your assigned region.
* Relationships with the people who make purchasing decisions — Chiefs of Logistics, procurement leads, and clinical stakeholders.
* A territory pipeline you build and manage yourself, from first contact through closed business, navigating VA purchasing processes along the way.
* Ongoing account growth, including new facility penetration and deeper relationships within your region.

**What Makes You the Right Fit**
================================


* **Government or VA sales experience — required.** You should already understand how these purchasing processes work.
* **Existing relationships within VA healthcare systems — preferred.** It's a specific, relationship\-driven network, and prior experience in it shortens the learning curve.
* **Comfort managing a defined territory independently,** with real ownership over how you prioritize and run it.
* **Strong follow\-through and CRM discipline,** since accurate pipeline and forecast tracking is a core part of the role, not an afterthought.

**Compensation \& Growth**
==========================



Base salary plus commission, structured to be competitive with current market data for government and federal healthcare sales roles, with uncapped upside as your territory develops. As AAG's government sales team grows, there is a defined path forward — into senior territory roles, national account management, and eventually broader federal healthcare opportunities beyond the VA.


**About American Armor Gloves**
===============================



American Armor Gloves manufactures high\-quality nitrile gloves, produced in West Columbia, South Carolina. The company has built its business on advanced manufacturing, operational discipline, and a commitment to quality — supplying healthcare professionals, first responders, and other essential workers who depend on consistent, reliable protection.


**We are actively interviewing for this role now — apply today to be considered.**

The Program Coordinator serves a vital role in advancing Vanguard University's mission by supporting the School of Education's commitment to preparing Christ\-centered educators who will positively impact schools, communities, and future generations. jobs.title: US Print-on-Demand Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
#### **Your purpose at Stanley/Stella**


As US Print\-on\-Demand Key Account Manager, you will lead the growth and development of Stanley/Stella's Print\-on\-Demand business across the United States.  

  

Acting as the primary commercial owner of the channel, you will build and strengthen relationships with official dealers, strategic partners and key accounts while identifying new opportunities to accelerate growth.  

Combining business development, account management and strategic planning, you will play a key role in expanding Stanley/Stella's presence within the US Print\-on\-Demand ecosystem and delivering a premium experience to our partners.  

  

Working closely with our European Print\-on\-Demand team and cross\-functional stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Planning, Finance and Customer Excellence, you will help shape the future of one of Stanley/Stella's key growth channels.#### **Your role and impact**

**Channel \& Account Development**
----------------------------------

* Define and execute the US Print\-on\-Demand commercial strategy in line with Stanley/Stella's growth ambitions and brand positioning
* Identify, recruit and develop new Print\-on\-Demand partners, official dealers and strategic accounts across the region
* Build and execute account plans that support customer growth, strengthen partnerships and unlock new business opportunities
* Lead regular business reviews focused on sales performance, profitability, service levels and growth initiatives
* Own sales and profitability targets and proactively implement actions to drive performance
**US \& European Collaboration**
--------------------------------

* Partner closely with the European Print\-on\-Demand team to align account strategies, share market insights and ensure consistency across international partnerships
* Act as the voice of the US market, bringing customer feedback, trends and opportunities into global discussions
* Adapt global initiatives and strategic programs to maximize their impact in the US market
**Market Presence \& Relationship Building**
--------------------------------------------

* Develop a strong network within the Print\-on\-Demand, decoration and apparel ecosystem
* Establish trusted relationships with key stakeholders across customers, partners and industry influencers
* Represent Stanley/Stella at trade shows, industry events, customer meetings and networking opportunities
* Strengthen brand visibility and reinforce Stanley/Stella's position as a preferred partner within the market
**Sales Planning, CRM \& Business Performance**
-----------------------------------------------

* Maintain accurate customer, opportunity and account information within the CRM environment
* Deliver reliable sales forecasts and provide clear insights on performance drivers, risks and opportunities
* Leverage sales data, market intelligence and business insights to prioritize opportunities and optimize account performance
* Develop and monitor annual sales plans for the channel, strategic accounts and dealer network
**Cross\-Functional Execution**
-------------------------------

* Collaborate closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, Planning, Finance and Customer Excellence teams to deliver outstanding customer experiences
* Ensure commercial commitments are aligned with inventory availability, operational capabilities and profitability objectives
* Support the development of customer\-facing initiatives, co\-branded programs and growth opportunities that strengthen demand and engagement
#### **About you**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in Sales, Business Development or Key Account Management within Print\-on\-Demand, promotional products, wholesale apparel or a related industry
* Proven track record of developing strategic partnerships, recruiting channel partners and growing key accounts
* Experience managing account plans, sales pipelines and revenue targets
* Existing network within the Print\-on\-Demand, apparel decoration or promotional products ecosystem is a strong advantage
* Strong commercial acumen and ability to identify growth opportunities
* Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship\-building skills
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a high level of ownership and accountability
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-growing and evolving business environment
* Experience collaborating with international and cross\-functional teams is a plus
* Willingness to travel extensively across the US (minimum 50%) and occasionally internationally
#### **About us**


Founded in 2012, Stanley/Stella has become Europe’s leading brand for premium and sustainable blank apparel. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to redefine how responsible fashion is made, distributed and experienced.


We combine contemporary design with uncompromising quality and a deeply embedded commitment to sustainability. Every choice, from the fabrics we select to the long\-term partnerships we build, reflects our belief that doing better is not optional; it is essential.


At Stanley/Stella, excellence is not a slogan. It is our way of working. We operate with transparency, respect and an entrepreneurial spirit that empowers every team member to make an impact. Together we are shaping a more conscious and inspiring future for our industry and for everyone who wears our products.


Join a company that leads by example, grows with purpose and creates change that lasts.

jobs.title: 2027 MBA Summer Intern – Account Manager, US
jobs.description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income. With our launch in 1971 in Newport Beach, California, PIMCO introduced investors to a total return approach to fixed income investing. In the 50\+ years since, we have worked relentlessly to help millions of investors pursue their objectives – regardless of shifting marketing conditions. As active investors, our goal is not just to find opportunities, but to create them. To this end, we remain firmly committed to the pursuit of our mission: delivering superior investment returns, solutions, and service to our clients.


Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high\-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

**2027 MBA Summer Intern – Account Manager, US**

**Positions will be located****in PIMCO’s Newport** **Beach,** **CA Headquarters, Austin,****Texas, or New** **York, NY.**


PIMCO’s client management team is comprised of client\-facing relationship management and sales professionals (“Account Managers”) who are directly responsible for contributing to the firm’s success through a combination of client relationship management and business development. Account Managers represent PIMCO to our clients and prospective clients and seek to deliver investment solutions that leverage PIMCO’s position as one of the world’s premier fixed income investment managers.


Account Managers are investment professionals who have a broad range of responsibilities, including to:

* Build and maintain relationships across client organizations
* Educate clients about a broad set of investment strategies
* Develop a deep understanding of clients’ investment objectives, risk tolerance and organizational structure, and industry trends towards presenting compelling tailored investment solutions
* Collaborate with other PIMCO investment professionals, including Product Strategists and Portfolio Managers regarding PIMCO's product offerings and capabilities
* Effectively communicate the benefits and features of PIMCO's investment solutions in the context of client investment objectives
* Provide information about performance attribution, market performance and macroeconomic conditions, as well as outline the firm’s current economic outlook and portfolio strategy
* Identify new business opportunities within existing clients and prospective clients; develop and execute strategies to grow PIMCO's assets under management (AUM) and improve firm profitability.


Account Managers can specialize in servicing a wide range of client types, including but not limited to, endowments, investment consultants, foundations, pension funds, broker\-dealer firms, and government entities.


The Account Manager Internship offers opportunities across both our Client Management and Global Wealth Management business groups. Interns will be aligned to one of these teams and gain hands\-on experience supporting client relationships and strategic initiatives within their respective group.

**Career Development, Training and Mentoring**


Every intern begins their summer with a formal week of training. The PIMCO Fundamentals training program will provide you with the skills, knowledge and relationships that will prepare you to succeed in your internship. Throughout the summer, in addition to formal senior networking initiatives and a high business impact project, your informal training will continue as you collaborate with the full PIMCO Team on client\-related work. In addition, you will be teamed with a seasoned professional who offers guidance and mentorship throughout the internship.

**Desired Candidates Should Possess the Following Characteristics**

* Ability to articulate ideas/strategies/views clearly verbally, in writing, and during presentations
* Personable and credible; ability to influence and develop client relationships into strategic partnerships
* Passion for financial markets, macroeconomics, and investment strategy
* Strong analytical abilities; capacity to blend the quantitative with the qualitative
* Ability to work effectively with other teams and leverage expertise to benefit clients
* Ability to develop an understanding of PIMCO’s clientele and investment strategies
* Ability to own a work assignment from ideation through implementation
* Highly organized, self\-sufficient, organized, and flexible
* Have demonstrated curiosity and experience in using new emerging technologies and AI tools in your work or school projects to solve problems and drive better outcomes

**You’re eligible to apply if you:**

* Are pursuing an MBA degree with an emphasis in Finance and Economics or a related, quantitative/analytical field from an accredited, leading business school or university, or other equivalent Advanced Degree as it relates to the position.
* Must be able to begin full time employment from a PIMCO office between January 2028 – August 2028
* Must be enrolled at a university during the Fall 2027 semester (August 2027 – December 2027\)
* Are business proficient in English

**While our eligibility requirements are not flexible, we encourage you to apply even if you do not possess 100% of the desired skills outlined above.**

**The PIMCO Internship Experience:**

* The PIMCO Internship is a 10\-week program that runs from early June to mid\-August, with the expectation that you will be available for the full duration of the program
* During Week 1, you’ll participate in PIMCO Fundamentals Training, providing you with the skills, knowledge, and relationships that will prepare you for success
* Alongside your colleagues, participate in PIMCO's Global Month of Volunteering, developed to heighten the impact of our employees' worldwide volunte

jobs.title: Enterprise Security Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:
**Grow with us!**  

HCI Systems, Inc. is seeking a results\-driven, enthusiastic sales professional to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will sell enterprise\-level integrated security solutions with a focus on new construction and build strong relationships with end\-users, electrical contractors and general contractors. You will have the opportunity to prospect and cultivate new relationships, gain an understanding of our clients' needs, and secure sales opportunities. **About Us:** HCI Systems, Inc. is a renowned leader in the fire life safety and low voltage industry, providing our clients with an end\-to\-end service offering that allows them to bundle all their needs under one provider.
Responsibilities:
* Drive business growth by prospecting and cultivating new relationships and identifying and educating prospective customers about HCI's products and services.
* Be responsible for identifying customer needs and developing strategies to meet company sales objectives.
* Lead the sales process from proposal development to closing, including crafting comprehensive scopes of work, managing project scope communication, and handling change order costs.
* Serve as the primary contact for clients, ensuring strong partnerships are established and maintained before, during, and after the sales process. Oversee all aspects of customer accounts, including managing active accounts and fostering sales growth.
* Collaborate with premier partners in vertical markets, such as transportation, global/enterprise accounts, utilities, financial/banking, healthcare, datacenters, federal, state, and local governments, and K\-12 \& higher education.
* Develop business opportunities by conducting needs assessments and constructing winning proposals for system installation and service opportunities.
* Develop financial justifications, perform takeoffs, prepare estimates and proposals, make presentations, and perform the necessary follow\-up for a successful closing of the sale.
* Build market awareness through networking, presentations, event attendance, and industry associations.
* Partner with operations personnel to execute growth, development, sales, and marketing strategies.
* Achieve agreed upon sales targets and outcomes within schedule.


Qualifications:
* Associate degree or equivalent experience required; Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or engineering preferred.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of demonstrated successful sales in the security integration industry, general construction, or electrical construction industry.
* Comprehensive industry knowledge of security integration solutions and/or other related low voltage systems.
* Ability to quickly identify and qualify opportunities, as well as handle complex, large\-scale accounts and high\-value contracts.
* Experience working with electrical contractors, general contractors, consultants, engineers or end users, with the ability to read construction blueprints and wiring diagrams.
* High degree of self\-discipline and ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced corporate environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, using tact and diplomacy when dealing with customers.
* Must be reliable, self\-motivated, success\-driven, with excellent organizational, negotiating and follow\-up skills.
* Proficiency in industry\-related equipment including Windows, MS Office, and customer relationship management (CRM) software.
* Applicants must meet requirements in relation to background, have a valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.
* Regular, reliable, predictable attendance.

***\*\*compensation range includes potential commissions earned on sales\*\****  

HCI Systems Inc. is a licensed C\-7, C\-10 and C\-16 low voltage systems integration contractor offering a full spectrum of services including sales, engineering, installation, service, and maintenance with over 600 employees in our seven branches. We offer fire life safety, fire suppression, fire sprinkler, access control, video management, intrusion detection, structured cable, nurse call and other related electronic detection solutions to our customers. **Why Join Us?*** **Unlimited Growth** – Our expanding product lines and markets drive consistent double\-digit growth, creating ongoing opportunities for advancement.
* **Comprehensive Benefits** – Enjoy 401(k) with matching, reduced\-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible spending accounts. Additional voluntary benefits include life insurance, disability, and accident coverage.
* **Paid Time Off** – Recharge with paid holidays and our PTO plan
* **Weekly Pay** – Get paid every Friday.
* **Employee Perks** – From appreciation events and department outings to wellness programs and pet insurance, we invest in our team’s well\-being.

**E*****qual Employment Opportunity****HCI is an equal opportunity employer. We will not unlawfully discriminate against qualified applicants or employees with respect to any terms and conditions of employment and give equal opportunity considerations to applicants and employees regardless of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, related medical conditions and lactation), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, disability, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances (“Protected Classifications”). HCI will reasonably accommodate employees and applicants with disabilities as required by law, if the person is otherwise qualified to perform all the essential functions of the position safely and competently.*
Pay Range: USD $60,000\.00 \- USD $300,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Billing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Briviant Inc.** is a growing technology company dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experiences through innovative technology and operational excellence. We are seeking a **Billing Operations Specialist** to join our Billing team and play a key role in supporting our subscription billing operations, customer accounts, and revenue integrity.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving customer problems, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, and takes pride in delivering accurate, timely billing support. You'll work closely with customers and cross\-functional teams to ensure billing processes run smoothly while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency through process enhancements and AI\-powered tools.

**Position Summary**

As a Billing Operations Specialist, you will own the day\-to\-day execution of billing, collections, and account management activities. You will serve as a trusted resource for customers and internal teams by resolving billing inquiries, processing account changes, and ensuring the accuracy of financial transactions.

Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong customer service skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy. You'll also be encouraged to identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve the customer experience.

**Responsibilities**

**Billing Operations**

* Manage daily billing operations for subscription and customer accounts.
* Process new subscriptions, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, refunds, credits, and billing adjustments.
* Ensure invoices, payments, and account records are accurate and up to date.
* Reconcile billing discrepancies and proactively resolve account issues.
* Support month\-end billing activities and revenue\-related operational tasks.

**Customer Experience**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer billing inquiries and account\-related questions.
* Resolve billing concerns professionally and efficiently while providing an exceptional customer experience.
* Communicate clearly with customers regarding invoices, payment options, subscription changes, and account status.
* Maintain ownership of customer issues through resolution, coordinating with internal teams as needed.

**Support Operations**

* Manage billing\-related support tickets and ensure timely responses and resolutions.
* Prioritize work effectively while meeting service level expectations.
* Identify recurring customer issues and recommend process improvements.

**Fraud, Payments \& Account Integrity**

* Review payment exceptions, chargebacks, disputes, and refund requests.
* Assist with fraud prevention efforts by identifying unusual account activity.
* Maintain accurate documentation related to payment investigations and account actions.

**Process Improvement**

* Continuously evaluate billing workflows to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* Identify repetitive tasks that can be streamlined through process improvements or AI\-assisted tools.
* Create and maintain documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles.
* Partner with Customer Support, Finance, Engineering, and Operations teams to improve billing processes and customer experience.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2–3 years of experience in billing operations, customer support, customer success, finance operations, accounts receivable, or a related operational role.
* Experience supporting customers in a subscription, SaaS, technology, telecommunications, or service\-based business.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong customer service and conflict resolution abilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy.
* Experience working within ticketing or customer support platforms.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

**Preferred**

* Experience with subscription billing platforms such as Recurly, Stripe Billing, or similar systems.
* Experience using payment gateways.
* Experience with Freshdesk or similar support platforms.
* Experience using AI productivity tools to improve workflows and customer communications.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets and reporting tools to analyze billing data and identify trends.

Pay: $28\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Irvine, CA 92614

---------------

  

  

  

Appointment to this position is expected to be at or below the midpoint **$91,810\.2855** of the salary range, however, the final amount will be carefully determined based on the candidate's knowledge, skills, qualifications, and an evaluation of internal equity within the organization.  

The Long Beach Airport Department currently has one (1\) opening available for an Executive Assistant in the Administration Division. **THE COMMUNITY**  

Ideally located on the Pacific Ocean south of Los Angeles, adjacent to Orange County, the City of Long Beach, California (population 470,000\) is frequently described as a series of strong, diverse interwoven smaller communities within a large city. Enjoying an ideal Southern California climate, Long Beach is home to an abundance of cultural and recreational options. The Long Beach Convention Center, Aquarium of the Pacific, Queen Mary, and the annual Acura Grand Prix of Long Beach, plus a wide variety of other attractions (two historic ranchos, three marinas, and five golf courses), serve to draw 6\.5 million visitors a year. The City is also home to California State University, Long Beach, and Long Beach City College. Cal State Long Beach is the second largest university in the state and was recently ranked the No. 3 best–value public college in the nation. Covering approximately 50 square miles, Long Beach is supported by a wide mix of industries with education, health and social services, manufacturing, retail trade, and professional services comprising the highest representation. Known for its livable and desirable neighborhoods, Long Beach was named by America’s Promise Alliance as one of the 100 Best Communities for Young People two years in a row. While it offers all the amenities of a large metropolis, many say Long Beach offers the added benefit of having maintained a strong sense of community and cohesiveness despite its growth. A superb climate, quality schools, a vibrant downtown, and a wide variety of neighborhoods help make Long Beach one of the most livable communities in the country. **CITY GOVERNMENT**  

Long Beach operates as a charter city governed by an elected Mayor and nine City Council members elected by district. The City Manager, appointed by the Mayor and City Council, oversees the daily operations of 15 departments and a proposed FY26 citywide annual budget of $3\.7B. The City employs over 6,000 full\-time and part\-time staff; dedicated to providing exceptional public services with the vast majority being represented by eleven employee associations.* **City Departments**
* **Proposed FY26 Budget**
* **2030 Strategic Vision**
* **Elevate '28 Infrastructure Investment Plan**

The City of Long Beach fosters an environment where every employee is celebrated for their individuality and unique talents they bring to their role. Reflecting the diversity of the community within the workforce is a key priority embraced at every level of the organization—from management to policy creation. City Leadership actively promotes equity and inclusion by partnering with staff and community stakeholders to advance fairness in all initiatives. Transparency remains a cornerstone of these efforts with demographic data, including workforce diversity and pay equity by race and gender, shared publicly to ensure accountability and progress. **THE DEPARTMENT**  

Recognized as America's Coolest Airport, LGB offers a unique blend of convenience, efficiency, and a relaxed atmosphere that sets it apart from larger, busier airports. Passengers appreciate shorter lines, quicker security checks, and easy access to gates, making travel less stressful and more enioyable. Central to the Los Angeles and Orange County areas, with an unparalleled passenger experience, LGB provides leisure travelers with the perfect gateway to Southern California's attractions while providing valuable time savings to business travelers. In a recent ranking by *The Washington Post,* LGB was recognized as the second\-best airport in the United States, based on factors such as accessibility, ease of navigation, architectural appeal, amenities, and unique features.  

Long Beach Airport (LGB) is classified as a small hub airport in the National Plan of Integrated Airport Systems and serves approximately four million passengers annually. Owned and operated by the City of Long Beach, LGB was established in 1923 and is one of the oldest municipal airports in the United States. Known as the Coolest Airport in America, LGB is a friendly alternative to other Southern California airports, offering preferred flight schedules, great airlines and destinations and overall accessibility.  

The Airport is committed to delivering an Outstanding Customer Experience in an intelligent. ecofriendly, safe, and efficient manner while being respectful of our employees and the community that we serve. We also strive to be a major driver in the economic vitality of Long Beach. Through Organizational Excellence, we seek to recruit, develop, and retain talented staff in an organization structured for success.  

Long Beach Airport has a rich history of contributions to our nation's leadership in aviation. Earl Daugherty opened one of the nation's first flight schools in Long Beach in 1919\. Charles Lindbergh and Amelia Earhart flew from Long Beach. Once home to McDonnell Douglas (now Boeing), many commercial aircraft including the DC\-8, DC\-9/MD\-80, DC\-10/MD\-11, and military aircraft such as the C\-17 were manufactured in Long Beach. Approximately 180 businesses reside on Airport property and are responsible for roughly 18,000 jobs. Some of these include AAA. Aero Business Center, Atlantic Aviation, Long Beach Marriott Hotel, DeVry Institute of Technology, DHL, Epson America, SCAN Health Plan, Signature @ Aeroplex, Skylinks Golf Course, and United Parcel Service.
