jobs.description:
Description:
**WHO WE ARE**  

AVI\-SPL is a digital enablement solutions provider who transforms how people and technology connect to elevate experiences, create new value, and enable organizations to thrive and grow. We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award\-winning managed services.  

Our highly certified industry experts and innovation leaders share a vision to help people work smarter and live better. We believe that success starts with a sound team and that an inclusive and diverse workplace moves us all forward. **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

  

As an Associate Project Manager, you will assist Project Management resources with key project activities including communication, change management, timely and on\-budget completion of project deliverables while meeting client scope and quality requirements. All work will follow established AVI\-SPL Project Management principles and procedures. AVI\-SPL will help you acquire/develop skills over time to manage smaller complexity projects with the ultimate goal to progress into the Project Manager position.

  

Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities:

* Learn and comply with all AVI\-SPL standard process and procedures within the AVI\-SPL Operations Playbook, utilizing tools approved and provided by AVI\-SPL.
* Review and acquire a thorough knowledge of contract documents for each assigned project including, but not limited to project scopes of work, bid drawings and specifications, contract, subcontractor scopes of work, and construction schedules.
* Manage project team resource tasks and milestone activity.
* Facilitate discovery and documentation during internal project kick\-off meetings as needed
* Participate in external project kick\-off meetings with all necessary external stakeholders as well as applicable internal resources as required.
* Manage internal and external project communication and documentation through accurate files and records of project status and activities.
* Respond to communications from customers regarding problems or concerns in a timely and professional manner as directed.
* Compile job progress reports. Raise any issues to Project/Office Management for proper escalation.
* Review daily site progress reports from lead technicians and respond to needs identified.
* Assist in the management of equipment requests, distribution and shipping through pick ticketing, packing slip and sign off process requirements.
* Assist Management through the change order process through assurance that any scope, schedule, cost or change of terms are handled in accordance with AVI\-SPL change order procedures.
* Deliver quality analysis report of internal resources and subcontractors.
* Ensure all closeout/as\-built documentation is created and stored in proper location for service and/or future office reference.
* Develop and maintain strong relationship with customers with direct interaction with focus on improving customers’ perception of on time delivery, quality, responsiveness, problem solving and service.
* Achieve project results per customer requirements to obtain AVI\-SPL Net Promoter Score goals

 **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

 **Must Haves:**

* Demonstrated experience in an assistant Project Manager or Project Coordination role fulfilling the responsibilities listed in this job description.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel) and PDF software.
* Ability to manage tasks and resources to meet project objectives.
* Energized self\-starter characteristics and ability to work independently.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.

jobs.description:
**At Swoop, our mission is simple:** Improving patient outcomes. As a market leader in AI\-driven, data\-powered, and privacy\-compliant healthcare engagement, we connect the signals that drive earlier diagnosis, better treatment decisions, and sustained adherence.
  
  

Our integrated, privacy\-safe platform, enables life sciences companies to drive measurable patient and commercial outcomes with actionable intelligence — spanning patient and HCP audience targeting, community engagement, AI\-powered web solutions, coordinated omnichannel activation, and prescription fulfillment.
  
  

We believe our people are our greatest asset. Swoop fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, providing employees with rich opportunities for professional growth. This commitment to our team earned us the "Best Places to Work" recognition from Business Intelligence Group in 2025 and 2026\. We are driven by a patient\-first philosophy and passionate about leveraging technology to create a healthier future.
  
  

After becoming an independent company in 2024, Swoop experienced significant growth and demonstrated an unwavering commitment to innovation, talent development, and enhancing the patient experience. Our acquisition of MyHealthTeam in January 2025 and Nimble in May 2026 helped us further bridging the gap between healthcare brands and patients for more impactful and targeted engagement. Empowering millions of patients nationwide to connect, share resources, and access medically verified information to better manage their health. MyHealthTeam hosts the largest and most engaged patient social networks in healthcare, offering more than 70 condition\-specific communities for chronic and rare conditions. As a prescription fulfillment and patient engagement platform, Nimble empowers independent and regional pharmacies to deliver a modern, consumer\-friendly healthcare experience while streamlining pharmacy operations.
  
  

If you're a driven professional seeking to make a real difference in healthcare marketing at a fast\-growing, innovative company, join Swoop and help us revolutionize how brands connect with patients and HCPs.
  
  

About the role
  
  

NimbleRx is looking for a motivated and ambitious Sales Development Representative from the tech/healthcare space to join our growing Sales Team. As an SDR, you will be the first point of contact for potential pharmacy partners and play a crucial role in driving our sales pipeline.
  
  

In this role, you will be responsible for scheduling appointments for our Account Executives to demo our product for local and regional pharmacy groups. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with an ability to adapt quickly and a team player with a passion for making an impact and building a career in a SaaS sales role!
  
  

What you'll do
  
  

Drive strategic outreach (cold calling, email campaigns, etc.) to large pharmacy groups to determine decision\-makers within target pharmacies.
  
Employ effective selling techniques including research, building rapport, productive questions, and issue identification.
  
Build relationships with pharmacy owners/decision\-makers to establish trust and confidence in NimbleRx's exciting tech\-driven product.
  
Schedule product demos for Account Executives and ensure prospects are prepared and engaged for the next steps in the sales process.
  
Work closely with the Sales and Marketing teams to align messaging, strategies, and goals for optimal outreach.
  
Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, track progress, and update lead statuses in our CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system, Salesforce.
  
Develop strategic account and opportunity insights by analyzing previously closed opportunities, historical conversation notes, and customer feedback to identify patterns, barriers, and high\-potential paths to engagement.
  
Lead thoughtful, research\-driven prospecting by incorporating pharmacy\-specific insights, including public reviews and customer sentiment, into personalized outreach and precall strategies.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

1 or more years of tech sales experience
  
Experience in the tech/healthcare space
  
A passion for working directly with customers and making an impact
  
A positive attitude and an ability to work in a fast\-paced, constantly evolving environment
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  
  

This role offers a base salary plus uncapped commission.

Graduate Program Coordinator, Biosciences (5156C) \#88591 About Berkeley
  
  

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.

We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.

Departmental Overview
  
  

The Departments of Molecular and Cell Biology (MCB), Integrative Biology (IB), and Neuroscience (NEU) are among the largest academic departments at UC Berkeley. Financial resources include approximately $90M in annual extramural funding (which accounts for over half of the total sponsored research awards in the College of Letters \& Science) and over $91M other fund sources. Department personnel are currently housed in eight buildings located in three widely separated parts of the campus.

Organizes two in\-person recruitment weekends for approximately 100\-130 individuals (applicants generally participate in 2 groups of 50\-65 individuals in January/February).

Responsible for establishing contracts with local hotels for accommodation blocks. Plans and manages all group events, including seminars, panel discussions, catered meals, and faculty dinners. Negotiates any necessary service provider contracts. Provides on\-site management for all recruitment events. Maintains computer databases of all pertinent correspondence, schedules, and costs.
  
Compiles and rewrites, as necessary, all departmental information for visitors' packets.
  
Supports the department's extensive efforts to recruit students from historically underrepresented populations to the graduate program.
  
  

Commencement

jobs.description:
**About depthfirst**
--------------------


We believe that software is the foundation of modern civilization. Yet vulnerabilities threaten its integrity, security, and resilience. We are on a mission to secure the world's software.


depthfirst is building intelligence to detect and remediate critical software vulnerabilities. We are training and scaling security AI agents to discover zero\-day vulnerabilities across large customer codebases and popular open source software.


Our founding team brings deep expertise in data, infrastructure, security and AI, with leaders from DeepMind, Databricks, Square, and Faire. We're looking for thoughtful, driven people excited to work at the intersection of AI, Security, and Infrastructure.

We're looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to help us deliver an exceptional candidate experience and build the operational foundation that allows our team to hire quickly without compromising on quality.


You'll work closely with our recruiting team, hiring managers, and leaders across the company to coordinate interviews, manage candidate communication, and keep our hiring processes moving. As one of the first members of our growing recruiting team, you'll also have the opportunity to improve how we operate, take on increasing ownership, and get exposure to the full recruiting lifecycle.

* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage many moving pieces simultaneously

* Highly proactive and resourceful, you anticipate what needs to happen next rather than waiting to be asked
* Strong sense of urgency and ability to move quickly without sacrificing quality
* Comfortable working with senior leaders and managing frequently changing schedules and priorities

jobs.title: Events & Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Build AI**
------------------


Build AI is the data hyperscaler for Physical AI. We're vertically integrated across hardware, manufacturing, logistics, collection, and model training to scale the physical labor dataset orders of magnitude faster than anyone in the world.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for our first Events \& Field Marketing Manager to build Build's events function from scratch.


You'll own how Build shows up in the world: the conferences we sponsor, the events we host around them, and the standalone experiences we create for customers, prospects, candidates, and the broader physical AI community.


This is a strategy **and** execution role. You'll decide where Build should invest, develop creative ways to stand out, and personally make the details happen. One week that might mean planning Build's presence at NeurIPS or CoRL; the next it could mean putting together an intimate dinner for AI researchers, a recruiting event in San Francisco, or an event format we haven't tried before.


You'll have significant autonomy, budget, and responsibility for representing Build externally.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build and own Build's events calendar and strategy from scratch.
* Own Build's presence at major AI and robotics conferences, including sponsorships, attendance, activations, and related events.
* Create and execute standalone events for customers, prospects, candidates, and the AI and robotics community \- including events ranging from executive dinners and small gatherings to recruiting events, conferences, launches, and larger experiences.
* Identify which conferences and events Build should invest in based on customer, recruiting, and brand impact.
* Develop creative concepts that make Build memorable and differentiated rather than simply showing up with a booth.
* Own events end\-to\-end: concept, venue, vendors, contracts, budgets, guest lists, invitations, logistics, onsite execution, and follow\-up.
* Measure what works and turn successful experiments into repeatable programs.
* Build the systems and operating processes required to scale the function as Build grows.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You**
--------------------------------

* Have **2\+ years of experience** in events, field marketing, experiential marketing, or a related role.
* Have personally owned conferences, sponsored events, dinners, or other in\-person experiences from concept through execution.
* Are exceptionally organized and detail oriented. You can run several complex projects simultaneously without dropping things.
* Have high agency. When something needs to happen, your instinct is to figure out how to make it happen rather than wait for instructions.
* Are creative and have strong taste. You care about creating experiences people actually remember.
* Are scrappy. You're equally comfortable negotiating a major sponsorship and fixing a last\-minute problem yourself five minutes before an event starts.
* Exercise excellent judgment and can represent Build confidently with customers, researchers, candidates, executives, and partners.
* Thrive in ambiguity and like building things from zero rather than inheriting established processes.
* Are willing to travel regularly for conferences and events.

**Even Better If**
------------------

* You've worked at a fast\-growing startup and know what it means to operate without much infrastructure.
* You have experience in AI, technology, robotics, or another technical industry.
* You've built an events or field marketing program rather than only executing an existing playbook.
* You've found unconventional ways to create memorable events without simply spending more money.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Build becomes one of the companies people consistently notice at the most important AI and robotics gatherings.


Our customers and prospects want to attend our events. Great candidates encounter Build through experiences that make them want to join. Our conference investments produce real relationships and opportunities. And behind the scenes, the entire program runs with exceptional operational discipline.


You turn events into a competitive advantage for Build to scale recruiting, brand, and customer acquisition.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive pay
* Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
* $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits
* Housing subsidy of $2k per month for those living within walking distance of the office
* Relocation support for those moving to San Francisco (Financial District) or Shenzhen (Nanshan)
* Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more
* Daily lunch and dinner in our office
* Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification
* Unlimited Codex and Claude credits
* Travel

**How we're different**
-----------------------


Build believes in the Bitter Lesson. By taking a general approach of learning from humans, our addressable market is all physical labor.


We are a fully in\-person team in San Francisco (Financial District) and Shenzhen (Nanshan), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.


Build AI is an equal opportunity employer. We review every application. If you do not meet every bullet, still apply. Questions: research@build.ai


Compensation Range: $130K \- $180K

jobs.description:
**Territory Account Manager** **– Public Sector (SLED) Focused**


**FLSA STATUS: Exempt**


**Location: Livermore, CA**

  


**WHO WE ARE:**



MGT is a leading provider of technology and advisory solutions serving state, local, and education government agencies (SLED) across the United States. Through client partnerships, MGT’s almost 1,200 employees impact communities for good by managing and securing critical networks, solving complex human capital and fiscal problems, elevating education systems, and advancing equity as a performance imperative. MGT partners with thousands of agencies as a trusted advisor delivering solutions that improve technology, operational, and economic performance to help communities thrive.



Founded in 1975, MGT initiated an ambitious restart in 2016, broadening the solutions portfolio to provide the most specialized solutions, tackling the most mission\-critical problems that live at the top of the public agency leadership agenda. MGT drives over 20% compound annual organic growth and utilizes programmatic mergers and acquisitions to grow capabilities, attract top talent, and accelerate growth scale. Since 2020, MGT has successfully completed 13 acquisitions, driving over 60% compound annual inorganic growth.



Celebrating its 50th year in 2025, the firm attracts exceptional talent and empowers them to exceed client expectations as they navigate the dynamic demands of the clients we serve. Hear more about MGT’s culture in the words of ouremployees (https://www.mgt.us/careers/).

  


**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**



A Territory Account Manager is a hunter\-focused sales role designed to accelerate growth across an assigned geographic territory by identifying, developing, and winning new business within the State, Local Government, and Education (SLED) market. This position is thrives on prospecting, building relationships from the ground up, and creating opportunities within largely untapped ("white space") accounts. The Territory Account Manager is responsible for executing strategic business development initiatives, establishing trusted relationships with technology and business decision\-makers, and positioning MGT as a preferred technology advisor.



The position opens doors, builds executive relationships, uncovers customer challenges, and partners with technical resources to deliver innovative technology solutions. Success in this role is measured by pipeline generation, new customer acquisition, revenue growth, forecast accuracy, and long\-term customer development.


* Develop and execute a strategic territory business plan focused on expanding MGT's presence within assigned SLED markets.
* Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities within white\-space accounts through outbound calling, email campaigns, networking, referrals, social selling, and partner engagement.
* Build relationships with executive leadership, IT leadership, procurement officials, and operational stakeholders throughout state agencies, local governments, K\-12 districts, higher education institutions, and special districts.
* Develop a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities by consistently executing prospecting and business development activities.
* Conduct virtual customer meetings, discovery sessions, presentations, and solution discussions while leveraging in\-person meetings for strategic opportunities.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects, Engineering, Sales Support, Renewals Support, Professional Services, and Managed Services teams to design and deliver comprehensive technology solutions.
* Develop account strategies that identify customer initiatives, funding opportunities, refresh cycles, and long\-term technology roadmaps.
* Build strong relationships with strategic technology partners, manufacturers, distributors, and channel account managers to jointly identify and pursue opportunities.
* Prepare customer presentations, proposals, quotations, statements of work, and executive business reviews.
* Maintain accurate opportunity, activity, forecasting, and pipeline information within Salesforce CRM.
* Achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales objectives, including pipeline generation, revenue, profitability, and new logo acquisition.
* Represent MGT at customer events, conferences, manufacturer events, and regional networking activities.

  


*ADA Notice: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

  


**WHAT YOU’LL BRING:**



Successful Territory Account Managers consistently:

The Enterprise Account Manager is an individual contributor responsible for the retention, expansion, and long\-term performance of Happen Bank's named national and enterprise Purchase Finance accounts. You will own the partner relationship from post\-sale handoff and launch through adoption, optimization, renewal, and growth.  

  

You will serve as a strategic advisor to executive and operational stakeholders, build account plans that connect partner priorities to measurable business outcomes, and coordinate cross\-functional execution across the full partner lifecycle. Success requires executive presence, analytical discipline, strong follow\-through, and the ability to resolve complex issues while protecting the customer experience and Happen Bank's business interests.**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own enterprise account strategy, retention, and growth**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Manage a portfolio of named national, multi\-location, and strategic enterprise accounts
* Develop account plans that define stakeholder relationships, business objectives, growth opportunities, risks, and action plans
* Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors, operators, finance leaders, technology teams, and frontline users
* Lead executive business reviews and regular operating reviews using clear performance insights and agreed actions
* Identify and advance opportunities for location expansion, product adoption, increased utilization, new use cases, and deeper strategic alignment

**Drive launch, adoption, and partner performance**
---------------------------------------------------

* Monitor applications, approvals, conversion, funded volume, product mix, active locations, utilization, portfolio health, and service performance
* Use performance data and partner feedback to recommend targeted actions that improve adoption and business results
* Ensure contractual commitments, pricing arrangements, rebates, reporting, and partner deliverables are tracked and fulfilled
* Maintain disciplined pipeline management, forecasting, and performance reporting using CRM, analytics, and AI\-enabled tools where appropriate

**Lead cross\-functional execution and issue resolution**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Partner with Product, Credit, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Marketing, Revenue Support, Technology, and Operations to deliver strong partner outcomes
* Serve as the primary commercial escalation point for complex partner issues and drive timely resolution with accountable owners
* Communicate product, credit, policy, process, and operational changes clearly to partner stakeholders
* Translate customer insights into recommendations that improve products, service models, enablement, and internal workflows
* Maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, forecasts, meeting notes, risks, and next steps

-------------

* Bachelor's degree or higher, or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Demonstrated success retaining and expanding strategic accounts while delivering measurable revenue, adoption, or utilization growth
* Strong executive relationship management skills with the ability to build credibility across business, financial, technical, and operational stakeholders
* Analytical and financially minded, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify drivers, and translate insights into action
* Experience leading complex implementations, escalations, and cross\-functional work without direct authority
* Strong commercial judgment with the ability to balance partner needs, contractual commitments, economics, risk, and customer experience
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong organization, and consistent follow\-through

* You actively look for ways AI can improve your work, from accelerating account analysis and preparation to approaching problems from different angles. You're thoughtful about accuracy, data sensitivity, and where human judgment and validation are needed

------------



**Grow with us!**  

HCI Systems, Inc. is seeking a results\-driven, enthusiastic sales professional to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will sell enterprise\-level integrated security solutions with a focus on new construction and build strong relationships with end\-users, electrical contractors and general contractors. You will have the opportunity to prospect and cultivate new relationships, gain an understanding of our clients' needs, and secure sales opportunities.  

**About Us:** HCI Systems, Inc. is a renowned leader in the fire life safety and low voltage industry, providing our clients with an end\-to\-end service offering that allows them to bundle all their needs under one provider.
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Drive business growth by prospecting and cultivating new relationships and identifying and educating prospective customers about HCI's products and services.
* Be responsible for identifying customer needs and developing strategies to meet company sales objectives.
* Lead the sales process from proposal development to closing, including crafting comprehensive scopes of work, managing project scope communication, and handling change order costs.
* Serve as the primary contact for clients, ensuring strong partnerships are established and maintained before, during, and after the sales process. Oversee all aspects of customer accounts, including managing active accounts and fostering sales growth.
* Collaborate with premier partners in vertical markets, such as transportation, global/enterprise accounts, utilities, financial/banking, healthcare, datacenters, federal, state, and local governments, and K\-12 \& higher education.

jobs.title: Community Manager (Fremont)
jobs.description:
**About ArtHaus Properties**### **The expanded ArtHaus Properties operating company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Arthaus Partners, purpose\-built to manage and scale our vertically integrated residential platform. This role offers a rare opportunity to help shape the future of operations at a company on the verge of doubling its footprint, bringing structure, innovation, and excellence to a portfolio with significant near\-term growth ahead. It’s an exciting moment to lead, build, and leave your mark.**

 **About the role**  

The Community Manager is responsible for the overall performance and financial success of the assigned community. This role leads the onsite team and ensures that leasing, maintenance, resident relations, and financial operations meet company standards. The Community Manager drives occupancy, revenue growth, resident satisfaction, and compliance with all ArtHaus policies and local regulations.


This role will be responsible for about 166 units.

 **Primary Responsibilities**### **Leadership and Team Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop the onsite team to deliver consistent, high\-quality performance.
* Conduct weekly staff meetings to align goals, review KPIs, and address challenges.
* Maintain engagement and retention, targeting voluntary turnover below 15% annually.
* Partner with Area and Regional leadership on recruiting, onboarding, and professional development.
* Use weekly dashboards and KPI tools to track accountability, celebrate wins, and identify early performance gaps.
* Ensure full utilization of ArtHaus’ digital and AI platforms for leasing, maintenance, and communication.

### **Operational Excellence**

* Oversee day\-to\-day community operations in compliance with company policies and Fair Housing laws.
* Conduct daily property inspections for curb appeal, cleanliness, safety, and compliance.
* Maintain average unit turn times of five business days or less.
* Ensure emergency work orders are responded to within 2 hours and non\-emergency within 48 hours; verify completion data in Yardi/EliseAI.
* Manage vendor performance and verify all work meets quality and budget standards.

### **Financial Management**

* Act as P\&L steward for the community with accountability for revenue, expenses, and asset performance.
* Oversee rent collection and enforce lease terms in line with company policy and local law.
* Keep delinquency below 2% of monthly rent roll.
* Prepare and manage the annual budget, maintaining variance within ±3%.
* Optimize revenue through occupancy management, renewals, and rent strategies.
* Review and submit accurate month\-end financial and operational reports.

### **Leasing and Marketing**

* Lead leasing operations to achieve and maintain occupancy of 95% or higher.
* Conduct market surveys and recommend pricing adjustments.
* Oversee marketing initiatives, outreach programs, and resident events to drive renewals and referrals.
* Maintain renewal rates of 70% or higher through proactive resident engagement.

### **Resident Experience and Compliance**

* Foster a culture of exceptional customer service and prompt issue resolution.
* Maintain resident satisfaction (NPS) of 70 or higher.
* Manage all resident communication professionally and document interactions properly.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with Fair Housing, safety, and all applicable regulations.

### **Reporting and Communication**

* Submit weekly performance summaries to Area or Portfolio Manager, covering occupancy, delinquency, renewals, and maintenance KPIs.
* Communicate operational issues, risks, and achievements to leadership promptly.
* Support corporate initiatives and contribute to process improvement efforts.

 **Qualifications*** High school diploma or equivalent required; college degree preferred.
* Minimum three years of property management experience with supervisory responsibility.
* Proven success meeting goals in occupancy, collections, and resident satisfaction.
* Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead with empathy and accountability in a fast\-paced, data\-driven environment.
* Proficiency in Yardi and EliseAI preferred.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation required.

**Work Environment*** Work performed both in office and on property grounds.
* May require evenings or weekends based on community needs.
* Frequent interaction with residents, vendors, and team members.

**Compensation and Benefits*** Company sponsored housing at the assigned property
* 401k with employer match
* Company phone
* Typical Base Pay Range: $70,720 \- $76,500 per year, included bonus program participation

jobs.title: Product Operations Specialist | Juno
jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================


You will build and run the operating systems that help Juno ship reliably and support customers as we scale. On the product operations side, you will turn product decisions into clear operating plans, maintain visibility in Linear, coordinate customer testing and launch readiness, keep commitments and risks visible, and make sure product changes are communicated clearly.


You will partner closely with product and engineering to make decisions executable, keep work organized, surface gaps and dependencies, and ensure the team follows through on what it has committed to ship.


On the customer support side, you will be the first line of defense when customers encounter product issues. You will triage and investigate problems, coordinate the right response, and redirect travel\-service questions to our travel partners. Because you sit close to both the product process and the customer, you will turn recurring friction into clear insights, accountable follow\-up, and better operating systems.


Success means Juno ships through a lightweight and dependable process, customers understand what changed, risks and commitments do not get lost, recurring issues reach the right owners, and support demand does not grow one\-for\-one with the business.

***\*Please note that this Product Operations role will require you to be comfortable with working in\-person at our NYC HQ (located near Madison Square Park) at least 2 days/week\****

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Provide holistic support through the entire launch lifecycle across program management, customer testing, launch readiness, change management, customer communication, and post\-launch iteration. Own and improve Juno's shipping process so the right reviews, testing, documentation, internal enablement, and customer updates happen at the right time.
* Maintain Linear as a reliable operating system for projects, owners, milestones, dependencies, status, and product decisions. Surface risks early and follow through until they are resolved.
* Serve as the first line of defense for product\-related customer issues across email and chat, join customer calls when needed, manage escalations to resolution, and route travel\-service questions to the right partner.
* Be the voice of the customer in product decisions. Analyze support trends and customer feedback, diagnose recurring friction, size the problems you find, and translate messy input into clear findings, recommended actions, prioritization input, and accountable follow\-up for product and engineering.
* Build AI\-powered workflows, automations, knowledge systems, and self\-service experiences that improve the quality and speed of product operations and customer support.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 3\+ years of experience in product operations, program management, customer experience, technical support, consulting, or another customer\-facing analytical role in a fast\-moving software company.
* You are highly process\-oriented. You can turn ambiguous cross\-functional work into clear owners, milestones, decisions, and next steps without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* You actively use AI to get real work done and can show us what you have automated, analyzed, or built.
* You can use qualitative feedback and data to identify patterns, diagnose root causes, size problems, and measure whether a product or operational fix reduced customer friction.
* You write with precision and empathy. You can explain a complicated product change or technical issue clearly, without jargon or filler.
* You run toward ownership, move quickly without losing the details, and can drive clarity across product, engineering, customer success, customers, and external partners.

**Nice\-to\-Haves**
-------------------

* Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, debugging, or data analysis, even if you do not write production code.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, travel, fintech, or another operationally complex product.

**Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home\-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra\-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------

* 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

**Canada**
----------

* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
* Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 40\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Automotive Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Club Sportiva**

Club Sportiva is Silicon Valley’s country club for car enthusiasts and an event center for all. We provide members with access to an extraordinary collection of performance and exotic vehicles, curated automotive events and experiences, Managed Car Services, and an exclusive 18,000\+ square\-foot event venue.

Our Managed Car Services help members enjoy their vehicles without having to personally coordinate maintenance, detailing, transportation, storage, and other ownership responsibilities.

We are seeking a hands\-on, mechanically inclined automotive professional to help care for our vehicle collection and deliver Managed Car Services to our members.

**Position Overview**

The Automotive Operations \& Managed Car Services Specialist supports the daily care, movement, maintenance, and presentation of Club Sportiva and member\-owned vehicles.

This is a hands\-on automotive position—not a desk\-only service\-advisor role. A typical day may include inspecting a vehicle, diagnosing a basic problem, performing minor maintenance, transporting a vehicle to a service provider, detailing it, and delivering it back to a member.

The right candidate does not need to be a master technician, but must have practical mechanical aptitude, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work safely around exotic, luxury, classic, and performance vehicles.

This person must also be professional and comfortable interacting with members, explaining basic vehicle needs, and recommending Club Sportiva services when appropriate.

Key ResponsibilitiesVehicle Maintenance and Readiness

* Inspect Club Sportiva and member\-owned vehicles and document their condition
* Perform vehicle\-readiness inspections before rentals, events, member use, or delivery
* Check fluids, tires, batteries, warning lights, fuel levels, and other routine vehicle items
* Perform basic maintenance and minor mechanical repairs within your experience and abilities
* Use basic diagnostic equipment to identify common vehicle issues
* Recognize when a vehicle requires evaluation by a dealership or specialized repair facility
* Assist with battery replacement and charging, tire changes, fluid services, and installation of minor components
* Track maintenance needs, service appointments, and vehicle status
* Keep vehicles fueled or charged, clean, organized, and ready for use

**Managed Car Services**

* Assist with services for members’ personally owned vehicles
* Help members coordinate maintenance, detailing, transportation, storage, and vehicle preparation
* Listen to member needs and recommend relevant Club Sportiva services
* Prepare basic service documentation, vehicle\-condition reports, and status updates
* Communicate professionally with members regarding vehicle pickups, deliveries, and service progress
* Follow each assigned service request through completion
* Identify additional maintenance, detailing, or transportation needs and bring them to the attention of the department lead
* Help deliver a convenient, trustworthy, and high\-quality ownership experience

**Vehicle Transportation and Logistics**

* Safely pick up and deliver vehicles for members and Club Sportiva
* Transport vehicles between the club, member residences, dealerships, repair facilities, detailers, storage locations, and events
* Assist with loading, securing, transporting, and unloading vehicles using a truck and trailer
* Follow proper procedures when handling low\-clearance, high\-value, manual\-transmission, and performance vehicles
* Maintain accurate vehicle condition, mileage, key, and transportation records
* Inspect and maintain trailers, tie\-downs, tools, and transportation equipment
* Coordinate vehicle movements with team members, members, and outside vendors

**Detailing and Vehicle Presentation**

* Wash, clean, detail, and prepare vehicles to luxury presentation standards
* Perform interior cleaning, exterior detailing, wheel cleaning, glass cleaning, and basic paint care
* Inspect vehicles after detailing and correct presentation issues
* Help maintain detailing equipment, products, supplies, and work areas
* Stage vehicles for member use, photography, events, and showroom display
* Ensure vehicles are returned to members clean, organized, and professionally presented

**Member and Facility Support**

* Provide friendly, responsive, and professional service to members and guests
* Treat member vehicles and personal property with discretion and care
* Maintain clean and organized automotive work, detailing, and vehicle\-storage areas
* Support member drives, automotive experiences, partner activations, and special events
* Assist with vehicle displays, event setup, operations, and breakdown as needed
* Help maintain Club Sportiva’s overall facility and presentation standards

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.


Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.


Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.


We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description**  

The purpose of this position is to lead individual, multi\-disciplined real estate project solutions for clients, with direct accountability for project delivery.  

  

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Manages all facets of project management (budget, schedule, procurement, quality \& risk) for individual real estate projects including planning, design, construction, occupancy and closeout.

* Identifies project delivery resources from pre\-qualified lists; Conducts simple request for proposals; completes bid analysis with management support. Recommends resources to clients.
* Leads project delivery resources/team (typically smaller team) providing project guidance and direction to achieve project goals.
* Implements communication plan for meetings and written reports/meeting minutes to keep client and project resources informed. Facilitates project meetings.
* Implements project documentation governance aligned with company and client requirements. Ensures project data integrity and documentation is accurate, timely and coordinated.
* Tracks progress of each project against goals, objectives, approved budgets, approved timelines. Reports status and variances. Creates action plans to meet objectives, budget and schedule.
* Implements change management routines to assess change requests, make recommendations, secure Client approvals, and issue change orders. Assesses change requests to determine impacts to scope, budget, schedule, quality and risk with management support.

* PMP (US and/or Canada) and LEED AP preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational and analytical skills. Ability to provide efficient, timely, reliable and courteous service to customers. Ability to effectively present information.

* Ability to understand and carry out general instructions in standard situations. Ability to solve problems in standard situations. Requires intermediate analytical and quantitative skills.

**SUMMARY**

The Digital Marketing Strategist is an individual contributor responsible for designing, executing, and optimizing multi\-channel campaigns that work seamlessly across digital and offline touchpoints. This role turns business goals into cohesive, full\-funnel strategies that connect paid, owned, and earned media to drive awareness, engagement, and conversion. This position contributes to website, digital marketing (including SEO), and social media efforts. This individual will work with the SVP of Marketing to proactively identify areas for campaign optimization. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

We introduce Workday's solutions to businesses and offer them new paths to operational efficiency and growth. We count on every team member to make that happen!
  

  

We are a collaborative community built on teamwork and forward thinking. We surround ourselves with industry experts and innovators, and we invest in each other's growth. We prioritize both personal and professional development because we believe that when our people grow, our team grows.
**About the Role**

As a Sales Development Representative, you will join our team in deploying various prospecting approaches across target accounts, partnering with our Account Executives to build quality opportunities for the Workday sales team. Your key role is to connect with potential customers and share our value messaging while also discovering the needs of the prospect and their organization.


Together, we generate a quality pipeline through a combination of email, phone calls, marketing qualified leads, social selling, and face\-to\-face events. We identify qualified potential buyers and develop the relationship between the account and our broader Workday team.


**In this role, you will be responsible for:**

* Deploying multi\-channel prospecting strategies across target accounts, including phone, email, social selling, and in\-person events
* Partnering with our Account Executives to build and advance quality opportunities for Workday field sales
* Contacting potential customers and sharing our value messaging while uncovering prospects' needs and organizational challenges
* Identifying and qualifying potential buyers to help us generate a healthy and growing pipeline
* Nurturing and developing relationships between prospective accounts and our Workday team
* Responding to and qualifying marketing qualified leads in a timely and effective manner
* Diligent to detail with a focus on staying organized while managing multiple prospecting activities and accounts simultaneously

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications**

* 1\+ year of professional or industry\-related experience with a Bachelor's degree; OR 2\+ years of equivalent work experience where a degree is not present
* Experience in prospecting, inside sales, business development, high\-technology environments, marketing, direct sales, or IT consulting
* Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce.com, Clari Groove, and ZoomInfo
* Effective verbal and written communication skills

**Other Qualifications**

* **Building Pipeline:** Ability to identify potential leads, nurture them through early\-stage engagement, and develop a consistent and growing pipeline through outreach activities.
* **Relationship Building:** Ability to establish meaningful connections with prospects and internal team members through empathy, effective communication, and trust.
* **Business Acumen:** Willingness to learn and understand customer environments, market trends, and organizational landscapes to position Workday effectively in prospecting conversations.
* **Value Propositions:** Ability to identify and articulate the unique value of our solutions in a way that resonates with different audiences and addresses customer needs.
* **Credibility:** Ability to build confidence with prospects and partners through consistency, integrity, and a commitment to continuously developing your knowledge.
* **Other Qualifications**

jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.


Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.


We're looking for a Research Coordinator to join our Research Operations team in San Francisco, with a dedicated focus on hardware research programs. Our Research Operations team designs and executes the human research studies that power Oura's next\-generation sensor development and scientific innovation, and bolster our scientific credibility. This role supports early\-stage exploration of novel device and sensor form factors, helping validate new hardware concepts and enhance the accuracy of our algorithms. In this role, you'll support and execute human research studies across the project lifecycle, from study initiation and trial monitoring to data collection and quality review.


### **What you will do:**


* Support up to 3 hardware\-focused human subjects research studies in parallel, under the guidance of Research Project Managers, Algorithm Scientists, and Research Scientists

* Collaborate closely with a range of technical and non\-technical teams to maintain high\-quality study rigor and documentation

* Have 1\+ years of experience in human subjects research in academic, commercial, or clinical settings

* Can troubleshoot tech, research, and data challenges during live sessions
* Have a foundational understanding of and commitment to human subjects research ethics, Good Clinical Practice, and protecting participant and product privacy/confidentiality
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and a track record of well\-documented, high\-quality data collection
* Are based in San Francisco and available for regular onsite work at least three days per week

* Working with early\-stage or prototype hardware in a research setting

Under the direction of an assigned supervisor, assist in the care and supervision of infants, preschool and school\-age children at an assigned childcare center or other learning environment; assist with planning and implementing a variety of activities to meet the needs and interests of the children; perform a variety of clerical support duties.

Classroom procedures and appropriate student conduct.


Operation of standard office and classroom equipment.


Oral and written communication skills.


Interpersonal skills using tact, patience and courtesy.


Basic record\-keeping techniques.

jobs.title: Clinic Operations Assistant (COA)
jobs.description:
**Clinic Operations Assistant (COA) \- Pleasanton**

  

**DESCRIPTION OF JOB RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES**

  

**Position Summary**



The Clinic Operations Assistant (COA) provides operational and administrative support to ensure the efficient daily functioning of the clinic. The COA serves as the primary administrative contact for clients, clinicians, and program staff and is responsible for coordinating front office operations, scheduling support, record management, and administrative processes that support clinical service delivery.



COAs work collaboratively with clinicians and supervisors to maintain organized clinic operations while ensuring a welcoming, professional, and efficient environment for clients and staff.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**


* At least three years of administrative support, front\-office, or office operations experience; healthcare, behavioral health, or medical\-office experience preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with scheduling, client reception, records management, data entry, and confidential information.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, scheduling systems, and electronic health record or insurance\-eligibility systems.
* Strong organizational, communication, customer\-service, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced clinic environment.
* Ability to maintain a regular, full\-time onsite Monday\-Friday schedule, with occasional evening work as needed.
* Ability to complete required background clearances, health screening, and TB testing, consistent with organizational policy.
  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Associate degree in business administration, healthcare administration, health information, or a related field.
* Experience in a behavioral health, healthcare, or medical\-office setting.
* Experience with insurance eligibility verification, authorizations, encounter reporting, or billing support.
* Experience using InSync or another electronic health record system.
* Valid California driver’s license and current auto insurance, if regular travel between sites is required.
  


**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1\. Client Scheduling and Appointment Coordination**



The COA supports clinicians by coordinating and managing appointment scheduling for outpatient services.



Responsibilities include:


* Scheduling client appointments in the clinic scheduling system based on clinician availability and treatment plans.
* Coordinating appointment times between clients and clinicians.
* Managing appointment changes, cancellations, and rescheduling requests.
* Monitoring clinician schedules for openings or conflicts.
* Communicating scheduling updates to clinicians and clients as needed.
* Maintaining accurate scheduling records through Insync database.
* Supporting client reminders and follow\-up communication when appropriate.


**Clinical decisions regarding treatment frequency, session length, and scheduling availability remain the responsibility of the clinician.**

  

**2\. Front Desk and Client Reception**


* Greet clients in a warm, professional manner upon arrival.
* COA electronically checks clients in and notify clinicians when their client has arrived.
* Provide general information regarding services offered by the clinic.
* Assist visitors and ensure visitor forms are completed.
* Maintain a welcoming, organized reception and waiting area.
  


**3\. Medical Records and Documentation Support**


* Organize and maintain client medical records according to agency policy.
* Prepare and process medical record requests.
* Ensure required forms and consents are completed and filed appropriately.
* Maintain filing systems for active and closed records.
* Assist with locating records when needed.
  


**4\. Data Entry, Reporting, and Administrative Support**


* Enter data into agency databases and state or county systems as required.
* Maintain referral logs and documentation.
* Assist with program reporting and administrative data tracking.
* Support clinicians, psychiatry, and supervisors with routine administrative tasks.
  


**5\. Billing and Insurance Support**


* Verify client insurance eligibility.
* Assist with service authorizations when required.
* Prepare encounter lists report.
  


**6\. Clinic Operations and Office Management**


* Ensure the clinic is opened and closed according to business hours.
* Maintain office organization, cleanliness, and supply levels.
* Order and store office supplies.
* Maintain shared spaces such as waiting rooms, kitchens, and meeting rooms.
* Support clinic activities, ex., birthday celebrations.
* Ensure office equipment is functioning and coordinate service requests when needed.
  


**7\. Communication and Team Support**


* Maintain communication between clinicians, clients, and administrative staff.
* Support coordination across clinic programs, ex., FSP, CIOS, and Med Management.
* Participate in staff meetings and organizational events.
* Provide coverage or administrative support at other clinic locations if needed.
  


**8\. Safety and Emergency Coordination**


* Serve as a point person for office emergencies (e.g., fire, earthquake, power outage).
* Maintain awareness of safety procedures.
* Ensure health and safety supplies are available to staff and clients.

  

  

**Personal Attributes:**


* Demonstrates Creativity, Flexibility and Openness
* Demonstrates High Professionalism
* Strong Organizational Skills
* Effective Interpersonal Skills, verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to Maintain Confidentiality
* Detail oriented.
* Works independently.
* Experienced in close collaboration with other administrative professionals
* Adept at working with both internal and external cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to work in fast\-paced and ever changing environments
* Ability to coordinate project details and project coordination skills
* Excellent conflict management resolution and problem\-s

jobs.description:
Executive Assistant to the Dean (4702C), Berkeley Law \#88585 About Berkeley
  
  

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  

Departmental Overview
  
  

Berkeley Law is one of the nation's premier law schools, located at one of the world's great universities, in one of the most vibrant places on the planet. Berkeley Law is one of 14 schools and colleges at the University of California, Berkeley. It is consistently ranked as one of the top law schools in the nation.
  
  

At Berkeley Law, we are committed to excellence in education and scholarship, as well as equality of opportunity. We believe we have a responsibility to use our substantial intellectual capital to help solve real\-world problems and to create a more just society through clinics, research, and policy engagement. We believe that a Berkeley Law degree is a tool for change, both locally and globally, and that we should be educating the leaders of tomorrow. We maintain an environment that nurtures academic and personal growth, respects a diversity of ideas, and stimulates independent thought and critical reasoning.

The Executive Assistant to the Dean provides executive level support to the Dean of Berkeley Law School. The position will also be responsible for providing leadership to manage effective systems and protocols within the Dean's Office under the supervision of the Deputy Chief Administrative Officer. The position will manage the Dean's calendar, conduct research in order to prepare briefing materials, coordinate travel, manage the Dean's tasks, coordinate confidential and sensitive communications among law school units and central campus administration, provide support for the Dean's teaching, and assist the dean in his legal work. This position works closely with several Law School units including Development and Alumni Relations, Operations, Human Resources and Academic Personnel. This position assists the Dean with special projects as needed. This position will also facilitate activities and appointments between the Dean and the CAO/Deputy CAO and the Dean's Office in general.
  
  

Application Review Date
  
  

The First Review Date for this job is September 14, 2026\. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.

Executive Administrative Support
  
  

Serves as the lead administrative support professional in a fast\-paced, high visibility work environment, providing comprehensive executive administrative support to the Dean of Berkeley Law School. Coordinates and manages a complex and dynamic schedule involving internal and external meetings, events, travel, and other executive commitments.
  
Manages the Dean's appointment calendar and prepares daily schedules, briefings, and check\-ins to ensure the Dean is prepared for all upcoming activities.
  
Serves as a primary point of contact and gatekeeper for the Dean, appropriately screening and directing requests and determining when matters require the Dean's attention, additional information, or referral to another individual or office.
  
Exercises independent judgment in prioritizing competing demands, identifying time\-sensitive matters, resolving scheduling conflicts, and allocating the Dean's time based on urgency, importance, and organizational priorities.
  
Oversees travel and entertainment, and related logistical activities for the Dean and Dean's Office, delegating appropriate responsibilities to other support staff as appropriate, while maintaining overall accountability for timely and accurate completion. Serves as the Deans primary point of contact for these activities, ensuring responsive, high\-quality service, and support throughout all activities both inside and outside of the Law School.
  
Implements and maintains related administrative and business processes in accordance with Law School and University policies and procedures. Accurately interprets and clearly communicates applicable processes and policies to staff and others, explaining the rationale and operational implications of established procedures.
  
  

Administrative Operations and Process Management
  
  

Identifies opportunities to establish, improve, strengthen, and refine internal administrative systems and processes, office procedures, and workflows to improve efficiency, service, communication, and responsiveness within the Dean's Office.
  
Organizes, tracks, and monitors multiple concurrent assignments, tasks, initiatives and time\-sensitive matters. Exercises sound judgment in adjusting priorities as demands shift, without sacrificing goal attainment or work quality.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Events
jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest\-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean\-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.


Despite being a $1\.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de\-risk projects, and scale with confidence.


As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.


We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top\-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

**Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in\-office days per week). We prefer NYC\-based candidates or those open to relocation.**

**About the Role**
==================


We've built the foundation for events at PermitFlow. Now we need someone to own the outcome and turn events into a pillar of our GTM motion.


This role runs the full events portfolio: industry conferences, owned events, customer\-specific gatherings, and field marketing, plus ongoing experimentation with new formats, venues, and audiences. You'll execute hands\-on, with internal and external support, and tie every event back to pipeline and revenue goals. We're an experimentation\-heavy culture. You'll be given room to ideate, experiment, measure, and repeat what works.


This is a manager\-level individual contributor role. You already know how to set goals, manage a budget, and partner across teams, and you'll bring that experience on day one.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Own the events portfolio: build the calendar across industry events, owned events, customer events, and field marketing, and decide where to place bets.
* Run logistics end to end: venues, budgets, vendors, contractors, staffing, and the on\-the\-ground run of show.
* Experiment deliberately and iterate quickly: test new formats, venues, and target audiences, and kill what doesn't work.
* Get the right targets in the room and at our booth. Great events don't stop at a project plan; they rely on driving high\-value attendees.
* Connect events to revenue: define what success looks like for each event, track pipeline and revenue impact, and report results back to the business.
* Partner cross\-functionally: work closely with demand gen, product marketing, sales, CS, and business operations to align events with GTM priorities.
* Manage event budgets and vendor relationships: negotiate contracts, manage contractor relationships, and keep spend accountable.
* Build the playbook: turn what's worked into repeatable processes so the program scales as the business grows.
* Represent events at the leadership level: bring recommendations and results directly to company leadership.
* Source speaking opportunities at relevant industry and public events for executive leadership, including content submissions as needed.

**Who You Are**
===============

* You've run B2B events in a fast\-moving environment and know the difference between an event that just looks good and one that drives pipeline.
* You can run logistics yourself. You don't need a coordinator to book a venue or manage a floor plan, but you know when and what to delegate.
* You think like a marketer first and an event planner second: every event ties back to organizational goals.
* You've worked closely with partners in Sales, Customer Success, and Executives.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. This program is evolving, and you'll be instrumental in building the playbooks and processes.
* Bonus: experience in construction, home services, or a related built\-world industry.
* Bonus: experience at a startup or in AI, and genuine interest in how physical infrastructure gets built.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high\-growth company
* 100% company\-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees \+ healthcare FSA
* 401(k) savings plan
* Unlimited PTO and paid family leave
* Home office \& equipment stipend
* Daily in\-office lunch and dinner provided
* Commuter benefits (pre\-tax transit and parking)

*PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.*

 *We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.*


Compensation Range: $120K \- $150K
