jobs.description:
**About On Board Experiential (OBE)**



OBE is a global marketing agency that brings brands to life through culture\-shaping experiences. For more than 30 years, we've partnered with iconic brands — including Nike, the NFL, JPMorganChase, Meta, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse — to build community, create cultural relevance, and drive measurable business impact. With offices in Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, and London, we activate globally. OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.



We've been recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events — and we couldn't agree more.



The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative, and make genuinely remarkable things happen. But behind every great activation is a human who deserves rest, connection, and a life outside of work. That's why we invest in recovery days, company offsites, happy hours, and the kind of friendly\-but\-competitive fitness challenges that bond teams for life.



We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences, your unconventional ideas, and the perspectives only you can bring. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.


**Summary of Position**



The Account Manager (Account Lead) is an integral part of the Account Team, delivering an exceptional level of service, strategic vision, and flawless execution of experiential programs on behalf of our clients. Responsible for cultivating and expanding client accounts, this position requires a comprehensive understanding of our clients' business needs, industry trends, and specialized experiential environments.



For this role, we are seeking an Account Lead with a strong background in hospitality, restaurant management, and food \& beverage programs. You will bring deep operational command of both Front of House guest experience and Back of House kitchen/culinary logistics, with a heavy emphasis on high\-end dining execution. This position requires a proven track record of managing multi\-partner culinary activations, including the capability to oversee up to 30 individual restaurant or hospitality partners within a single event. Providing end\-to\-end project management and accountability for financial and operational performance, the Account Manager ensures that programs successfully promote client brands while delivering world\-class hospitality standards.


**Essential Job Functions**


* **Strategic Client Partnership:** Partner with client and brand teams to understand business objectives, identifying opportunities to offer innovative experiential solutions. Specifically leveraging F\&B, culinary integration, and hospitality\-driven touchpoints to drive measurable results.
* **Large\-Scale Hospitality Partner Management:** Direct vendor relationships and operational onboarding for complex, multi\-vendor culinary activations, managing up to 30 individual restaurant, chef, or hospitality partners per event.
* **FOH \& BOH Operations Integration:** Bridge Front of House service standards (guest flow, table service, VIP hospitality, bar pacing) with Back of House kitchen realities (staging areas, prep timelines, cold storage, equipment load\-in, waste management, and chef coordination) with a primary emphasis on dining excellence.
* **Experiential \& F\&B Program Planning:** Guide and coordinate the development of Experiential tactical plans for live, hybrid, and culinary\-focused activations in partnership with Strategy/Creative, Production, Tech, Digital, Social, and Culinary Operations teams.
* **Regulatory \& Permitting Oversight:** Serve as the primary Account Lead for venue buyouts, restaurant partnerships, bar program builds, menu development, staffing protocols, and temporary health/liquor permitting compliance across all participating culinary partners.
* **Day\-to\-Day Account Skills:** Manage day\-to\-day project activities, providing clear direction and seamless execution across internal cross\-functional teams, external vendors, master mixologists, Executive Chefs, FOH leads, and venue owners.
* **Communication \& Meeting Facilitation:** Lead weekly client status meetings, deep dives, and post\-event debriefs. Direct the proper distribution of all project communications, timelines, run\-of\-shows (ROS), Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), and kitchen load\-in schedules throughout the engagement.
* **Financial Management \& Budgeting:** Provide ongoing monitoring of expenses, vendor contracts, culinary talent fees, and actual costs for approved program budgets. Obtain client approvals, manage scope changes, and reconcile all project expenses in partnership with the Program Producer.
* **Performance Feedback \& Quality Control:** Provide timely performance feedback on all activations, catering partners, and internal team members to senior management, maintaining white\-glove dining standards across all touchpoints.


**Desired Skills and Experiences**


**Education \& Experience**


* **3\+ years of experience** in marketing, promotions, live events, or experiential marketing (agency experience strongly preferred).
* **Minimum 2 years of experience as an Account Lead**, acting as the primary point of client contact.
* **Demonstrated experience in hospitality and dining operations**, including direct experience managing both Front of House service and Back of House kitchen logistics.
* **Proven track record of managing large\-scale culinary activations**, specifically coordinating multi\-vendor footprints featuring up to 30 distinct restaurant, chef, or bar partners simultaneously.
* Experience managing live events, hospitality suites, food festivals, pop\-up dining concepts, and high\-volume experiential activations.

We are solving big problems, and meeting the needs of our clients and the people they care about in a whole new way. We realize that the world has changed so much recently, and that the needs of our customers and how they envision transportation is changing too. Our work is fun, challenging and rewarding and we are looking for customer and growth\-focused team members passionate about solving problems and delighting our customers.



As an Account Manager, you'll help our clients understand the power of Lyft Business. You will build and manage a named account list of large organizations in the US, ensuring that they leverage Lyft's products for any transportation objective they have. We're building the next great transportation platform, and we need world\-class talent and candidates that aren't afraid to try new things and think outside the box to build new business.

* Identify and generate additional revenue streams within existing accounts, including up\-sells and cross\-sells; selling across commuter benefits, events, employee perks, concierge, and corporate travel use cases to exceed revenue targets

* Have comfort in operating in the gray. Programs will fail as others succeed. Take note of what works, and help build our playbook for new B2B transportation use cases for Lyft.

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Star Fire is a Long Island–based fire and life safety company and a proud member of the ONEAltus family of companies. As a Siemens distributor, we design, install, service, and inspect fire alarm and life safety systems for many of the region’s most demanding institutional clients — trusted by transit authorities, railroads, and school districts across Long Island to keep people safe and buildings code\-compliant. As we grow and transition long\-standing customer relationships to the next generation of leadership, we are seeking a driven, relationship\-focused Account Manager to steward and expand our most important accounts.  

  

The Account Manager is the trusted advisor and primary point of contact for Star Fire’s portfolio of strategic institutional accounts — including the MTA, the Long Island Railroad (LIRR), and school districts across Long Island. This role exists to take ownership of established, high\-value relationships historically managed by ownership and to protect, deepen, and grow them over time.  

  

This is fundamentally a relationship\-management role. You will retain and expand recurring inspection, testing, service, and project revenue across an assigned book of strategic accounts by being present, responsive, and genuinely useful to the people who depend on Star Fire for life\-safety compliance. You will coordinate Star Fire’s technical, project management, service, and office teams around each client’s needs — acting as the internal \\"quarterback\\" who ensures the customer experience is seamless.  

As a secondary focus, you will help develop new relationships with general and electrical contractors on Long Island — positioning Star Fire as their fire alarm and life safety subcontractor of choice on retrofit and new\-installation projects. This is an opportunistic growth lever, not the core of the role.  

  

Hourly Rate: $28\.00/hour \- $45\.00/hour**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**KEY ATTRIBUTES**
==================


The Account Manager is expected to embody the following key attributes:

* **Accountability** — take ownership of every strategic account relationship, from transition through long\-term growth and retention.
* **Client Focus** — prioritize long\-term institutional relationships, measured by satisfaction, retention, compliance, and account growth.
* **Collaboration** — win as a team across Star Fire’s technical experts, project management, service, scheduling, estimating, and office/accounting functions.
* **Trusted Presence** — become the reliable, credible face of Star Fire to institutional decision\-makers; earn the relationship equity that ownership built over decades.
* **Sense of Urgency** — respond promptly to client requests and drive timely coordination across the organization.
* **Time Management** — balance field time with institutional accounts against the office discipline needed to manage a clean, current book of business. Administrative work should never crowd out relationship\-building or customer engagement.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
========================

***Account Management (Primary Focus)***

* Serve as the single, consistent point of contact and trusted advisor for Star Fire’s strategic institutional accounts — MTA, LIRR, and Long Island school districts.
* Take ownership of relationships transitioning from ownership; introduce yourself, establish rapport, and set clear communication expectations with each key stakeholder during the transition period.
* Conduct proactive, in\-person outreach and site visits to review service satisfaction, surface concerns early, and build long\-term trust.
* Understand each account’s compliance calendar, inspection cycles, and code obligations; be the client’s guide to staying ahead of requirements rather than reacting to them.
* Educate clients on code and compliance requirements, using each conversation as an opportunity to add value and recommend appropriate services, upgrades, and repairs.
* Document all client interactions, commitments, and opportunities in the CRM for continuity, accountability, and a smooth long\-term transition of institutional knowledge.

***Account Retention \& Growth***

* Retain and grow recurring inspection, testing, and service revenue across the assigned portfolio of strategic accounts.
* Identify and pursue opportunities to expand within existing accounts — additional buildings, additional systems and service lines, deficiency repairs, and system upgrades or retrofits.
* Begin renewal planning well ahead of contract expiration; prepare by reviewing account history, outstanding deficiencies, management or leadership changes, and growth opportunities.
* Present the value of added services and compliance coverage proactively — reach out ahead of expirations, line up site visits for open deficiencies, and grow the account at renewal.
* **Public procurement awareness** — understand that many institutional accounts award work through competitive bids and public procurement; stay aware of bid calendars and coordinate with estimating and leadership so Star Fire is positioned to respond when opportunities come up.

***General Contractor Development (Secondary Focus)***

* Develop new relationships with general and electrical contractors on Long Island, positioning Star Fire as their fire alarm and life safety subcontractor of choice.
* Learn how each contractor bids, who makes decisions, and what they value most in a subcontractor — price, schedule, quality, or close\-outs — and set how quoting will work going forward.
* Expand relationships beyond a single contact — estimators, project managers, and owners — so Star Fire is known across the company, not dependent on one person.
* Coordinate with Star Fire’s project management and estimating teams to respond to bid and RFP requests for fire alarm and life safety installations, retrofits, and upgrades.

***Internal Coordination (Quarterback)***

* Route cust

**About Grubhub**

  

At Grubhub, we believe food is more than just a meal: It’s a source of discovery, connection, and pure enjoyment. There’s a time and place for every type of dish, from hidden neighborhood gems to tried\-and\-true favorites, and we exist to connect people with the food they love in all the ways they like to dig in. We’ve been at it since 2004, but now, as part of Wonder, Grubhub is operating with a renewed sense of momentum and the high\-velocity energy of a powerhouse startup.

  

As a leading U.S. ordering and delivery marketplace, we feature over 415,000 merchants in more than 4,000 cities, creating the ultimate food experience by elevating online ordering through innovative restaurant technology, easy\-to\-use platforms, and an improved delivery experience. We are constantly finding new ways to innovate—from integrated grocery delivery with groceries powered by Instacart to exclusive loyalty programs. Join our team, based out of New York City and Chicago, and help us give our diners the exceptional value they deserve.

 **The Impact You Will Make:**

* Develop a solid understanding of Grubhub's products and services, including their features, benefits, and value propositions.
* Assist in managing a portfolio of accounts, ensuring timely communication, and addressing basic inquiries or concerns from clients.
* Assist restaurants in attracting new diners, boosting order volume, and delivering top\-quality service to their diners.
* Conduct regular check\-ins with restaurant partners to gather feedback, assess satisfaction levels, and identify areas for improvement.
* Respond to restaurant inquiries, account issues, and requests or route them to appropriate company departments within turnaround time expectations.

jobs.title: Product Operations Specialist | Juno
jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================


You will build and run the operating systems that help Juno ship reliably and support customers as we scale. On the product operations side, you will turn product decisions into clear operating plans, maintain visibility in Linear, coordinate customer testing and launch readiness, keep commitments and risks visible, and make sure product changes are communicated clearly.


You will partner closely with product and engineering to make decisions executable, keep work organized, surface gaps and dependencies, and ensure the team follows through on what it has committed to ship.


On the customer support side, you will be the first line of defense when customers encounter product issues. You will triage and investigate problems, coordinate the right response, and redirect travel\-service questions to our travel partners. Because you sit close to both the product process and the customer, you will turn recurring friction into clear insights, accountable follow\-up, and better operating systems.


Success means Juno ships through a lightweight and dependable process, customers understand what changed, risks and commitments do not get lost, recurring issues reach the right owners, and support demand does not grow one\-for\-one with the business.

***\*Please note that this Product Operations role will require you to be comfortable with working in\-person at our NYC HQ (located near Madison Square Park) at least 2 days/week\****

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Provide holistic support through the entire launch lifecycle across program management, customer testing, launch readiness, change management, customer communication, and post\-launch iteration. Own and improve Juno's shipping process so the right reviews, testing, documentation, internal enablement, and customer updates happen at the right time.
* Maintain Linear as a reliable operating system for projects, owners, milestones, dependencies, status, and product decisions. Surface risks early and follow through until they are resolved.
* Serve as the first line of defense for product\-related customer issues across email and chat, join customer calls when needed, manage escalations to resolution, and route travel\-service questions to the right partner.
* Be the voice of the customer in product decisions. Analyze support trends and customer feedback, diagnose recurring friction, size the problems you find, and translate messy input into clear findings, recommended actions, prioritization input, and accountable follow\-up for product and engineering.
* Build AI\-powered workflows, automations, knowledge systems, and self\-service experiences that improve the quality and speed of product operations and customer support.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 3\+ years of experience in product operations, program management, customer experience, technical support, consulting, or another customer\-facing analytical role in a fast\-moving software company.
* You are highly process\-oriented. You can turn ambiguous cross\-functional work into clear owners, milestones, decisions, and next steps without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* You actively use AI to get real work done and can show us what you have automated, analyzed, or built.
* You can use qualitative feedback and data to identify patterns, diagnose root causes, size problems, and measure whether a product or operational fix reduced customer friction.
* You write with precision and empathy. You can explain a complicated product change or technical issue clearly, without jargon or filler.
* You run toward ownership, move quickly without losing the details, and can drive clarity across product, engineering, customer success, customers, and external partners.

**Nice\-to\-Haves**
-------------------

* Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, debugging, or data analysis, even if you do not write production code.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, travel, fintech, or another operationally complex product.

**Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home\-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra\-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------

* 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance

**Canada**

jobs.title: Executive Assistant (Marketing Org)
jobs.description:
**POS\-33349**



 HubSpot's Marketing organization is responsible for building the brand, creating demand, deepening customer connection, and helping millions of businesses grow better. We're looking for an Executive Assistant to join our Marketing team who is passionate about providing world\-class support to senior leaders and enabling a high\-performing, connected organization.



This role will provide high\-touch, proactive support to 3–4\+ Marketing Vice Presidents, helping them operate effectively across a dynamic, highly cross\-functional organization. The Executive Assistant will report to the Chief of Staff to the CMO and work closely with two other Executive Assistants on the Marketing team to provide coordinated coverage, share best practices, and deliver a seamless executive\-support experience.



Success in this role requires exceptional prioritization, time management, and judgment. This person will expertly manage a complex portfolio of executive calendars, constantly assessing competing requests, anticipating conflicts, and making thoughtful tradeoffs to protect leaders' focus and ensure their time is aligned to the highest\-impact business priorities. The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, and resourceful, with a demonstrated ability to stay ahead of shifting priorities, operate calmly under pressure, and create leverage for senior leaders in a fast\-paced environment.


**In this role, you'll get to:**


* Manage complex, high\-volume calendars, travel, and incoming and outgoing meeting requests for 3–4\+ Marketing Vice Presidents. Proactively prioritize requests, resolve scheduling conflicts, protect executive focus time, and ensure leaders are prepared for their highest\-impact internal and external engagements.
* Partner closely with the Chief of Staff to the CMO and two Marketing Executive Assistants to coordinate executive coverage, align on team priorities, share best practices, and ensure continuity during absences or high\-volume periods.
* Partner with the EA's in planning and executing All Team meetings, AMAs, leadership meetings, planning sessions, and team offsites. This may include agenda ownership, logistics coordination, speaker management, content collection, and run\-of\-show support.
* Process expense reports, open and manage purchase orders, and support other administrative workflows with accuracy and timeliness.
* Handle sensitive information, executive communications, and high\-priority requests with appropriate discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, team communications, meeting rhythms, and operating practices across the Marketing organization.
* Serve as a trusted representative of Marketing leadership, creating a thoughtful and seamless experience for employees, customers, partners, and external contacts.


**We are looking for people with:**


* Must have at least 3\+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, senior administrative support, or equivalent coordination experience, including direct support for VP, SVP, or C\-suite\-level leaders in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, or otherwise complex organization.
* Ideally based in the Boston area; East Coast\-based candidates will also be considered, with the ability to travel to the office for key leadership meetings, on\-sites, and events.

*This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the Americans with Disabilities Act.***What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------


* Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills.
* Demonstrates strong goal orientation; results driven, highly competitive, and self\- motivated with demonstrated successful sales track record
* Understanding of consultative sales process, experience with formalized sales training
* Strong business acumen
* Highly accountable, well organized with excellent planning skills
* Strong hunter mentality
* Available and able to work evenings and weekends
* Demonstrated integrity with high ethical standards and practice
* Ability to utilize a laptop computer with strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office including: Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

* Bachelor’s degree in business, life sciences or related field, preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

**Travel Expectations**
-----------------------


* Requires daily local travel and some longer distance/overnight travel for trade shows and business meetings.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About the job**  

Flatpay is on a mission to simplify payments for small and medium\-sized businesses. We provide transparent, low\-cost payment solutions combined with fast onboarding and real human support. Our approach is simple: fair pricing, great technology, and local support that merchants can rely on.  

  

We’re scaling rapidly, with 2,000\+ colleagues across multiple markets, and we’re just getting started!
  

  

As we’re now expanding into the United States, we’re looking for driven Business Development Representatives in New Jersey who want to help SMBs access better payment solutions while playing a key role in launching Flatpay in a new market!  

  

If you want to join a high\-growth, customer\-centric company where things move fast and people genuinely care, you’ll feel right at home here.  

  

You'll potentially have to commute to our New York office for the first 6 months before we open our permanent office in New Jersey.  

  



**Salary Band**  

Competitive salary, standard US benefits \- including health insurance and 401(K).  

On‑Target Earnings (OTE): $60,000 – $70,000

**What you'll do**


As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you will play a critical role in generating new business opportunities by booking qualified meetings for our Field Sales Representatives.
  

This is a pure outbound, booking\-focused role.
  

  

As a BDR, your responsibility is to:

* engage SMB merchants
* generate interest in Flatpay
* book qualified meetings for our Field Sales team


You will not be responsible for closing deals. Your success is measured by activity, meetings booked, and show rates.
  

  

This is a high\-energy role suited for individuals who enjoy fast\-paced environments, targets, and direct impact on growth.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct outbound cold calls to merchants to spark interest in Flatpay
* Qualify leads and book on\-site meetings for Sales Managers
* Maintain clean, accurate data in the CRM; log activities and outcomes meticulously
* Iterate on outreach scripts and tactics based on results and coaching
* Provide feedback on merchant responses, competitor insights and pitch success

 **Who you are**

* High energy, persistence and positive attitude toward cold outreach
* Strong verbal and written persuasion skills and quick rapport building
* Metrics\-driven mindset and comfort working toward daily/weekly targets
* Receptive to feedback and eager to learn sales best practices
* Ability to multitask, manage time effectively and stay organised in a fast\-paced environment

 **Background**

* No previous telesales experience required
* 1\-2 years of customer facing roles preferred (e.g. customer support, retail, restaurants, telesales)
* Fluent in English, additional languages are a plus

 **Why Flatpay**


Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed. You'll get the opportunity to play a key role in driving Flatpay's success in the US, while accelerating your own career at the same time.


With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low\-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

jobs.title: PGIM Quantitative Solutions, Executive Assistant (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Job Classification:


Corporate \- Administration**A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE \& INCLUSIVE CULTURE**
-----------------------------------------------------


As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact \- touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever\-changing world.


We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!


If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can!


Our Quantitative Solutions business is seeking a talented and driven Executive Assistant to work closely with leadership for our Equity and Multi\-Asset investment teams. This role is ideal for a highly organized, proactive professional who thrives in a demanding environment and takes pride in supporting a high‑performing investment leadership team.

**What you can expect:**

* Provide day‑to‑day administrative and operational support including preparation and coordination of communications, calendar management, and meeting logistics.
* Organize and maintain complex calendars, including scheduling large meetings with senior‑level executives across the company.
* Coordinate complex international travel across multiple time zones and regions, leveraging knowledge of global geographies, visa requirements, and cultural considerations to ensure seamless execution.
* Support client meetings by coordinating agendas, preparation materials, logistics (including catering and security clearance), compliance pre‑approvals, and internal prep sessions.
* Prepare, edit, and produce high‑quality PowerPoint presentations, Word documents, reports, and other executive‑ready materials, with a strong attention to detail and a focus on efficiency and consistency.
* Serve as a professional point of contact for written and verbal communications on behalf of the Investments leadership team.
* Participate in coordinating employee and volunteer events as part of the shared administrative team responsibilities.
* Provide backup coverage for other Executive Assistants and collaborate closely with the Quantitative Solutions Admin Team on ad hoc projects and broader initiatives.

**What you will bring:**

* Minimum of six years of experience supporting senior‑level executives in a fast‑paced professional environment.
* Prior experience in the financial services or investment management industry.
* Hands‑on, roll‑up‑your‑sleeves mindset with a willingness to take on whatever is needed to support the team.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability; approaches work with a client‑service orientation.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and adapting quickly as priorities evolve.
* Proven project and workflow management skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of concurrent requests while maintaining accuracy and follow‑through.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to producing polished, executive‑level deliverables.
* Strong time‑management and prioritization skills, with the judgment to manage shifting deadlines and competing stakeholder needs.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Word; strong working knowledge of Excel for tracking, organization, and analysis.
* High level of integrity, discretion, and judgment in handling highly sensitive and confidential information.
* Ability to communicate effectively across teams to align priorities and business objectives.
* Working knowledge of Concur and Workday.
* Flexibility to work overtime as needed.

**What will set you apart?**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree


PGIM believes in the Power of a Hybrid work arrangement. The Power of Hybrid is both the flexibility of work from home, as well as the networking and career development of in\-person work with colleagues through weekly anchor day(s). This position will work a 3 day hybrid schedule in our Newark, NJ office.

**Note**: Prudential is required by state specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations. The base salary range for this role is from $95,000\.00 to $120,000\.00\. Specific pricing for the role may vary within the above range based on many factors including geographic location, candidate experience, and skills. Roles may also be eligible for additional compensation and/or benefits. Eligibility to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

PGIM Quantitative Solutions is the quantitative, multi\-asset and liquid alternatives specialist of PGIM. For more than 45 years, PGIM Quantitative Solutions has helped investors around the world solve their unique needs by leveraging the power of technology and data as well as advanced academic research. PGIM Quantitative Solutions manages portfolios across equities, multi\-asset and liquid alternatives and offers defined contribution solutions. For more information, please visit PGIM Quantitative Solutions


\#LI\-Hybrid


\#LI\-CR1

======================

* **Market competitive base salaries, with a yearly bonus potential at every level.**
* **Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO), and leave of absences, such as parental and military leave.**
* 401(k) plan with company match (up to 4%).
* Company\-funded pension plan.
* **Wellness Programs**

jobs.description:
Who are we?


A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know\-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef \& Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef \& Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence.


**Are you a good match?**

For this role, we are looking for the candidate to have a bachelor’s degree and a minimum of five years’ work experience, preferably supporting luxury retail executives; Events planning and project management experience is preferred. You will have the ability to communicate and liase with executives and leaders as well as a diverse employee population with excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. You will have a high level of confidentiality, discretion, professional maturity, emotional intelligence \& social etiquette. You will have advanced\-level experience with Microsoft Office; SAP is a plus.


**What are we expecting from you?**

The Executive Assistant to the Vice Presidents of Finance \& Operations will provide core administrative support including calendar management, booking \& coordinating travel, budget and expense management, and assisting with planning, negotiating large scale meetings and other ad\-hoc projects as needed. This role will help to facilitate the day\-to\-day activities and administrative operations of the office. This role reports to the Vice President of Operations and is based in New York.


In this role, you will:


**Responsibilities:**

* Provide scheduling support to the Finance and Operations members of the Executive leadership team (CoDir); Manage travel schedules anticipating and resolving conflicts.
* Assist the Leadership team with administrative tasks, such as scheduling meetings, managing expense reports, invoice processing, filing, shipping, ordering supplies, receiving visitors, and planning events and coordination for team meetings.
* Book travel, hotels, car service for international and domestic travel and process corresponding expense reports accurately and in compliance with company policies.

* Manage all administrative tasks and coordination for Sustainability benefits and initiatives including volunteer day organization and execution.

This role is bonus eligible

**Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.**



More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it's because they are employed by a company that doesn't offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium\-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.



We're a high\-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. * **Fundamental Optimism**: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

**Aria Care Partners** is the national leader in providing onsite dental, vision, hearing, and podiatry care to over 3500 long\-term care and skilled nursing facilities across 25 states. Aria Care Partners believes that our clinicians should be able to focus on providing the best, most comprehensive care for their patients. Our clinicians visit different skilled nursing communities daily, bringing life\-affirming care to an underserved population. Our business model, innovation, customer support and teamwork deliver an unparalleled customer experience, resulting in a customer satisfaction rating of over 98%. Executing this strategic philosophy resulted in rapid company growth with revenue increases of 25%\-30% annually over the last 4 years, nearly doubling the size of the company. At Aria Care Partners, our mission is to enrich the quality of life for every resident with passion and compassion.

**Working at Aria Matters!**

**The Position**


We’re looking for an Account Manager who would enjoy working for a company that makes a difference in the geriatric population’s lives in communities across the nation. The primary function of this position is to provide excellent customer service, retention of existing accounts, and insurance sales.

* Retention of existing facilities: Sustains rapport with key accounts by making periodic visits – at a minimum once per quarter; exploring specific needs; anticipating new opportunities.

* Keeps promotional materials ready by coordinating requirements with marketing department; inventorying stock; placing orders; verifying receipt.
* Plans meetings and attends trade shows
* Protects organization's value by keeping information confidential

**The Location**


The Account Manager position is a remote position that includes a combination of field days and home office days. **This role REQUIRES overnight travel and** **the individual MUST reside within the territory.**


Requirements:
* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred
* 3\-5 Years previous applicable experience
* Preferred prior work experience within senior living communities, sales, and life/health insurance
* Ability to obtain health and life insurance license
* Reliable transportation
* Ability to Lift Up to 50 Pounds

**Other Qualifications**

* Preferred skills \- experience using Salesforce and Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Word, and Outlook.

* Dependability \- consistently at work and on time, follows instructions, takes responsibility for own actions, responds to management direction.
* Efficiency \- the ability to visit required number of weekly visits in a timely manner without sacrificing quality.
* Teamwork \- Able to work in team environment.
* Communication \- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Education of Aria Care Partners’ mission \& services to potential facilities.
* Currently possess a life/health insurance license or the ability to successfully complete the licensing course and exam.
* Territory management – the ability to plan weekly travel throughout the state to visit with nursing home staff and residents.

**Why Should You Apply?**

* Ability to work for a company that cares and makes a difference.
* You enjoy feeling challenged and driven to exceed goals

* Competitive Base Pay \+ bonus
* Mileage reimbursement

**Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive benefit package for you and your family, including:

* PTO and Paid Holidays for FT Employees

jobs.title: Commercial Specialties Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
What This Job Is  
This is the supply side of commercial interiors. As an Assistant Project Manager on our Division 10 Specialties team, you'll take projects from the estimate through procurement, delivery, and closeout \- pricing the work, placing the orders, tracking lead times, and keeping general contractors and installers informed along the way. The goal is straightforward: the right products, on the job when the schedule calls for them, matching what the specs require.  


It's a full\-time, in\-office position, and it's structured as a path into a Project Manager seat.  


Who This Fits  
You'll do well here if you're organized enough to run a lot of open orders at once and comfortable picking up the phone when something doesn't line up. We're open on background \- zero to two years in construction, estimating, or project coordination works, and internships count. Prior work in customer service, sales, or any B2B setting transfers well, since a good share of this job is talking to people about what they need and when they need it.  


What we do want to see:  


Ability to read construction drawings, blueprints, and specifications  
A working understanding of construction processes, building systems, and project documentation  
Solid Microsoft Office skills; ERP or order entry experience helps  
Clear communication and a habit of following through  
Real interest in specialty products and the construction management side of the business  


The Work Itself  


Estimating and bidding  
Working under a Project Manager, you'll prepare takeoffs, budgets, quotations, and bid proposals. That starts with reviewing plans and specs to pin down what a project actually calls for, then identifying product solutions that hit the spec at a competitive number. Bids and budgets go out on deadline.  
Project execution  
Once a job is awarded, it's yours to run through closeout. You'll coordinate procurement, approvals, lead times, deliveries, and schedules against the project's milestones and completion dates, and keep records and customer information accurate as things move.  
Documentation  
Quotations, purchase orders, submittals, shop drawings, RFIs, change orders, and freight claims \- all of it has to stay current and compliant with the contract documents and customer requirements.  
Communication  
You'll be the point of contact for general contractors, architects, subcontractors, vendors, installers, and customers. When a product, order, or schedule issue comes up, you handle it directly and early, with a consultative approach rather than an order\-taking one.  


Product Categories You'll Work With  
Toilet partitions, toilet accessories, lockers and benches, fire extinguishers and cabinets, visual display units, corner guards and wall protection, interior signage, and assorted other specialties.  


What Success Looks Like  
The people who thrive in this role are self\-starters \- detail\-oriented, analytical, able to juggle competing priorities without dropping any of them. They work independently but coordinate well with internal teams and outside partners, they communicate professionally under pressure, and they're genuinely trying to learn the business well enough to step up into a PM role.  


Apply  
If you have construction project support experience and you want to build a career on the specialties side of commercial interiors, send us your application!  


United Contractor Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law.  


Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year

American Armor Gloves is hiring its first VA Regional Sales Representatives to build out a dedicated sales function for VA healthcare accounts. This is a new sales team, not a new company — AAG has spent years developing the manufacturing capacity, quality systems, and early government relationships this role is built to take advantage of.


**The Opportunity**
===================



This is a new role, but it isn't a cold start. AAG has already done much of the groundwork required to sell into government and VA healthcare: compliant manufacturing, a quality system built for regulated buyers, and early relationships with VA stakeholders. What hasn't existed until now is a dedicated sales representative to develop that opportunity fully within an assigned VA region. You'll be one of the first five or six people to hold this role, working from an established foundation rather than starting from nothing.


**What You'll Own**
===================


* Sales development and account management for VA facilities, CBOCs, and healthcare systems within your assigned region.
* Relationships with the people who make purchasing decisions — Chiefs of Logistics, procurement leads, and clinical stakeholders.
* A territory pipeline you build and manage yourself, from first contact through closed business, navigating VA purchasing processes along the way.

**What Makes You the Right Fit**
================================


* **Government or VA sales experience — required.** You should already understand how these purchasing processes work.
* **Existing relationships within VA healthcare systems — preferred.** It's a specific, relationship\-driven network, and prior experience in it shortens the learning curve.
* **Comfort managing a defined territory independently,** with real ownership over how you prioritize and run it.
* **Strong follow\-through and CRM discipline,** since accurate pipeline and forecast tracking is a core part of the role, not an afterthought.

Base salary plus commission, structured to be competitive with current market data for government and federal healthcare sales roles, with uncapped upside as your territory develops. American Armor Gloves manufactures high\-quality nitrile gloves, produced in West Columbia, South Carolina. At Worth AI, we are passionate about leveraging the power of AI to revolutionize the way businesses make decisions. We value diversity of thought, foster a collaborative team environment, and embrace agility to adapt to evolving market needs.


As a Business Development Representative, you will be responsible for identifying and qualifying potential clients, generating leads, and scheduling meetings for the sales team. Your strong communication skills and ability to build rapport will be instrumental in educating potential clients about Worth AI's solutions and value proposition

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with potential clients.
* Strong problem\-solving and negotiation skills, with the ability to identify clients' needs and propose effective solutions.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
* Self\-motivated with a results\-oriented mindset.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Proficiency in CRM software (Hubspot) and other sales tools.
* Understanding of AI and its applications in the business world
* Prior experience in lead generation
* You are comfortable with cold calling and have a persistent and resilient approach to generating leads.
* You have a passion for sales and a desire to exceed targets and goals.
* You are proactive and resourceful in finding potential clients and opportunities.
* You have a strong attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
  

  

  

**Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k)
* Life Insurance
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* 9 paid Holidays
* Hybrid \- Orlando office and WFH
* Free Food \& Snacks

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Overview:**

The Business Development Representative, reporting directly to the VP of Sales, will play a key role in driving new customer acquisition and expanding market presence within the local region. This position partners closely with operations leadership, prospective clients, and internal teams to identify business opportunities, build strong customer relationships, and deliver staffing and workforce solutions tailored to client needs. Ideal candidates are proactive, relationship\-driven sales professionals with a passion for business development and a strong ability to understand and communicate the value of Staff Management \| SMX \| SIMOS solutions in solving customer challenges.


**Location:** Atlanta , GA


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Actively prospect and acquire new customers within the designated territory through effective networking and lead development.
* Identify growth opportunities and prospects for new customer acquisition.
* Implement strategic sales initiatives to meet and surpass sales targets.
* Consult customers to understand their business needs and offer creative solutions to solve workforce needs.
* Work with the Market Engagement team to build sales outreach and territory account targets.
* Effectively sell the Staff Management \| SMX \| SIMOS service offerings.
* Collaborate with Staff Management \| SMX \| SIMOS contracts and legal teams to negotiate contract terms effectively.
* Proactively cross\-sell opportunities across all TrueBlue brands and neighboring markets.
* Utilize appropriate technology and tools to develop and maintain comprehensive account management and growth strategies, including Salesforce, ZoomInfo, and Sales Navigator.
* Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and market developments to effectively position TrueBlue products and services.
* Collaborate with Onsite Operations personnel and leadership to build impactful in\-market relationships.

**EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE**

* Associate’s Degree preferred
* Equivalent combination of education and experience considered.
* 3\+ years of sales or related experience required, with a proven track record of exceeding sales targets and the ability to understand, adapt, and apply new technologies.
* Valid driver license, registered vehicle, and vehicle insurance.

**CORE KNOWLEDGE and SKILLS**

* Adept at persuading diverse customer stakeholders and influencing decision\-making.
* Strong organizational skills with keen attention to detail.
* Capable of prioritizing tasks and meeting deadlines effectively under pressure.
* Demonstrates analytical abilities, including analyzing order, associate, and customer data to drive informed decisions and achieve outcomes.
* Competitive drive with a results\-oriented mindset.
* Capable of establishing rapport and building relationships with a wide range of individuals.
* Ability to understand and navigate multiple, diverse perspectives from clients.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Salesforce.com, leveraging technology for efficient sales management and reporting.
* Clear, concise and professional communication in both written and verbal forms.
* Ability to adapt quickly to changing business needs, customer demands, and market conditions.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* This position will not have any direct supervisory responsibilities.

**Work Environment and Physical Demands:**

* Remote office work environment; frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk, and/or hear for long periods of time. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
* Travel is required as part of the job. Visits to customer sites or local branches required.

**Salary Range:** $65,900 \- $79,100 annually, depending on experience and geographic location, plus eligibility for incentive pay, subject to plan terms.


Please note that actual compensation offered may vary based on local pay requirements, and will meet or exceed state\-specific minimum wage or salary thresholds.


**Benefits and Well\-Being:**

We offer a competitive benefits package, including 6 paid holidays, 1 paid floating holiday and up to 20 days of Paid Time Off per year, Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, Company\-matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Purchase Program, in addition to other programs and perks. More details about our benefits can be found here .


We consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in the application or interview process. If you require disability\-related accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact your Recruiter directly, Employee Relations at HR\-Advice@trueblue.com , or 1\-800\-610\-8920\. TrueBlue, Inc. and its brands will consult with all applicants who request disability\-related accommodation during the application or interview process to ensure that the accommodation provided takes into account the applicant’s individual accessibility needs.


We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative - Entry Level / Full Time
jobs.description:
Territory Sales Representative – Entry Level / Full Time
  
  

Atlanta GA
  
  

Break Into Pharmaceutical Sales with Pivya® at ImpactBio supporting Alembic Therapeutics
  
  

Do you have work experience that demonstrates drive, energy, and transferable skills that will lead to being a strong salesperson?
  
If you are looking to launch a career in pharmaceutical sales, this is your opportunity!
  
  

Alembic Therapeutics, in partnership with ImpactBio, is launching Pivya®, an FDA\-approved oral antibiotic for uncomplicated urinary tract infections (uUTIs). With over 40 years of success in Sweden, Pivya® is now entering the U.S. market—and we’re building a high\-performance sales team to support this launch.
  
  

As a Territory Sales Representative, you don’t need prior pharmaceutical sales experience—we’re looking for motivated, coachable individuals who are eager to learn, follow a proven sales model, and build a long\-term career in the industry. You’ll receive the training, tools, and mentorship needed to succeed while gaining real\-world experience calling on healthcare providers.
  
  

This full\-time role is with ImpactBio, a premier commercial partner in Life Sciences, with the potential to transition to Alembic Therapeutics based on strong performance.
  
View Openings \& Apply Here Job Openings \- ImpactBio
  
  

Why This Role Matters
  
  

This is more than a sales job—it’s a career entry point into pharmaceutical sales. You’ll be part of a national product launch, gaining experience in a highly competitive industry while developing the skills and discipline needed to grow your career.
  
  

**We’re looking for individuals who are:**  

* Hungry to succeed
* Open to coaching and feedback
* Willing to follow a structured plan
* Ready to put in the work to build something meaningful


If that sounds like you, we’ll teach you the rest.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Promote Pivya® to healthcare providers within your assigned territory
* Learn and execute a structured sales process and messaging strategy
* Build relationships with physicians, nurses, and office staff
* Consistently apply training and coaching in the field
* Develop and execute territory plans to achieve sales goals
* Provide timely updates, insights, and field feedback to leadership
* Maintain full compliance with all company and industry regulations


What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 1–3 years of experience meeting or exceeding goals/metrics (some sales experience would be helpful, B2B sales, Pharma sales, outside sales, customer facing)
* A strong desire to break into pharmaceutical or healthcare sales
* Proven work ethic and demonstrated a track record of going above and beyond to succeed
* Coachability—someone who takes direction well and applies feedback quickly
* High level of motivation, resilience, and accountability
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently while following a defined sales plan
* Willingness to travel extensively within territory
* Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record


Pharmaceutical experience is not required—drive, attitude, and willingness to learn are.
  
  

What We Offer
  
  

* Competitive base salary with a generous performance\-based incentive plan
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental \& Vision coverage
* Car allowance \& mileage reimbursement
* 401K plan with company match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Structured training program designed to help you break into and succeed in pharmaceutical sales
* Ongoing mentorship and field coaching
* A clear path for career growth and advancement
* The chance to be part of a major U.S. product launch


About Alembic Therapeutics
  
  

Alembic Therapeutics LLC, a U.S. subsidiary of Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., is committed to delivering high\-quality, patient\-focused branded pharmaceuticals. Our mission is to bring innovative, reliable medicines to the U.S. market while upholding the highest standards of safety, efficacy, and quality.
  
  

About ImpactBio
  
  

At ImpactBio, we build and launch commercial teams with a focus on performance, development, and long\-term success. We’re known for investing in our people and creating opportunities for driven individuals to grow into high\-performing professionals in the life sciences industry.
  
  

The annual base salary for this position is $65,000\. Compensation is aligned with the position’s scope and internal pay structure.
  
  

Apply Now

jobs.description:
US Heart and Vascular is in need of a Certified Clinical Research Coordinator to join our team at NSC Cardiology in Johns Creek, GA.


**Job Summary**
A clinical research coordinator is a registered professional who will coordinate and oversee clinical operations of medical research projects. This person will participate in assessing, planning, implementing and evaluating subject care in clinical research studies and will establish clinical research organizational policies and procedures, as well as carry out research. This person will work under the general supervision of physicians responsible for the clinical trials.


**Duties and Responsibilities:*** Obtain and review medical records for potential research subjects; maintain medical records of research subjects that include documentation of laboratory test results and progress of research study subjects, following guidelines set forth by the protocol sponsors.
* Recruit clinical study subjects; schedule appointments and interviews, and evaluate potential subjects.
* Instruct potential research subjects, responsible family members, and physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, nursing staff, and ancillary staff involved in care of subjects on aspects of the subject’s care, available research studies, treatments, and side effects.
* Educate subjects concerning diagnosis and treatment plan and explain informed consent procedures, including HIPAA authorizations, to research study subjects and obtain subjects’ written consent. Evaluate and develop subject education materials and give subjects and/or family members instruction on drug administration and other medical information.
* Perform physical assessments and monitor subjects' progress during clinical trials and notify principal investigator of any adverse events and serious adverse events, including evidence of drug toxicity or unexpected side effects. Perform initial interview during each subject visit and plan appropriate care under direction of a physician, nurse practitioner, or physician assistant.
* Provide emotional and educational support to research subjects and serve as liaison between them and the investigators.
* Coordinate research activities, including scheduling laboratory tests, radiology testing, and/or exams for study subjects. Complete case report forms for each study participant and document medical data in subject study chart.
* Perform and/or oversee a variety of clinical duties that may include EKGs, blood smears, and processing of blood serum, urine, and chemistries and recording the results in the subject study chart. Communicate all lab results to PI and medical staff.
* Prepare and/or oversee the preparation of biological specimens for shipment to reference laboratory and centrifugation of hazardous biological and chemical materials. Notify research study subjects of laboratory test results.
* Assess and document compliance of research subjects.
* Participate with other research staff in assessing, planning, implementing, and evaluating the success of research studies with other healthcare providers. Coordinate research activities with related medical departments clinic and hospital.
* Attend staff meetings/conferences as part of a team of physicians, pharmacy, nurses, other ancillary areas, and research staff.
* Discuss current medical treatments, medications, and therapies with medical company representatives and relay this information to medical staff, offering suggestions on the use of new treatments, medications, and therapies.
* Act as principal investigator's representative as appropriate. This may include communicating with private and pharmaceutical company personnel and the clinical research unit.
* Maintain subject database information. May assist in preparing for publication. Work with analysts and assist with queries related to data to evaluate the significance of compiled data.
* Assist investigators with data collection, review of literature, methodology, and writing of abstracts. Investigate literature for general and specific references of interest to the research protocols and conduct library research as needed. Review potential protocols to evaluate their suitability for study.
* Prepare project approval forms necessary for submission to appropriate committees.
* Develop written informed consent forms for new protocols in accordance with FDA regulations. Prepare project approval forms necessary for submission to appropriate committees.
* Assist physician/principal investigator in writing manuscripts for publication and/or presentation of materials at conferences.
* Attend research meetings and conferences as required.
* Provide orientation, information, training/cross\-training, and assistance for new/existing nursing personnel, research assistants, and medical staff to the research activities.
* Participate in staff meetings and in\-service education of nursing and medical staff.
* Maintain adequate inventory of research supplies necessary for research activities. Maintain exam rooms and laboratory.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.
* Valid driver’s license, vehicle, and cell phone are required.

**Qualifications:*** Successful completion/documentation of research training course and BLS certification required.
* High degree of empathy for subjects
* Ability to work independently.
* Demonstrated supervisory and project management skills
* Strong problem\-solving abilities
* Understands OSHA guidelines for handling hazardous biological and chemical materials
* CCRC preferred

**Why Choose Us?*** Comprehensive benefits package
* Monday\-Friday schedule
* CME allowance

Johns Creek is among the fastest\-growing and most desirable communities in North Metro Atlanta, known for excellent schools, family\-friendly neighborhoods, and a large, vibrant South Asian community. The area offers easy access to Atlanta's dining, culture, and outdoor recreation, along with a short commute to Hartsfield\-J

Position Summary

We are seeking an organized, motivated, and detail\-oriented Project Coordinator to join our team. This is a dynamic position for someone who enjoys keeping projects organized, communicating with customers, solving problems, and working with both field and office teams.

As a Project Coordinator, you will play an important role in keeping projects moving from initial planning through completion. You will work directly with clients, field personnel, vendors, and management to help ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget.

This position offers broad exposure to project management, customer service, field operations, administrative processes, and financial coordination, making it a great opportunity for someone looking to expand their project management experience and grow within an established company.

What You'll Do

Project Coordination

You will help manage the day\-to\-day details that keep our projects organized and moving forward.

* Coordinate projects from planning through completion.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, timelines, and budgets.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for customers throughout each project.
* Coordinate field crews, subcontractors, vendors, and internal departments.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify and resolve scheduling or operational issues.
* Track project costs and assist with budget management.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, inspection reports, schedules, and progress reports.
* Assist with reviewing project proposals, pricing, and supporting documentation.

Customer \& Administrative Support

Strong communication and organization are an important part of this role. Responsibilities include:

* Prepare professional correspondence, reports, proposals, and project documentation.
* Coordinate meetings, appointments, and project schedules.
* Maintain organized electronic and paper filing systems.
* Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries.
* Prepare documentation for anchor certification projects.
* Coordinate shipping and receiving of project\-related materials and equipment.
* Assist with company meetings, training sessions, and special events.

Financial Coordination

This position also provides support for several important day\-to\-day financial processes.

* Prepare daily bank deposits.
* Post customer payments in QuickBooks and billing software.
* Support Accounts Receivable with payment reconciliation.
* Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation related to projects.

Office \& Team Support

Because our projects involve multiple departments, the Project Coordinator will also provide cross\-functional support to help keep office and field operations running smoothly.

* Maintain employee records and training documentation.
* Track employee certifications and required training.
* Assist with weekly payroll processing.
* Provide administrative and operational support to other departments as needed.

What We're Looking For

Qualifications

* Previous experience in project coordination, project management, construction administration, or a related field.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service skills and a professional approach to customer communication.
* Ability to prioritize multiple projects and responsibilities while meeting deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple departments.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Experience with QuickBooks or similar accounting software is preferred.
* Experience coordinating construction, building maintenance, or commercial service projects is a plus.
* Experience with Salesforce, ACT!, or other CRM software is beneficial.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in the following areas are especially encouraged to apply:

* Commercial construction.
* Facilities management.
* Building maintenance.
* Commercial service industries.
* Project scheduling and budget tracking.
* Supporting field operations.
* Coordinating multiple crews, vendors, or projects simultaneously.

What We Offer

We offer a professional, team\-oriented environment where you will have the opportunity to work across multiple areas of the business and continue developing your project coordination and management skills.

Benefits include:

* 401(k).
* 401(k) company match.
* Health insurance.
* Dental insurance.
* Vision insurance.
* Life insurance.
* Paid time off.

Why Join Our Team?

This isn't a position where you'll spend your entire day performing the same administrative tasks. You'll be involved in the full project lifecycle, communicate directly with customers, coordinate with field teams, assist with budgets and project documentation, and help solve the day\-to\-day challenges that come with managing active projects.

For someone who is organized, takes initiative, and enjoys seeing a project progress from planning to completion, this role provides an opportunity to develop valuable experience across multiple areas of the business.

If you're looking for a position where you can take ownership, build your project management skills, and make a visible impact on daily operations, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Us:

HBK Engineering, LLC is a fully licensed, professional engineering design firm headquartered in Chicago, IL with a staff approaching 700 individuals. HBK provides civil, environmental, structural, electrical, subsurface utility, construction support services and permitting facilitation. Since our founding in 1998, we have earned a reputation for delivering outstanding, accurate services in extremely time\-sensitive, multilayered environments. That "industry\-recognized" performance has propelled our expansion and the ability to provide engineering services in all 50 states. With 25 offices nationwide, including concentrations in the Midwest and on the Coasts, HBK brings together a dedicated team whose main focus is the design and protection of utilities and utility networks. We have successfully performed engineering work for a complete spectrum of utility infrastructure projects providing solutions and construction support from Coast to Coast in areas ranging from complex urban city centers, to rural greenfields, to limited access rights\-of\-way. In July 2020, HBK Engineering was acquired by Quanta Services. Quanta Services provides infrastructure services for electric power, pipeline, and communications industries and employees over 50,000 people. Quanta’s focus on the utility industry and HBK’s focus on constructability in our designs has made our integration into the Quanta family of companies seamless.
About this Role:

A Project Coordinator at HBK Engineering is a position for professionals with foundational experience in project coordination and utility infrastructure projects. This role builds upon the Associate Project Coordinator responsibilities by requiring utility design and/or coordination experience and familiarity with area agencies, municipalities, and governing jurisdictions. The position involves working as a team member on diverse technical teams while demonstrating a strong desire for career progression and assisting in the growth of project management programs within the organization.
What You'll Do:
* Work as a team member on diverse technical teams involved in engineering design and construction of utility infrastructure
* Solve complicated problems by breaking them down into manageable steps and applying project management methodologies
* Work independently on day\-to\-day tasks and prioritize efforts based on deadlines and project requirements
* Use software to track project performance in an organized and clear manner for internal and external use
* Develop, maintain, and improve tracking metrics related to project design and permitting progress including permit submittals, design and review statuses, client deliverable submittals, and other relevant project metrics
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external teammates for effective collaboration
* Provide support to project team leadership through assistance with project forecasts and analytics
* Support identification of project/program budget, forecast, and authorization concerns early and develop resolutions to meet required project metrics
* Support monitoring of program financial risks and opportunities and provide detailed analysis of variances to budget, quarterly plan, and month\-over\-month variance analysis
* Review external schedules from owners, clients, contract resources, and construction partners
* Monitor and maintain schedules with the project team to meet or exceed client deadlines
* Develop and improve non\-technical program/project procedural documents for operational efficiency
* Coordinate project activities and communications between team members and stakeholders
* Assist with project documentation and reporting requirements
* Apply utility design and coordination experience to enhance project delivery
* Leverage familiarity with area agencies, municipalities, and governing jurisdictions for project success.


What You'll Bring:
* Typically requires bachelor's degree from an ABET/EAC accredited program (substitution of experience and confirmation of meeting qualifications may be extended to non\-degreed individuals on case\-by\-case basis)
* CAPM or PMP licensure recommended
* 3\+ years of relevant experience
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite required to track project performance in an organized and clear manner for internal and external use
* Strong written and verbal communication abilities
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment
* Strong desire for career progression while assisting in the growth of the program
* Utility design and/or coordination experience
* Familiarity with area agencies, municipalities, and governing jurisdictions
* Ability and willingness to learn new Microsoft Office 365 apps for project management purposes
* Problem\-solving skills with ability to break down complex issues into manageable steps
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines
* Attention to detail for accurate tracking and reporting
* Ability to work for prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Ability to lift up to 10 pounds at a time.


What You'll Get:
* Advanced project coordination role with increased responsibility and utility infrastructure expertise
* Professional development in project management methodologies with CAPM/PMP certification support
* Experience with utility design and coordination in real\-world project applications
* Enhanced relationship building with area agencies, municipalities, and governing jurisdictions
* Advanced training in Microsoft Office 365 apps for project management purposes
* Leadership opportunities in program growth and development initiatives
* Experience with complex financial analysis, budget variance tracking, and project forecasting
* Professional development in procedural document creation and process improvement
* Clear career progression pathway within the HBK Organization's Project Management Track

**Organizational Overview**
La Casa Norte serves youth and families confronting homelessness by providing access to stable housing and holistic, culturally responsive services. Our mission is rooted in compassion, dignity, and a commitment to equity. We embrace trauma\-informed, harm reduction, and client\-centered practices to empower individuals and transform communities.
**Position Summary**
The Program Coordinator is a cross\-functional leader who advances the integrity, effectiveness, and continuous improvement of case management services across all La Casa Norte programs. This role provides leadership, technical guidance, training, and strategic support to case managers and supervisors, while fostering consistent, high\-quality, client\-centered approaches across housing, shelter, and support services.
This position will offer enhanced support for complex, high\-intensity clients and provides coverage during staff absences or vacancies, or to launch new programs. In the absence of a Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator may also exercise designated authority to support team operations, reinforce accountability, and ensure continuity of service.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Direct Support and Temporary Caseloads**
* Provide direct client services on a temporary basis to maintain service continuity during staff transitions, support participants with significant barriers requiring advanced coordination, and/or temporarily manage a caseload in newly launched programs until permanent staff is onboarded.
* Provide intensive, client\-centered case management rooted in Harm Reduction and Trauma\-Informed Care.
* Ensure any direct service provided aligns with the organization’s commitment to client\-led, flexible, and holistic care.
* Provide support when the supervisor is unavailable for crisis situations, high\-need clients, and unexpected walk\-ins.


**Leadership and Practice Development**
* Provide expert guidance and coaching to case managers and supervisors across programs, strengthening clinical judgment, service planning, and engagement strategies.
* Promote fidelity to harm reduction, trauma\-informed care, and housing\-first approaches.
* Serve as a thought partner to program leadership, helping shape service delivery frameworks and quality standards.

* Support implementation of new tools, service models, or policy updates through structured staff development.
