* Provides real\-time direction, support and supervision to assigned case managers and program staff.
* Participates in hiring processes and makes candidate selection recommendations.
* Has the authority to issue verbal and written disciplinary actions, including corrective action plans.
* Assists with investigations into policy violations and recommends or initiates appropriate disciplinary responses in consultation with HR.
* Reviews staff performance provides coaching and support and contributes to annual performance evaluations.
* Approves time\-off requests and ensures adequate shift and program coverage.


**Strategic Projects and Stakeholder Engagement**
* Participate in or lead strategic initiatives that impact case management practice, such as process improvement pilots, interagency collaborations, or compliance redesign.
* Represent La Casa Norte in community forums or stakeholder meetings when assigned.
* Provide oversight or coordination of contracted services related to case management, when applicable.


**Quality Assurance and Compliance**
* Support the periodic review of case documentation, service plans, and outcomes data to ensure quality, consistency, and funder compliance.
* Assist in resolving systemic barriers to service delivery, supporting continuous improvement across teams.
* Promote equity in service access and delivery through culturally responsive case management practices.


**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, or a related field *or* at least four (4\) years of relevant case management experience.
* Minimum of one year of direct case management experience working with individuals and families who are homeless, at risk of homelessness, or otherwise marginalized.

* Demonstrated experience coaching, mentoring, or training peers or interdisciplinary teams.
* Strong working knowledge of housing first, harm reduction, and trauma\-informed care principles.
* Reliable personal vehicle, proof of insurance, and a valid driver’s license.
* Ability to work flexibly across multiple programs and physical sites as needed.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills.


**Preferred:**

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
You get to create, execute, and keep the work moving.  

  

Roadrunner is the most tech\-forward company in LTL. We built a proprietary Smart Network™ that delivers fewer touches, faster transit, real\-time visibility, and real accountability. The service is differentiated. The point of view is clear. Marketing has not yet fully translated that advantage into how the brand shows up every day—on the website, in social, in video, in events, and in the materials our teams use.  

  

That’s the opportunity. Reporting to the Marketing Manager, you will be the creative force and operational backbone of the marketing team. You will design, film, write, organize, and ship. You will bring campaigns to life through compelling visual content, tight planning, and cross\-platform execution. You will keep initiatives on\-brand, on deadline, and running smoothly in a lean, PE\-backed environment that rewards ownership and speed.
**What you’ll do**
==================

**1\. Content Creation \& Brand Presence**
------------------------------------------


This is a creation role, not a maintenance role. You make the brand visible.

* Design and produce marketing materials using Canva and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) for digital and print campaigns.
* Invent and ship high\-impact visual content that advances Roadrunner as the Category of One—graphics, sales collateral, social assets, landing\-page visuals, event materials, and campaign creative.
* Create video and photo content. Appear on camera when needed and direct shoots that capture authentic customer stories, owner\-operator voices, and company culture.
* Support Roadrunner’s LinkedIn and social presence with content that is sharp, human, and on\-brand—not generic freight marketing.
* Shape how the brand shows up across digital, physical, and experiential touchpoints so every interaction reinforces that Roadrunner is leading the way.

**2\. Campaign Execution \& Coordination**
------------------------------------------


The Marketing Manager owns the strategy. You make the machine run.

* Coordinate with vendors, internal stakeholders, sales, talent acquisition, and the marketing team to execute multi\-channel campaigns on time.
* Support integrated campaigns across digital, social, email, content, events, and emerging channels that drive awareness, pipeline, and talent outcomes.
* Treat every campaign as an experiment. Track what shipped, what worked, and what needs to change. Document what you learn.
* Produce materials and communications for strategic customer accounts based on direction from leadership and the Marketing Manager.

**3\. Website, Social \& Digital Presence**
-------------------------------------------


Keep the public face of the brand fresh, usable, and current.

* Manage and update the website CMS so content is accurate, optimized, and user\-friendly.
* Support social media content creation and campaign execution across platforms—planning, producing, scheduling, and reporting.
* Help build and maintain landing pages and digital experiences that match Roadrunner’s voice and convert attention into action.
* Use AI tools to accelerate production without sacrificing quality, voice, or point of view.

**4\. Calendar, Systems \& Operational Support**
------------------------------------------------


You are the detail\-oriented backbone. Nothing falls through the cracks.

* Own the marketing calendar and project\-management systems. Keep deadlines visible. Keep work moving.
* Help maintain reusable content resources, brand guidelines, and AI prompt frameworks so internal teams can produce on\-brand materials without bottlenecks.
* Apply AI and automation to recurring production and administrative work—reducing manual effort and shortening turnaround time.
* Track marketing expenses and assist with budget reconciliation.
* Identify friction in how marketing work gets done, then fix it with process, templates, and tools that stick.

**5\. Talent, Owner\-Operator \& Culture Content**
--------------------------------------------------


Attract the right people. Help them stay. Make the culture visible.

* Produce recruitment marketing creative that attracts high\-quality CDL drivers, owner operators, and key employees.
* Create targeted assets and content for owner\-operator acquisition and retention campaigns.
* Partner with talent acquisition and operations to support employee recruiting with clear, compelling materials.
* Capture and produce culture content—photos, video, recognition assets, newsletter visuals—that reinforces We Run Safe. We Run Smart. We Run Together.
* Support internal communications with polished, on\-brand assets so employees and owner operators feel informed and seen.

**What you bring**
==================

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Sales \& Business Operations Coordinator**
--------------------------------------------


**Location:** Chicago, IL  

**Experience:** Entry Level / Recent Graduates


**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------


LeadsIQ is looking for a smart, driven, and highly organized recent graduate to join our team as a Sales \& Business Operations Coordinator.


This is a unique entry\-level opportunity designed for someone who ultimately wants to build a career in **sales, business development, analytics, or strategic partnerships**, but first wants to develop a strong understanding of how the entire business operates.


For your first 3–6 months, you'll work closely with senior leaders across LeadsIQ, supporting the day\-to\-day needs of the business while gaining hands\-on exposure to sales, client relationships, analytics, performance marketing, and operations.


You'll help manage schedules, prepare client presentations, organize meetings, research opportunities, analyze data, and support senior leaders wherever needed.


The goal is simple: **learn the business from the ground up and develop into a contributor within LeadsIQ's sales and analytics organization.**


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Work directly alongside senior LeadsIQ leaders and gain exposure to multiple areas of the business.
* Manage calendars, schedules, meetings, and day\-to\-day coordination for senior team members.
* Help prepare client presentations, sales materials, reports, and meeting materials.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings and ensure senior leaders are prepared with the information they need.
* Conduct research on prospective clients, partners, competitors, industries, and new business opportunities.
* Assist with CRM management, pipeline tracking, follow\-ups, and sales organization.
* Sit in on client calls, sales meetings, partnership discussions, and internal strategy meetings.
* Take notes, track action items, and help ensure projects and opportunities continue moving forward.
* Support the team with Excel analysis, reporting, and performance tracking.
* Learn how LeadsIQ evaluates customer acquisition opportunities, partnerships, and new business verticals.
* Help senior leaders with ad hoc projects across sales, analytics, marketing, and business operations.
* Gradually take on more responsibility as you develop your understanding of the business.


**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* Recent graduate or approximately 0–2 years of professional experience.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Analytics, Communications, or a related field.
* Strong work ethic and willingness to do whatever is needed to help the team succeed.
* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Analytical mindset and comfort working with numbers.
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.
* Interest in sales, business development, analytics, and understanding how companies grow.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives, clients, and external partners.
* Curious and eager to understand how different parts of a business work together.
* Coachable and willing to take feedback.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced environment where responsibilities can change quickly.
* Competitive and motivated by growth, responsibility, and results.


**The First 3–6 Months**
------------------------


This role is intentionally designed to provide broad exposure to LeadsIQ.


You'll spend your first several months working alongside senior leaders and supporting the business wherever needed. Rather than immediately being placed into a narrow function, you'll learn how LeadsIQ operates across:


* Sales and business development
* Client relationships
* Performance marketing and customer acquisition
* Analytics and reporting
* Strategic partnerships
* Business operations
* New market and vertical expansion


You'll see how opportunities are identified, how client relationships are built, how deals are evaluated, and how data influences business decisions.


**Career Growth**
-----------------


This position is designed to be a **starting point, not a long\-term coordinator role**.


As you learn the business and demonstrate your strengths, the goal is for you to transition into a larger contributor position within LeadsIQ.


Depending on your interests, performance, and skill set, that could mean developing into a role focused on:


**Sales \& Business Development** — prospecting, building relationships, managing a pipeline, negotiating partnerships, and closing new business.


**Analytics \& Strategy** — analyzing performance, identifying trends, evaluating opportunities, and using data to help drive business decisions.


We're looking for someone who wants to come in, work hard, learn from experienced leaders, understand the business from the ground up, and earn the opportunity to take on significantly more responsibility.

jobs.description:
American Armor Gloves is hiring its first VA Regional Sales Representatives to build out a dedicated sales function for VA healthcare accounts. This is a new sales team, not a new company — AAG has spent years developing the manufacturing capacity, quality systems, and early government relationships this role is built to take advantage of.


**The Opportunity**
===================



This is a new role, but it isn't a cold start. AAG has already done much of the groundwork required to sell into government and VA healthcare: compliant manufacturing, a quality system built for regulated buyers, and early relationships with VA stakeholders. What hasn't existed until now is a dedicated sales representative to develop that opportunity fully within an assigned VA region. You'll be one of the first five or six people to hold this role, working from an established foundation rather than starting from nothing.


**What You'll Own**
===================


* Sales development and account management for VA facilities, CBOCs, and healthcare systems within your assigned region.
* Relationships with the people who make purchasing decisions — Chiefs of Logistics, procurement leads, and clinical stakeholders.
* A territory pipeline you build and manage yourself, from first contact through closed business, navigating VA purchasing processes along the way.

Base salary plus commission, structured to be competitive with current market data for government and federal healthcare sales roles, with uncapped upside as your territory develops. jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative- Advertising Executive (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Compensation:** Draw \+ Lucrative Commission \+ Performance Incentives

 **The Opportunity**


Are you a self\-motivated "hunter" who thrives on variety? Guide Book Publishing, an industry leader since 1991, is looking for a strategic Advertising Account Executive. Unlike traditional sales roles where you call the same list for years, our team moves to a **new assignment every 2\-3 weeks**, helping local businesses across 24 states reach "micro\-communities" through high\-quality direct\-mail advertising.

 **How it Works**

* **The Workflow:** You’ll switch assignments frequently, focusing on businesses within a 3\-5 mile radius of a specific congregation or community center.
* **The Method:** 70% of your time is spent on high\-energy outreach (phone, email, and video meetings); 20% on market research; and 10% on contract execution.
* **The Flexibility:** This is a remote role, but does require getting your materials back to the Post Office to return to the Home Office.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **New Business Development:** Identify and close new advertising partnerships to meet production goals.
* **Consultative Sales:** Educate local business owners on the ROI of being featured in our community guides and directories.
* **Relationship Management:** Act as the primary liaison between your clients and our operations staff to ensure an excellent experience.
* **Account Growth:** Nurture and maintain large\-scale accounts within your metro area.
* **Administrative Precision:** Manage contracts and paperwork accurately and return assignment materials via USPS upon completion.

 **Compensation \& Benefits**


We offer a structure that rewards high performers and provides security through a comprehensive benefits package via ADP TotalSource.

* **Draw \& Commission:** Payroll is based on "Cash In" from sales, with a Draw program available to stabilize income as you build your funnel.
* **Performance Bonuses:** Additional incentive pay for hitting Assignment, Monthly, Quarterly, and Annual targets.
* **Benefits:**
	+ Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
	+ 401(k) with Company Match
	+ Life Insurance
	+ Paid Time Off (PTO)

 **Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 1\-2 years of sales experience preferred (or equivalent education).
* **Mindset:** A self\-starter who can manage their own schedule without being micromanaged.
* **Skills:** Proficient in Excel, scanning, email, and PDF management. Strong ability to calculate discounts and commissions accurately.
* **Communication:** Persuasive verbal skills and clear, professional written communication.
* **Requirements:** Valid Driver’s License and Auto Insurance.

 **Why Guide Book Publishing?**


We serve the communication needs of over 800 micro\-communities. If you are looking for a role that balances the freedom of remote work with the fast\-paced nature of community\-based sales, we want to talk to you.

 **Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

* Requires Valid Driver’s License and Auto Insurance
* Frequently required to sit and utilize a keyboard and phone.
  

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Security Technology and Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**OUR MISSION \& IMPACT**



Illinois Holocaust Museum \& Education Center (IHMEC) honors Survivors and victims of the Holocaust by teaching universal lessons that combat hatred, prejudice, and indifference. The Museum activates this mission through world\-class exhibitions, public programming, and educational initiatives to equip audiences with knowledge, skills, and courage to take a stand for humanity. Today, IHMEC is the third largest Holocaust museum in the world and second largest in the country, impacting hundreds of thousands of students, teachers, law enforcement and community members annually. As a world leader in connecting the history and lessons of the Holocaust, we inspire visitors to become Upstanders, who speak out for what’s right – turning powerful lessons of history into positive actions today.

  


**THE POSITION**



Position Title: Security Technology and Operations Coordinator



Location: Skokie, IL and Chicago, IL



Reports To: Associate Director of Security Operations

  

The Security Technology and Operations Coordinator serves as the primary day\-to\-day resource for the Museum's security technology environment and provides operational support to the Associate Director of Security Operations. The Coordinator helps ensure the effective operation of security systems, security programs, and departmental activities. This is a non\-exempt, full\-time onsite position that requires one weekend day and occasional evening availability.

 **SPECIFIC** **KEY** **RESPONSIBILITIES**



* Monitor, test, maintain, and coordinate repairs, upgrades, and vendor support for security technology systems.
* Coordinate with IT, Facilities, and external vendors to ensure the effective operation of access control, CCTV, and other security technologies.
* Recommend technology enhancements and assist in developing policies, procedures, and standards related to security systems.
* Support daily security operations, staffing coordination, event security, and visitor and employee protection initiatives.
* Assist with incident response, post\-order development, after\-action reviews, and emergency preparedness activities, drills, and exercises.
* Maintain active involvement in frontline security operations to ensure technology solutions effectively support operational needs.

  




**THE PERSON**


**E****ducation****\|** **Experience**


* Minimum of 2\+ years of experience with administering security systems, such as video surveillance systems, access control systems, intrusion, and alarm systems.
* College Degree preferred.
* Must pass a thorough criminal background check.
* Availability to work a flexible schedule including one weekend day and occasional evenings.

 **Knowledge** **\|** **Skills** **\|** **Abilities**


* Working knowledge of security technology and investigations, security communication systems, alarm and video surveillance systems.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with Microsoft Office and related applications.

  


**OTHER INFORMATION**


**Salary** **and Benefits**


* Salary Range is $50,000\-$60,000
* Generous benefits, including medical/vision/dental coverage, paid time off, and retirement plan contributions, among other industry\-leading benefits.


**Committed to Diversity**



Illinois Holocaust Museum \& Education Center is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. People of color, women, LGBTQ\+ people, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.


**Physical Requirements**



Able to stand for extended periods of time; Ability to climb up and down stairs; to bend, stoop, and lift or move materials; to pull/push, lift, and carry up to 25 pounds; and to reach both above and below shoulder height.


**Learn More**



Visit our website, engage in virtual experiences, and learn more at ilholocaustmuseum.org.

**Summary**

**About the Project:**  
Supercharged is seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented Freelance Project Coordinator to support our growing Roadshow team. This role will provide critical coordination, project administration, data management, and workflow support across multiple concurrent clusters, activations, partners, vendors, and deliverables.

The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in a fast\-moving, project\-based environment and is exceptionally comfortable keeping information organized, following up on open items, maintaining accurate project records, and making sure deadlines and deliverables stay on track.

**This is a hands\-on coordination role for someone who enjoys bringing structure and visibility to complex projects.**

**What You'll Do:**

* Support maintenance of our project\-management foundation across Egnyte, Airtable, Teamwork, Slack, Iconik, and CoreCRM, ensuring the Roadshow team can consistently locate accurate information, resources, and deliverables.
* Provide additional bandwidth as the Roadshow grows, helping the team manage multiple clusters, activations, partners, vendors, and reporting requirements without sacrificing organization, accuracy, or delivery quality.
* Prepare and maintain reporting and activation records by auditing metadata, hyperlinks, statuses, task comments, cluster records, stop records, and activation records against established requirements.
* Reinforce standardized workflows and delivery timelines by facilitating repeatable processes, applying due dates, preparing resources, and maintaining weekly update cadences across clusters and activations.
* Increase accountability and visibility by proactively identifying missing deliverables, overdue tasks, incomplete metadata, unresolved Slack threads, and other gaps before they create downstream delays.
* Relieve Roadshow leadership and project staff of high\-volume administrative and data\-management work so they can focus on production, stakeholder management, strategy, and core Roadshow execution.
* Coordinate information across platforms and workstreams, ensuring corresponding records, folders, reports, tasks, contacts, and creative assets are accurately linked and reflect consistent project information.
* Conduct regular quality\-control checks to identify inconsistencies, missing information, or outdated records.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders and project owners to obtain missing information and keep workstreams moving.
* Maintain a high level of organization and accuracy across a fast\-changing portfolio of projects.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 2\+ years of experience in project coordination, project administration, marketing operations, agency operations, event/experiential production, or a similar role.
* Experience supporting multiple projects, workstreams, clients, activations, or stakeholders simultaneously.
* Exceptional organizational and time\-management skills with a strong attention to detail.
* Ability to proactively identify gaps and follow through until issues are resolved.
* Comfortable working across multiple project\-management, collaboration, CRM, and file\-management platforms.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of assigned workflows.
* Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
* Strong follow\-up skills and a high level of accountability.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Experience with tools such as Airtable, Teamwork, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, ClickUp, Slack, or similar platforms is highly valued.
* Experience in events, experiential marketing, creative agencies, sports, entertainment, media, lifestyle, or marketing\*\* is strongly preferred.

**Location \& Time Zone:**

* **Candidates must be located in California and work within the Pacific Time Zone** (PST/PDT).
* **Please do not apply if you are not currently located in California** or are unable to consistently work Pacific Time hours.

**NOTE:**

* If selected for this role the client will run a background check.
* Please be prepared to be responsive to interview request within 24 hours.

**Success in This Role:**

Success in this role means the Roadshow team can rely on you to keep project information accurate, organized, connected, and current; identify issues before they become problems; maintain momentum across deadlines and deliverables; and provide the administrative and coordination support that allows the broader team to focus on executing exceptional Roadshow experiences.

If you are someone who naturally creates order, loves a well\-maintained project tracker, follows up relentlessly, and can keep many moving pieces organized at once, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $35\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**



Under the general supervision of the Executive Director and Program Principal Investigator, the INSPIRE Programs Coordinator will manage the day\-to\-day operations of CDU’s growing portfolio of INSPIRE community\-based research programs—INSPIRE Faith, INSPIRE CA, and INSPIRE USA. The Coordinator serves as the primary operational point of contact across these programs, combining research\-program coordination, community relationship\-building, and oversight of the digital engagement and data\-capture platforms (in partnership with the technology team) that enable the programs to operate at scale. The role blends hands\-on, place\-based community partnership (primarily through INSPIRE Faith) with the coordination of predominantly online, largely automated statewide, and national programs. A central purpose of the role is to strengthen community trust in research and to broaden the participation of Black/African American/Hispanic communities and other communities of color in clinical research and trials, ensuring that community voice and priorities shape how the work is designed and carried out.



About the Center:



The Charles R. Drew University of Medicine and Science (CDU), a partner in the UCLA Clinical and Translational Science Institute (CTSI) alongside UCLA and Cedars\-Sinai, is building a community\-centered clinical research enterprise through its Clinical and Translational Research Center (CTRC) in South Los Angeles. The INSPIRE programs are a family of community\-based research initiatives advancing health and brain health across diverse populations. INSPIRE Faith is a deep, place\-based partnership with faith institutions requiring regular in\-person engagement with community partners; INSPIRE CA, and INSPIRE USA are digitally delivered, largely automated programs conducted primarily online, with select live sessions led by physicians and study staff. Together they build on CDU’s longstanding legacy of community engagement and health\-equity research.

  



This work advances a national commitment to health equity: expanding access to healthcare in underserved communities, building lasting trust between communities of color and the healthcare system, and increasing the participation of Black/African American communities and other communities of color in research and clinical trials. As a historically Black graduate institution, CDU pursues these goals in partnership with peer institutions and community organizations, treating community relationships not as a means of recruitment but as the foundation of research that is shaped by, accountable to, and beneficial for the communities it serves. The INSPIRE Programs Coordinator is central to this mission, serving as the trusted community bridge that connects faith and community partners to research and trial opportunities and helps ensure that the science reflects the priorities of the community.


**Essential Duties**


* Manage the day\-to\-day operations and coordination of the INSPIRE research programs (Faith, CA, and USA), ensuring each program runs smoothly, on schedule, and in alignment with study protocols and the Center’s mission
* Coordinate in\-person activities for INSPIRE Faith—anticipated at approximately two days per week of on\-site engagement with community partners—and support the logistics of live sessions conducted by physicians and study staff across all programs, including scheduling, participant coordination, and event execution.
* Coordinate and support program staff, students, and volunteers across the INSPIRE programs, including onboarding, task coordination, and training
* Support participant recruitment, retention, and outreach across programs, including coordinating culturally appropriate promotional and educational materials (in collaboration with the communications team)
* Attend community meetings, faith\-partner gatherings, health events, and program activities as needed to represent the INSPIRE programs and CDU
* Oversee the online engagement platform, participant communications, scheduled calls, and data\-capture elements for the digitally delivered programs (INSPIRE CA, and USA), coordinating closely with the technology team to ensure the platforms function reliably and participant data is captured accurately and securely.
* Monitor program metrics, participant engagement, and feedback to assess effectiveness, support quality improvement, and inform recommendations to program leadership
* Establish and support Faith Community Advisory Boards across Los Angeles, coordinating the formation of one board in 2026 and several additional boards by 2028\. Each board is a governance body of no more than 11 faith leaders drawn from partnering faith institutions, guiding program direction, protocol input, and community voice at the faith\-partner level.
	+ The Coordinator organizes board recruitment, scheduling, meeting logistics, and ongoing stewardship.
* Recruit, onboard, and support Community Navigators from partnering faith institutions, growing the Navigator corps to 50 by the end of 2026 and more than 500 by the end of 2028\. new_jobs.title: Navigator/ Outreach Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

**Legal Name of Agency:** Central City Neighborhood Partners

**Position Title:** Navigator/ Outreach Coordinator

**Reports to:** 

Financial Empowerment Manager

**Hours and Benefits:** This is a full\-time, on\-site position offering an hourly rate of $19\-$22, based on experience, with an expected commitment of 40 hours per week. The role includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical and dental coverage, paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave.

**ORGANIZATIONAL/PROGRAM BACKGROUND:**

Central City Neighborhood Partners (CCNP) was established in 1994 and incorporated as a formal non\-profit collaborative in 2000 to address the socio\-economic conditions impacting low\-income families living in the City of Los Angeles, with a focus on Westlake and surrounding communities. and expanding to Koreatown in 2024\. With the mission of catalyzing partnerships to systemically address the multiple challenges facing low\-income families, CCNP works with its partners to help families create pathways to financial security and economic opportunity through our FamilySource Center (FSC) program, financial asset\-building programs and other signature programs.

**Position Overview:**

The Outreach Coordinator is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing strategic outreach initiatives to connect with and serve individuals and communities impacted by specific events or conditions such as the fires. This role requires building strong relationships with community stakeholders and partners to ensure the effective delivery of information and resources. The person is responsible for active recruitment of individuals to CCNP programs, specifically recruiting eligible individuals to participate in financial and career development.

**Outreach Coordinator** will perform a broad range of duties spanning the full employment cycle, including, but not limited to providing support and/or monitoring of the following

* Warmly welcome clients and provide information and referrals based on client needs;
* Anticipate, meet and exceed client needs by maintaining a current working knowledge of all programs, activities and procedures;
* Develop and implement strategic outreach plans tailored to the needs of impacted populations.
* Lead workshops and trainings to the general public and offer 1\-1 navigation support
* Build and maintain relationships with community leaders, organizations, government agencies, and other stakeholders.
* Create and distribute outreach materials such as brochures, flyers, and newsletters, and graphics that can be ready to post on social media
* Work with internal teams to align outreach strategies with overall organizational goals and respond to public inquiries.
* Attend community outreach events, job fairs, and other events to promote the financial and career coaching opportunities.
* Assist in the preparation of all outreach material for distribution in the community
* Additional tasks, projects and responsibilities as assigned by supervisor and executive leadership.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Savvy and energetic with ability to outreach, connect and engage the community in activities;
* Ability to instruct and present ideas, rules and activities in a clear and comprehensive manner;
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills required, ability to multi\-task, and the ability to fill\-in for co\-workers as the work schedule requires;
* Must be able to cultivate teamwork, exercise good judgment and be comfortable working with partners, staff and clients of diverse backgrounds and circumstances;
* Must be a self\-starter, have initiative, excellent follow\-through skills and problem\-solving capacity;
* Commitment to the mission and goals of CCNP.

new_jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator / Client Experience Advocate - Plastic Surgery
new_jobs.description:
**About the Opportunity**
Adoreal works with a small number of leading aesthetic and cosmetic medicine practices, giving them the technology, operational support, and talent they need as they grow. We are hiring on behalf of one of those partners, a plastic surgery practice in Santa Monica, for a Patient Care Coordinator (PCC) / Client Experience Advocate (CEA).


Adoreal partners with a select group of top\-tier aesthetic and cosmetic medicine practices, providing the technology, operational support, and talent that help them deliver an exceptional patient experience while they scale. We are recruiting on behalf of one of our partner practices, a high\-end, luxury plastic surgery practice based in California.


**About The Role**
This is a patient care coordination and client experience role. You own the patient relationship from the first phone call through consultation, treatment, and everything after. It is not a front desk job. A separate front\-office team handles reception, check\-in, and the day\-to\-day running of the office, and you will work alongside them.


What matters most here is the conversation itself. You find out what a patient actually wants, talk openly about options and pricing, and help them reach a decision they feel settled about, whether that decision is yes or no. Do that well and patients come back for years and send their friends. It suits someone who is at their best one\-on\-one and who follows up when they said they would.


Key Responsibilities**Inquiry \& Consultation Intake**

* Handle incoming inquiries by phone, email, and social. The first call sets the tone, so ask real questions and find out what the patient is actually after.
* Turn those inquiries into booked consultations, and send patients in prepared so they are not hearing everything for the first time in the room.
* Keep notes current in the practice EMR and CRM. A patient history, goals, and hesitations should not have to be rediscovered at the next visit.

**Patient Care Coordination**

* Be the person patients call, from consultation through surgery, recovery, and follow\-up.
* Walk patients through pre\-op and post\-op instructions and answer the questions they are nervous to ask.
* Coordinate with the surgeon and other treatment providers, and clinical staff, so nothing falls between them.
* Follow up to confirm appointments and check on recovery, before a patient has to chase you.

**Client Experience \& Practice Growth (CEA)**

* Present treatment plans, pricing, and financing clearly, so patients can decide with the full picture in front of them.
* Run the consultation conversation with structure. Understand the goal, address hesitations head on and help every patient throughout their decision\-making process.
* Follow up on a real schedule with patients who need time to think. Consultative, never pushy, but nobody should go quiet in your pipeline because you forgot about them.
* Keep track of your own pipeline of prospective patients, from first inquiry to booking, in the practice CRM.
* Help them navigate financing options such as CareCredit and Cherry.
* Help with reputation management by asking happy patients for reviews and handling any service complaint quickly.
* Protect patient privacy and hold the standard of discretion a practice like this depends on.

  

**Requirements**  

* You live in or near Santa Monica. This role is on\-site.
* Polished, presentable, and professional in appearance and demeanor at all times.
* Organized and diligent, and comfortable holding several patients, schedules, and priorities in your head at once.
* Comfortable talking about value. Pricing, treatment plans, and financing come up constantly, and how you handle those conversations shapes whether patients go ahead.
* You see what needs doing and do it, rather than waiting to be told.
* Genuinely at ease in a clinical setting and around patients.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with a warm, client\-service instinct.
* Prior experience as a patient coordinator, treatment coordinator, or client experience advocate in plastic surgery, dermatology, a medspa, or a similar aesthetics setting.
* Formal consultative sales training in aesthetics or elective medicine is a strong plus, as is a track record of owning the consult\-to\-booking process.
* Familiarity with aesthetics EMR, CRM, and scheduling software helps, but we can teach the software.

  

**Benefits** **Adoreal is helping our partner plastic surgery practice fill a position internally. This position is not with Adoreal directly.**

**We provide the operational, marketing, and growth infrastructure that empowers surgeons to focus on what they do best: delivering exceptional patient care and outcomes.**

 **By combining innovative business strategies with world\-class clinical talent, Adoreal enables clinics and surgeons to thrive in today’s competitive elective medicine landscape.**

Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world's health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem \- including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient's request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.  

  

By joining Datavant today, you're stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.


We're looking for a Marketing Specialist with a knack for operational excellence \- someone who brings order to standard operating procedures, cross\-format production support, and the knowledge systems that keep the team's collateral and institutional knowledge organized and accessible.



This role is responsible for documenting and maintaining how the team works, coordinating production of marketing assets across formats including video, one\-pagers, and design collateral, and serving as the team's go\-to for Airtable, building and maintaining the systems that organize the team's work, content, and knowledge management.

* Hands\-on Airtable experience required \- comfortable building bases, views, and automations, not only using existing ones.
* Strong process orientation and organizational instincts.
* Digitally savvy, with the ability to learn new tools quickly.

new_jobs.title: Creator Content & Partnerships Associate Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Disney Entertainment segment includes the company's full portfolio of entertainment media and content businesses globally, including streaming.


The Creator Content \& Partnerships team oversees the strategy and execution of paid and organic influencer campaigns to amplify digital marketing efforts across The Walt Disney Studios (and wider TWDC). Our Creative Strategy, Influencer Relations and Campaign Execution teams lead full\-service, 360\-marketing solutions partnering with relevant, brand safe influencers for various activations – custom content, premieres, experiential events, mailers, etc. Using industry best practices and innovative strategies, this team is tasked with developing and delivering engaging and impactful creator content at scale.

**Job Overview:**


The Creator Content \& Partnerships Associate Manager supports the development and execution of creator marketing initiatives across The Walt Disney Company. This role contributes to the creative development of creator campaigns from audience research and insights through campaign execution, helping ensure programs are culturally relevant, innovative, and aligned with business objectives across Disney's portfolio of brands.


As a member of the Disney Entertainment Creator Marketing team, the Associate Manager supports creative strategy, campaign ideation, creator communications, and execution across assigned initiatives. Working collaboratively with internal stakeholders and external partners, this role helps execute creator campaigns across earned, owned, and paid channels while maintaining creative consistency and brand integrity.


Supporting the evolving entertainment and creator landscape, this role leverages audience insights, cultural trends, and performance data to inform creator marketing strategies and identify opportunities to engage audiences. This role also contributes to the creator vertical content pipeline on Disney\+, helping integrate creator content initiatives into broader partnership strategies. Through collaboration, creativity, and strong execution, the Associate Manager supports the continued growth and success of Disney's creator marketing efforts.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Campaign Project Management and Execution**, including maintaining relationships with external platform teams, influencer talent, talent reps and agencies, and supporting the successful execution of creator partnerships and campaign activations across earned, owned, and paid channels.
* **Collaborate with Influencer Team Leads** (Talent Relations and Creative Strategy) to determine creative and program strategy, contributing to campaign ideation, strategic frameworks, creative concepts, and best practices that help optimize campaign performance.
* **Support creative development from research through execution**, contributing to creator campaigns from audience research and insights through delivery while helping ensure programs are culturally relevant, innovative, brand safe, and aligned with business objectives across Disney's portfolio of brands.
* **Maintain creative consistency and brand integrity**, ensuring creator content authentically reflects Disney's brands and storytelling standards throughout campaign planning and creative development.
* **Monitor the creator landscape**, tracking emerging platforms, creator trends, digital behaviors, and cultural trends—and applying audience insights and performance data—to inform creator marketing strategies and support campaign planning and content development.
* **Contribute to the creator vertical content pipeline on Disney\+,** helping integrate creator content initiatives into broader partnership strategies.
* **Create reporting presentations and compile campaign performance metrics**. Evaluate and help maintain the team's campaign database and metrics records to drive valuable insights.
* **Develop presentations and materials for cross\-functional teams and leadership**, including creative recommendations, campaign narratives, and performance recaps.
* **Partner across functions**—working closely with Campaign Strategy, Marketing, Events, Publicity, Production, and other internal partners—to improve creative workflows, support creator discovery and brainstorming sessions, and evolve campaign processes that strengthen creator collaboration, improve efficiency, and drive audience engagement.

* At least 3 year's experience in the digital space with a focus on influencer/creator marketing or media campaigns and strategy
* Proven track record working with influencer talent (digital and/or traditional) and talent representatives. Ideally has relationships or experience fostering relationships with talent management teams (agents, managers, publicists) across different industries.
* Experience with and knowledge of short\-form video platforms Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and Snapchat. Familiarity with back\-end publishing and platform analytics tools (i.e. metrics, paid media).
* Experience working with legal and finance partners to facilitate contracting and vendor payments.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem\-solving skills, able to strategize marketing initiatives while navigating changing digital landscapes and influencer relationships.
* Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communicator and collaborator able to manage programs with teams of diverse working and communication styles.
* Organized and strong project manager able to execute multiple projects simultaneously with high level of attention to detail.
* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of experience.

MGT is a leading provider of technology and advisory solutions serving state, local, and education government agencies (SLED) across the United States. Through client partnerships, MGT’s almost 1,200 employees impact communities for good by managing and securing critical networks, solving complex human capital and fiscal problems, elevating education systems, and advancing equity as a performance imperative. * Utilize a consultative sales approach to understand prospects' business issues, provide demonstrations, and create custom sales proposals.
* Exceed sales performance goals by addressing the specific business needs of each customer.
* Work collaboratively with employees in the sales function and cross\-functional teams to ensure success.
* Effectively manage relationships with partners, driving growth within new accounts and existing customers. Provide regular updates on sales forecast and pipeline information using SFDC or other CRM tools.
**What You Will Bring*** 8\+ Years experience with a track record of exceeding assigned sales quotas in multiple, continuous years.
* You are someone with an entrepreneurial spirit with an affinity for collaboration and teamwork.
* You come with a keen ability to land new accounts and expand your current customers within your assigned territory.
* You are extremely organized, with deep knowledge of territory planning and strategy.
* You have an aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems as well as the competitive landscape.
* Ability to communicate with senior managers about their business challenges and Nutanix data management storage solutions.
* You have strong verbal and written communications skills including presentation skills.
* You have a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
**Work Arrangement****Remote**: This position is primarily remote. There is no specific in\-office requirement, however, there may be circumstances where you may be required to come into a local office for a specific purpose, and/or to travel to other locations based on business needs.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $254,000 and USD $ 380,000 per year.

However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign\-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

new_jobs.title: Community Manager (Fremont)
new_jobs.description:
**About ArtHaus Properties**### **The expanded ArtHaus Properties operating company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Arthaus Partners, purpose\-built to manage and scale our vertically integrated residential platform. This role offers a rare opportunity to help shape the future of operations at a company on the verge of doubling its footprint, bringing structure, innovation, and excellence to a portfolio with significant near\-term growth ahead. It’s an exciting moment to lead, build, and leave your mark.**

 **About the role**  

The Community Manager is responsible for the overall performance and financial success of the assigned community. This role leads the onsite team and ensures that leasing, maintenance, resident relations, and financial operations meet company standards. The Community Manager drives occupancy, revenue growth, resident satisfaction, and compliance with all ArtHaus policies and local regulations.


This role will be responsible for about 166 units.

 **Primary Responsibilities**### **Leadership and Team Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop the onsite team to deliver consistent, high\-quality performance.
* Conduct weekly staff meetings to align goals, review KPIs, and address challenges.
* Maintain engagement and retention, targeting voluntary turnover below 15% annually.
* Partner with Area and Regional leadership on recruiting, onboarding, and professional development.
* Use weekly dashboards and KPI tools to track accountability, celebrate wins, and identify early performance gaps.
* Ensure full utilization of ArtHaus’ digital and AI platforms for leasing, maintenance, and communication.

### **Operational Excellence**

* Oversee day\-to\-day community operations in compliance with company policies and Fair Housing laws.
* Conduct daily property inspections for curb appeal, cleanliness, safety, and compliance.
* Maintain average unit turn times of five business days or less.
* Ensure emergency work orders are responded to within 2 hours and non\-emergency within 48 hours; verify completion data in Yardi/EliseAI.
* Manage vendor performance and verify all work meets quality and budget standards.

### **Financial Management**

* Act as P\&L steward for the community with accountability for revenue, expenses, and asset performance.
* Oversee rent collection and enforce lease terms in line with company policy and local law.
* Keep delinquency below 2% of monthly rent roll.
* Prepare and manage the annual budget, maintaining variance within ±3%.
* Optimize revenue through occupancy management, renewals, and rent strategies.
* Review and submit accurate month\-end financial and operational reports.

### **Leasing and Marketing**

* Lead leasing operations to achieve and maintain occupancy of 95% or higher.
* Conduct market surveys and recommend pricing adjustments.
* Oversee marketing initiatives, outreach programs, and resident events to drive renewals and referrals.
* Maintain renewal rates of 70% or higher through proactive resident engagement.

### **Resident Experience and Compliance**

* Foster a culture of exceptional customer service and prompt issue resolution.
* Maintain resident satisfaction (NPS) of 70 or higher.
* Manage all resident communication professionally and document interactions properly.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with Fair Housing, safety, and all applicable regulations.

### **Reporting and Communication**

* Submit weekly performance summaries to Area or Portfolio Manager, covering occupancy, delinquency, renewals, and maintenance KPIs.
* Communicate operational issues, risks, and achievements to leadership promptly.
* Support corporate initiatives and contribute to process improvement efforts.

 **Qualifications*** High school diploma or equivalent required; college degree preferred.
* Minimum three years of property management experience with supervisory responsibility.
* Proven success meeting goals in occupancy, collections, and resident satisfaction.
* Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead with empathy and accountability in a fast\-paced, data\-driven environment.
* Proficiency in Yardi and EliseAI preferred.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation required.

**Work Environment*** Work performed both in office and on property grounds.
* May require evenings or weekends based on community needs.
* Frequent interaction with residents, vendors, and team members.

**Compensation and Benefits*** Company sponsored housing at the assigned property
* 401k with employer match
* Company phone
* Typical Base Pay Range: $70,720 \- $76,500 per year, included bonus program participation

new_jobs.title: Product Operations Specialist | Juno
new_jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================


You will build and run the operating systems that help Juno ship reliably and support customers as we scale. On the product operations side, you will turn product decisions into clear operating plans, maintain visibility in Linear, coordinate customer testing and launch readiness, keep commitments and risks visible, and make sure product changes are communicated clearly.


You will partner closely with product and engineering to make decisions executable, keep work organized, surface gaps and dependencies, and ensure the team follows through on what it has committed to ship.


On the customer support side, you will be the first line of defense when customers encounter product issues. You will triage and investigate problems, coordinate the right response, and redirect travel\-service questions to our travel partners. Because you sit close to both the product process and the customer, you will turn recurring friction into clear insights, accountable follow\-up, and better operating systems.


Success means Juno ships through a lightweight and dependable process, customers understand what changed, risks and commitments do not get lost, recurring issues reach the right owners, and support demand does not grow one\-for\-one with the business.

***\*Please note that this Product Operations role will require you to be comfortable with working in\-person at our NYC HQ (located near Madison Square Park) at least 2 days/week\****

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Provide holistic support through the entire launch lifecycle across program management, customer testing, launch readiness, change management, customer communication, and post\-launch iteration. Own and improve Juno's shipping process so the right reviews, testing, documentation, internal enablement, and customer updates happen at the right time.
* Maintain Linear as a reliable operating system for projects, owners, milestones, dependencies, status, and product decisions. Surface risks early and follow through until they are resolved.
* Serve as the first line of defense for product\-related customer issues across email and chat, join customer calls when needed, manage escalations to resolution, and route travel\-service questions to the right partner.
* Be the voice of the customer in product decisions. Analyze support trends and customer feedback, diagnose recurring friction, size the problems you find, and translate messy input into clear findings, recommended actions, prioritization input, and accountable follow\-up for product and engineering.
* Build AI\-powered workflows, automations, knowledge systems, and self\-service experiences that improve the quality and speed of product operations and customer support.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 3\+ years of experience in product operations, program management, customer experience, technical support, consulting, or another customer\-facing analytical role in a fast\-moving software company.
* You are highly process\-oriented. You can turn ambiguous cross\-functional work into clear owners, milestones, decisions, and next steps without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* You actively use AI to get real work done and can show us what you have automated, analyzed, or built.
* You can use qualitative feedback and data to identify patterns, diagnose root causes, size problems, and measure whether a product or operational fix reduced customer friction.
* You write with precision and empathy. You can explain a complicated product change or technical issue clearly, without jargon or filler.
* You run toward ownership, move quickly without losing the details, and can drive clarity across product, engineering, customer success, customers, and external partners.

**Nice\-to\-Haves**
-------------------

* Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, debugging, or data analysis, even if you do not write production code.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, travel, fintech, or another operationally complex product.

**Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home\-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra\-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------

* 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

**Canada**
----------

* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
* Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 40\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.title: Automotive Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About Club Sportiva**

Club Sportiva is Silicon Valley’s country club for car enthusiasts and an event center for all. We provide members with access to an extraordinary collection of performance and exotic vehicles, curated automotive events and experiences, Managed Car Services, and an exclusive 18,000\+ square\-foot event venue.

Our Managed Car Services help members enjoy their vehicles without having to personally coordinate maintenance, detailing, transportation, storage, and other ownership responsibilities.

We are seeking a hands\-on, mechanically inclined automotive professional to help care for our vehicle collection and deliver Managed Car Services to our members.

**Position Overview**

The Automotive Operations \& Managed Car Services Specialist supports the daily care, movement, maintenance, and presentation of Club Sportiva and member\-owned vehicles.

This is a hands\-on automotive position—not a desk\-only service\-advisor role. A typical day may include inspecting a vehicle, diagnosing a basic problem, performing minor maintenance, transporting a vehicle to a service provider, detailing it, and delivering it back to a member.

The right candidate does not need to be a master technician, but must have practical mechanical aptitude, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work safely around exotic, luxury, classic, and performance vehicles.

This person must also be professional and comfortable interacting with members, explaining basic vehicle needs, and recommending Club Sportiva services when appropriate.

Key ResponsibilitiesVehicle Maintenance and Readiness

* Inspect Club Sportiva and member\-owned vehicles and document their condition
* Perform vehicle\-readiness inspections before rentals, events, member use, or delivery
* Check fluids, tires, batteries, warning lights, fuel levels, and other routine vehicle items
* Perform basic maintenance and minor mechanical repairs within your experience and abilities
* Use basic diagnostic equipment to identify common vehicle issues
* Recognize when a vehicle requires evaluation by a dealership or specialized repair facility
* Assist with battery replacement and charging, tire changes, fluid services, and installation of minor components
* Track maintenance needs, service appointments, and vehicle status
* Keep vehicles fueled or charged, clean, organized, and ready for use

**Managed Car Services**

* Assist with services for members’ personally owned vehicles
* Help members coordinate maintenance, detailing, transportation, storage, and vehicle preparation
* Listen to member needs and recommend relevant Club Sportiva services
* Prepare basic service documentation, vehicle\-condition reports, and status updates
* Communicate professionally with members regarding vehicle pickups, deliveries, and service progress
* Follow each assigned service request through completion
* Identify additional maintenance, detailing, or transportation needs and bring them to the attention of the department lead
* Help deliver a convenient, trustworthy, and high\-quality ownership experience

**Vehicle Transportation and Logistics**

* Safely pick up and deliver vehicles for members and Club Sportiva
* Transport vehicles between the club, member residences, dealerships, repair facilities, detailers, storage locations, and events
* Assist with loading, securing, transporting, and unloading vehicles using a truck and trailer
* Follow proper procedures when handling low\-clearance, high\-value, manual\-transmission, and performance vehicles
* Maintain accurate vehicle condition, mileage, key, and transportation records
* Inspect and maintain trailers, tie\-downs, tools, and transportation equipment
* Coordinate vehicle movements with team members, members, and outside vendors

**Detailing and Vehicle Presentation**

* Wash, clean, detail, and prepare vehicles to luxury presentation standards
* Perform interior cleaning, exterior detailing, wheel cleaning, glass cleaning, and basic paint care
* Inspect vehicles after detailing and correct presentation issues
* Help maintain detailing equipment, products, supplies, and work areas
* Stage vehicles for member use, photography, events, and showroom display
* Ensure vehicles are returned to members clean, organized, and professionally presented

**Member and Facility Support**

* Provide friendly, responsive, and professional service to members and guests
* Treat member vehicles and personal property with discretion and care
* Maintain clean and organized automotive work, detailing, and vehicle\-storage areas
* Support member drives, automotive experiences, partner activations, and special events
* Assist with vehicle displays, event setup, operations, and breakdown as needed
* Help maintain Club Sportiva’s overall facility and presentation standards
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and communicate promptly when problems arise

**Required Qualifications**

* Genuine interest in cars and automotive culture
* Practical mechanical aptitude and comfort working with hand tools
* Some professional, educational, or personal experience maintaining, repairing, detailing, or transporting vehicles
* Ability to perform basic vehicle inspections and minor maintenance
* Ability to recognize mechanical concerns and ask for assistance when a repair is beyond your capabilities
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record
* Comfortable driving a variety of vehicles, including performance vehicles
* Ability to drive a manual\-transmission vehicle, or willingness to become proficient
* Comfortable driving a truck and towing a vehicle trailer, or willingness to learn
* Strong attention to detail and respect for high\-value vehicles
* Professional appearance and positive, service\-oriented attitude
* Strong communication, organization, and time\-management skills
* Reliable, punctual, resourceful, and comfortable performing physical work
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and changing priorities

Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.


Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest\-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean\-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.


Despite being a $1\.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de\-risk projects, and scale with confidence.


As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.


We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top\-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

**About the Role**
==================


We've built the foundation for events at PermitFlow. Now we need someone to own the outcome and turn events into a pillar of our GTM motion.


This role runs the full events portfolio: industry conferences, owned events, customer\-specific gatherings, and field marketing, plus ongoing experimentation with new formats, venues, and audiences. You'll execute hands\-on, with internal and external support, and tie every event back to pipeline and revenue goals. We're an experimentation\-heavy culture. You'll be given room to ideate, experiment, measure, and repeat what works.


This is a manager\-level individual contributor role. You already know how to set goals, manage a budget, and partner across teams, and you'll bring that experience on day one.

* Own the events portfolio: build the calendar across industry events, owned events, customer events, and field marketing, and decide where to place bets.

* Manage event budgets and vendor relationships: negotiate contracts, manage contractor relationships, and keep spend accountable.

**Who You Are**
===============

* You've run B2B events in a fast\-moving environment and know the difference between an event that just looks good and one that drives pipeline.
* You can run logistics yourself. You don't need a coordinator to book a venue or manage a floor plan, but you know when and what to delegate.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================


You will build and run the operating systems that help Juno ship reliably and support customers as we scale. On the product operations side, you will turn product decisions into clear operating plans, maintain visibility in Linear, coordinate customer testing and launch readiness, keep commitments and risks visible, and make sure product changes are communicated clearly.


You will partner closely with product and engineering to make decisions executable, keep work organized, surface gaps and dependencies, and ensure the team follows through on what it has committed to ship.


On the customer support side, you will be the first line of defense when customers encounter product issues. You will triage and investigate problems, coordinate the right response, and redirect travel\-service questions to our travel partners. Because you sit close to both the product process and the customer, you will turn recurring friction into clear insights, accountable follow\-up, and better operating systems.


Success means Juno ships through a lightweight and dependable process, customers understand what changed, risks and commitments do not get lost, recurring issues reach the right owners, and support demand does not grow one\-for\-one with the business.

* Build AI\-powered workflows, automations, knowledge systems, and self\-service experiences that improve the quality and speed of product operations and customer support.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 3\+ years of experience in product operations, program management, customer experience, technical support, consulting, or another customer\-facing analytical role in a fast\-moving software company.
* You are highly process\-oriented. You can turn ambiguous cross\-functional work into clear owners, milestones, decisions, and next steps without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* You actively use AI to get real work done and can show us what you have automated, analyzed, or built.
* You can use qualitative feedback and data to identify patterns, diagnose root causes, size problems, and measure whether a product or operational fix reduced customer friction.
