new_jobs.title: Commercial Specialties Assistant Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
What This Job Is  
This is the supply side of commercial interiors. As an Assistant Project Manager on our Division 10 Specialties team, you'll take projects from the estimate through procurement, delivery, and closeout \- pricing the work, placing the orders, tracking lead times, and keeping general contractors and installers informed along the way. The goal is straightforward: the right products, on the job when the schedule calls for them, matching what the specs require.  


It's a full\-time, in\-office position, and it's structured as a path into a Project Manager seat.  


Who This Fits  
You'll do well here if you're organized enough to run a lot of open orders at once and comfortable picking up the phone when something doesn't line up. We're open on background \- zero to two years in construction, estimating, or project coordination works, and internships count. Prior work in customer service, sales, or any B2B setting transfers well, since a good share of this job is talking to people about what they need and when they need it.  


What we do want to see:  


Ability to read construction drawings, blueprints, and specifications  
A working understanding of construction processes, building systems, and project documentation  
Solid Microsoft Office skills; ERP or order entry experience helps  
Clear communication and a habit of following through  
Real interest in specialty products and the construction management side of the business  


The Work Itself  


Estimating and bidding  
Working under a Project Manager, you'll prepare takeoffs, budgets, quotations, and bid proposals. That starts with reviewing plans and specs to pin down what a project actually calls for, then identifying product solutions that hit the spec at a competitive number. Bids and budgets go out on deadline.  
Project execution  
Once a job is awarded, it's yours to run through closeout. You'll coordinate procurement, approvals, lead times, deliveries, and schedules against the project's milestones and completion dates, and keep records and customer information accurate as things move.  
Documentation  
Quotations, purchase orders, submittals, shop drawings, RFIs, change orders, and freight claims \- all of it has to stay current and compliant with the contract documents and customer requirements.  
Communication  
You'll be the point of contact for general contractors, architects, subcontractors, vendors, installers, and customers. When a product, order, or schedule issue comes up, you handle it directly and early, with a consultative approach rather than an order\-taking one.  


Product Categories You'll Work With  
Toilet partitions, toilet accessories, lockers and benches, fire extinguishers and cabinets, visual display units, corner guards and wall protection, interior signage, and assorted other specialties.  


What Success Looks Like  
The people who thrive in this role are self\-starters \- detail\-oriented, analytical, able to juggle competing priorities without dropping any of them. They work independently but coordinate well with internal teams and outside partners, they communicate professionally under pressure, and they're genuinely trying to learn the business well enough to step up into a PM role.  


Apply  
If you have construction project support experience and you want to build a career on the specialties side of commercial interiors, send us your application!  


United Contractor Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law.

new_jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative (Chicago)
new_jobs.description:
We are looking for an ambitious, drive\-oriented Inbound Sales Representative (ISR) to join our Sales team. In this role, you will own a book of business, drive full\-cycle sales deals, and directly impact revenue growth. You will partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives on key accounts and operate at the intersection of AI\-powered tooling, a world\-class product, and a transformed go\-to\-market strategy.



This role is based in our Chicago office with an office\-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in\-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in\-office requirements.


### **What you'll achieve**


* Own and close inbound and transactional opportunities within your assigned book of business, running the full sales cycle with speed and precision.
* Build and drive new pipeline through targeted outbound plays in new logo accounts and large existing footprints, partnering closely with Enterprise and Emerging Enterprise AEs.
* Shadow AEs on larger strategic transactions to accelerate your development toward a full AE closing role.
* Fast follow transactions in your book — direct customers to the best onboarding resources and set the stage for future expansion and up\-tiering.
* Monitor and work inbound opportunities across your AE\-mapped book to ensure timely coverage — routing appropriately between yourself and the AE based on deal size and complexity.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to prioritize your pipeline, surface buying signals, and move faster on the deals that matter while experimenting with new plays and revenue motions that scale across Asana's global Scale organization.
* Monitor and drive success across key metrics including pipeline volume, deal velocity, average deal size, and win rate to continuously refine your approach.
* Maintain high standards of pipeline hygiene across managed opportunities and forecast with a high degree of precision.

### **About you**


* Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision\-making.
* 2\+ years of experience in Sales or Outbound Sales Development with a strong track record of hitting or exceeding targets.
* Demonstrated experience up\-selling, cross\-selling, and hunting for net\-new pipeline.
* Full\-cycle closing exposure or a strong appetite to close, with a clear vision of developing into a future AE.
* Impeccable customer\-facing skills with exceptional communication, empathy, and integrity.
* Ability to build and follow repeatable processes that support a high volume of concurrent customer interactions.
* Proficient with modern sales tech stacks; familiarity with Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, or similar platforms preferred.
* Growth\-oriented and adaptable — you bring a strategic mindset and genuine appetite for coaching and development, thriving in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments where you can find creative paths forward.


At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.


### **What we'll offer**



Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.



For this role, the On\-Target Earnings (OTE) range is $69,000 \- $77,000 (based on the terms of the Sales Incentive Plan and level). These ranges are a guideline; actual base salary and OTE may vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process, and the ranges for this role may be modified.



In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

* Mental health, wellness \& fitness benefits

* Long\-term savings or retirement plans
* In\-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences


These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

Asana is a leading platform for human \+ AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7\+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office\-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. * Help create polished, client\-facing delivera1bles including proposals, presentations, meeting materials, account plans, business cases, and other strategic documentation.
* Maintain visibility into key priorities, deadlines, commitments, and next steps across sales, partnerships, customers, and internal initiatives.

* Ability to stay organized and thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment while managing multiple priorities
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
